While existing AI-generated image (AGI) evaluation benchmarks have made notable progress, comprehensive AGI defect diagnosis remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce AGIDefect-4K, a richly annotated dataset of 4,000 images from 15 state-of-the-art generative models spanning both open-source and closed-source systems. AGIDefect-4K features hierarchical defect annotations: (1) detection labels identifying whether defects exist, (2) pixel-level segmentation masks localizing defective regions, and (3) detailed textual explanations characterizing defect types and their perceptual impact. Each image is further annotated with an overall quality score. Building on this, we present AGIDA (AGI Defect Assistant), a baseline framework leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for joint defect detection, localization, explanation, and quality prediction. Comprehensive benchmarking on AGIDefect-4K reveals that AGI defect understanding remains challenging, underscoring the value of this dataset. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/sxfly99/AGIDefect-4K.
summary_zh: 当前生成式AI可生成高度逼真的图像，但生成结果仍存在细微但关键的缺陷，损害了生成内容的可靠性。现有AI生成图像（AGI）评估基准已取得显著进展，但面向AGI的综合缺陷诊断仍缺乏充分探索。为填补这一空白，本文提出AGIDefect-4K，一款标注丰富的数据集，包含来自15款开源与闭源最先进生成模型的4000张图像。AGIDefect-4K具备分层缺陷标注：1）识别缺陷是否存在的检测标签；2）定位缺陷区域的像素级分割掩码；3）描述缺陷类型及其感知影响的详细文本解释。每张图像还额外标注了整体质量评分。基于该数据集，本文提出AGIDA（AGI Defect Assistant，AI生成图像缺陷助手），一款利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）同时完成缺陷检测、定位、解释与质量预测的基线框架。在AGIDefect-4K上的综合基准测试表明，AI生成图像的缺陷理解任务仍极具挑战性，凸显了该数据集的应用价值。数据集公开地址：https://github.com/sxfly99/AGIDefect-4K。

title: Privacy-Preserving Object Detection for Vision Transformer-Based Models
title_zh: 面向视觉Transformer模型的隐私保护目标检测
authors: Homare Sueyoshi, Kiyoshi Nishikawa, Hitoshi Kiya
abstract: We propose a novel object detection method that enables us to protect sensitive visual information of test images. Previous studies considering visual information protection focus on image classification tasks. This paper proposes an object detection method using perceptual encryption for the first time. The proposed method can achieve almost the same accuracy as that of models without any protection by utilizing the embedding structure of the Vision Transformer (ViT) and a domain adaptation technique with keys. In experiments, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified in terms of accuracy and visual protection under the use of ViTdet, which is a ViT-based object detection model.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种新型目标检测方法，可保护测试图像中的敏感视觉信息。此前针对视觉信息保护的研究主要聚焦图像分类任务，本文首次提出使用感知加密的目标检测方法。该方法利用ViT（Vision Transformer，视觉Transformer）的嵌入结构与带密钥的域自适应技术，可实现与无保护模型几乎一致的精度。实验中，本文基于ViT架构的目标检测模型ViTdet，从精度与视觉保护效果两个维度验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: ArtiMo: Agent-Driven Articulated Mesh Animation
title_zh: ArtiMo：智能体驱动的关节网格动画
authors: Chunyu Zou, Peng Dai, Yi-Hua Huang, Ze Yuan, Jingwei Huang, Yeming Yao, Xiaojuan Qi
abstract: Animating articulated 3D meshes via text requires satisfying strict kinematic constraints, modeling causal interactions between parts, and achieving instruction fidelity. Due to the absence of task-specific training data and explicit articulation supervision, existing data-driven mesh animation methods are largely inapplicable to this setting. To address this, we propose ArtiMo, a novel agent-driven framework for text-guided articulated mesh animation. Operating in a zero-shot manner, ArtiMo develops an agentic pipeline powered by Large Language and Vision-Language Models (LLMs/VLMs) to orchestrate motion generation. By synergizing the explicit kinematic constraints of URDF with the agent's reasoning and planning capabilities, it effectively produces causally coherent part motions and interactions without requiring model fine-tuning. To ensure motion correctness, the agent additionally utilizes a visual self-improvement mechanism: generated animations are rendered into compact keyframes and motion cues, enabling the VLM to iteratively diagnose and correct errors. Furthermore, we contribute a new benchmark dataset spanning 21 articulated object categories, featuring high-quality motion annotations enriched with causal relationships. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ArtiMo significantly outperforms baselines, particularly on complex, causally driven motions. The project page is available at https://zou-2004.github.io/ArtiMo/.
summary_zh: 通过文本驱动关节3D网格动画需要满足严格的运动学约束、建模部件间的因果交互、保证指令保真度。由于缺乏任务专属训练数据与显式关节标注监督，现有数据驱动的网格动画方法大多无法适配该场景。针对该问题，本文提出ArtiMo，一款全新的智能体驱动框架，用于实现文本引导的关节网格动画。ArtiMo以零样本方式运行，搭建由大语言模型与视觉语言模型（LLM/VLM）驱动的智能体流水线，统筹运动生成过程。该方法将URDF（统一机器人描述格式）的显式运动学约束与智能体的推理规划能力相结合，无需对模型进行微调即可生成具备因果一致性的部件运动与交互。为保证运动正确性，智能体还引入视觉自改进机制：将生成的动画渲染为精简关键帧与运动线索，让VLM可迭代诊断并修正错误。此外本文贡献了一款全新基准数据集，覆盖21类关节物体，包含标注了因果关系的高质量运动标注。大量实验表明，ArtiMo的表现显著优于基线方法，在复杂的因果驱动运动任务上优势尤为明显。项目主页地址：https://zou-2004.github.io/ArtiMo/。

title: Bridging Language and Spherical Space: Object-Centric Control for Text-to-Panorama Generation
title_zh: 衔接语言与球面空间：面向文本到全景图生成的以物体为中心控制
authors: Derui Li, Qian Qiao, Yuhao Sun, Wenhao Guo, Peng Lu
abstract: Panoramic image generation is increasingly important for immersive applications such as virtual reality, augmented reality, and 3D content creation. Unlike perspective images, panoramic images represent a viewer-centered $360^\circ$ surrounding space, where directional expressions such as left, right, front, and behind play a central role in spatial understanding. However, existing text-to-panorama methods largely rely on implicit spatial reasoning and often fail to faithfully ground object-level directional descriptions in spherical panoramic scenes. A straightforward alternative is to introduce explicit layouts, but requiring manually specified spatial conditions reduces the flexibility of language-based interaction and does not directly resolve the misalignment between egocentric directional language and panoramic image space. To address this issue, we propose PanoCtrl, an object-centric framework for controllable text-to-panorama generation. Our method explicitly bridges natural language and spherical panoramic space by converting textual descriptions into structured object-level spherical conditions and integrating them into the diffusion process. Specifically, we introduce PanoParse, a text-conditioned parser that predicts object semantics and spherical bounding field-of-view (BFoV) parameters, and \textbf{PanoControl}, which injects object-level semantic and spatial guidance into the diffusion transformer through object-aware attention and spatial residual enhancement. To support this task, we construct PanoGround, a dataset with object-level spherical annotations and diverse directional descriptions for controllable panoramic generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PanoCtrl achieves state-of-the-art performance in both spatial alignment and image quality.
summary_zh: 全景图像生成在虚拟现实、增强现实、3D内容创作等沉浸式应用中的重要性日益提升。与透视图像不同，全景图像代表以观察者为中心的360°环绕空间，左、右、前、后等方位表述在空间理解中占据核心地位。但现有文本到全景图生成方法大多依赖隐式空间推理，往往无法将物体级的方位描述准确映射到球面全景场景中。一种直接的解决方案是引入显式布局，但要求人工指定空间条件会降低语言交互的灵活性，也无法直接解决自我中心方位语言与全景图像空间的错位问题。针对该问题，本文提出PanoCtrl，一款面向可控文本到全景图生成的以物体为中心的框架。该方法通过将文本描述转换为结构化的物体级球面条件，并将其集成到扩散过程中，显式衔接自然语言与球面全景空间。具体而言，本文提出PanoParse，一款文本条件解析器，可预测物体语义与球面视场边界（BFoV）参数；同时提出PanoControl，通过物体感知注意力与空间残差增强，将物体级的语义与空间引导注入扩散Transformer。为支撑该任务，本文构建了PanoGround，一款面向可控全景图生成的数据集，包含物体级球面标注与多样化的方位描述。大量实验表明，PanoCtrl在空间对齐度与图像质量上均达到当前最先进性能。

title: Identity-Aware Human-Object Interaction Motion Captioning
title_zh: 身份感知的人-物交互运动描述生成
authors: Yiming Wang, Yonghao Dang, Huilai Li, Jiawei Tu, Jianqin Yin
abstract: Existing human-object interaction (HOI) motion captioning methods typically describe what happens while referring to the subject using generic terms such as "a person" or "someone", without grounding the caption in subject identity. To address this limitation, we introduce Identity-Aware Human-Object Interaction Motion Captioning task. This task requires each generated caption to specify both the subject identity and the corresponding HOI motion. For example, the model generates "Sub_ID lifts the chair" rather than "A person lifts the chair". For this task, we design identity-aware HOI motion captions based on the BEHAVE and InterCap datasets. We further propose ID-HOINet, which learns from multi-view videos while supporting single-view identity-aware HOI motion caption generation. ID-HOINet contains two core components: Multi-View Identity-Motion Learning Module (MVIML) and Two-Stage Caption Rewriting Strategy (TSCR). MVIML learns from multi-view videos by modeling dependencies across temporal stages and camera viewpoints, capturing identity and interaction motion features. At inference, the TSCR first retrieves the subject identity and generates identity-agnostic HOI motion captions. TSCR then rewrites these captions with the predicted identity to produce the final identity-aware HOI motion captions. Experiments demonstrate that ID-HOINet achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 现有人-物交互（HOI）运动描述生成方法通常使用“一个人”“某人”这类通用术语指代主体来描述发生的动作，无法将描述与主体身份绑定。针对该局限，本文提出身份感知人-物交互运动描述生成任务，要求生成的每条描述都同时指定主体身份与对应的人-物交互运动，例如模型生成“Sub_ID 抬起椅子”而非“一个人抬起椅子”。针对该任务，本文基于BEHAVE与InterCap数据集构建了身份感知的人-物交互运动标注。本文进一步提出ID-HOINet，该模型可从多视图视频中学习，同时支持单视图身份感知人-物交互运动描述生成。ID-HOINet包含两个核心组件：多视图身份-运动学习模块（MVIML）与两阶段描述重写策略（TSCR）。MVIML通过建模时间阶段与相机视角间的依赖关系从多视图视频中学习，捕获身份与交互运动特征。推理阶段，TSCR首先检索主体身份，生成与身份无关的人-物交互运动描述，随后使用预测的身份重写描述，输出最终的身份感知人-物交互运动描述。实验表明ID-HOINet达到当前最先进性能。代码将在论文录用后开源发布。

title: TopoSurfel: Closing the Loop between Gaussian Surfels and Meshes for Surface Reconstruction
title_zh: TopoSurfel（拓扑面元）：面向表面重建的高斯面元与网格闭环构建方法
authors: Chuanjin Fan, Wenjie Chang, Bohao Liao, Yujia Chen, Wenfei Yang, Tianzhu Zhang
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting has achieved remarkable success in novel view synthesis. However, extracting high-fidelity surfaces directly from 3DGS remains challenging due to its discrete and unstructured nature. Existing 3DGS-based reconstruction methods typically rely on multi-view geometric consistency or local constraints. Without an explicit structured geometric prior during optimization, these methods often struggle to resolve structural ambiguities, leading to artifacts and floaters, particularly in textureless or occluded regions. To address this limitation, we propose TopoSurfel, a novel framework that closes the loop between Gaussian surfels and continuous meshes. Unlike recent methods that incorporate mesh extraction into the differentiable pipeline by introducing auxiliary neural networks or extra per-Gaussian parameters, we dynamically extract a continuous proxy mesh via a non-trainable differentiable iso-surfacing process. Leveraging this differentiable connection, we introduce a mesh-guided surfel evolution strategy, including normal alignment and geometry-aware density control, to effectively suppress floaters and fill surface holes. Furthermore, to address the initialization challenges in large-scale environments, we propose a spatially aware hybrid re-initialization strategy that ensures robust reconstruction across complex scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TopoSurfel achieves competitive geometric reconstruction accuracy while maintaining high-quality mesh-based novel view synthesis. The code for our method is available at https://github.com/Fan-Treasure/TopoSurfel.
summary_zh: 三维高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS）在新视角合成任务中已取得显著成效，但由于其离散非结构化的固有属性，直接从3DGS中提取高保真表面仍存在较大挑战。现有基于3DGS的重建方法通常依赖多视图几何一致性或局部约束，在优化过程中缺乏显式的结构化几何先验，往往难以解决结构歧义问题，进而产生伪影与浮点伪影，在无纹理或被遮挡区域表现尤为突出。为解决该局限，本文提出TopoSurfel这一全新框架，实现了高斯面元与连续网格之间的闭环连接。不同于近期相关工作通过引入辅助神经网络或额外的逐高斯参数将网格提取嵌入可微流水线的方案，本文通过不可训练的可微等值面提取过程动态生成连续代理网格。借助该可微连接，本文提出包含法向对齐与几何感知密度控制的网格引导面元演化策略，可有效抑制浮点伪影并填补表面孔洞。此外，为解决大规模环境下的初始化难题，本文提出空间感知混合重初始化策略，可保障复杂场景下的鲁棒重建效果。大量实验表明，TopoSurfel在保持高质量基于网格的新视角合成效果的同时，达到了极具竞争力的几何重建精度。本文方法的开源代码已发布于：https://github.com/Fan-Treasure/TopoSurfel。

title: Aristotelian Manifolds: Leveraging Platonic Perceptual Features for Backpropagation Free Rapid Concept Learning
title_zh: 亚里士多德流形：利用柏拉图感知特征实现无反向传播快速概念学习
authors: Michael Karnes, Alper Yilmaz
abstract: This paper formalizes and systematically characterizes Aristotelian Manifolds, a generalized structural framework built upon the Platonic Representation Hypothesis. We position high-capacity foundation models as universal perceptual filters and conduct a comprehensive layer-wise investigation to map how knowledge is functionally synthesized within these latent subspaces. Across diverse architectural paradigms and multi-domain datasets, we rigorously chart the interplay between network depth, dimensionality reduction, and distance metrics. Our characterization reveals that semantic maturation does not follow a singular, monotonic path; instead, different data domains exhibit highly distinct geometric response profiles, characterized by intermediate mound-like peaks for specialized clinical modalities and sigmoidal plateaus for natural visual tasks. By profiling the exact coordinates where these manifolds achieve peak representational efficiency, we establish a predictable taxonomy for layer selection and feature compression. Ultimately, this systematic characterization demonstrates that mapping the internal geometry of frozen representations provides a robust, backpropagation-free, and interpretable framework for understanding and exploiting foundation model latent spaces.
summary_zh: 本文基于柏拉图表征假说，形式化定义并系统刻画了亚里士多德流形这一通用结构化框架。研究将高容量大模型定位为通用感知滤波器，通过逐层全面分析，明确了知识在这些隐式子空间中的功能合成机制。在不同架构范式与多领域数据集上，本文严谨梳理了网络深度、降维操作与距离度量三者之间的相互作用关系。刻画结果表明，语义成熟过程并非遵循单一单调路径：不同数据域呈现出差异极大的几何响应特征，面向专用临床模态的响应曲线呈现中间隆起的峰型特征，面向自然视觉任务的响应曲线则呈现S型平台特征。通过定位这些流形达到最高表征效率的精确坐标，本文建立了可预测的层选择与特征压缩分类体系。最终，该系统性刻画工作证明，对冻结表征的内部几何结构进行映射，可为理解和利用大模型隐空间提供一套鲁棒、无反向传播且可解释的框架。

title: Shortcut Learning in a Public Grape Disease Dataset: Annotation Granularity as a Modulator, Not a Cause
title_zh: 公开葡萄病害数据集的捷径学习现象：标注粒度是调制因子而非根本原因
authors: Pushuo Wang (Shenyang Institute of Technology)
abstract: Public datasets for agricultural disease detection are usually judged fit for use from reported metrics, which say nothing about whether the annotation scheme is internally consistent. On one public grape disease dataset (3288 images, 11995 boxes, 6 classes), varying model capacity, input resolution and detection paradigm yields a test-set mAP50 range comparable to seed-to-seed noise, with the bottleneck at small objects across all five architectures. The finding lies on the data side: one class is annotated at whole-leaf level (median box area 43.16% of the image) while the other five are annotated at lesion level. On 5156 cross-species images containing no grape, 65.7% of the false-positive boxes fall into that one class, an over-representation of 13.41x relative to its share of the training annotations. Counterfactual retraining establishes a causal effect of granularity on the magnitude of the shortcut: shrinking only that class's boxes cuts its cross-species false positives by 66%, and a placebo control confirms the effect is specific to the manipulated class. A manipulation in the opposite direction, with criteria registered in advance, returns a negative result: coarsening the finest class to whole-leaf level (0.57% to 40.37%), matched in box count and share of annotations and with higher in-distribution AP, still leaves its cross-species false positives at zero boxes, while the unmanipulated original class holds 50.0% of them. Annotation granularity is therefore a modulator of this shortcut, not its cause: it can amplify or attenuate a sink that already exists, but cannot create one, and what fixes the destination remains open. We also give a granularity screening statistic requiring neither images nor training, and show airborne lesion-level detection to be optically out of reach. The failure mode is invisible to in-distribution evaluation.
summary_zh: 农业病害检测公开数据集通常仅依据公开指标判定可用性，这类指标无法反映标注方案的内部一致性。本文针对一个公开葡萄病害数据集（含3288张图像、11995个标注框、共6个类别）开展实验，结果显示在调整模型容量、输入分辨率与检测范式的情况下，测试集mAP50的波动范围与随机种子噪声相当，且所有5种架构的性能瓶颈均集中在小目标上。该现象的根源来自数据层面：该数据集中一个类别采用全叶级标注（标注框面积中位数占图像的43.16%），其余5个类别则采用病斑级标注。在5156张不含葡萄的跨物种图像上，65.7%的误检框都集中在该全叶级标注类别中，其误检占比是其训练集标注占比的13.41倍。反事实重训练实验证实，标注粒度对捷径学习的强度存在因果效应：仅缩小该类别的标注框即可将其跨物种误检率降低66%，安慰剂对照实验进一步证实该效应仅作用于被调整的类别。本文预先设定标准开展反向调整实验得到了阴性结果：将标注最精细的类别粗化为全叶级标注（标注框面积占比从0.57%提升至40.37%），在标注框数量、标注占比均与原类别匹配且分布内AP更高的情况下，该类别跨物种误检数始终为0，而未调整的原全叶级标注类别仍占全部跨物种误检的50%。因此标注粒度是这类捷径学习的调制因子而非根本原因：它可以放大或衰减已存在的偏差汇聚效应，但无法凭空生成该效应，而偏差汇聚效应的根本成因仍有待进一步探究。本文还提出了无需图像与训练过程即可计算的标注粒度筛查统计量，并证实机载病斑级检测在光学层面目前仍无法实现，这类失效模式无法通过分布内评估发现。

title: Lift, Associate, and Fuse: A Decision-Centric Framework for 2D-to-3D Foundation Model Transfer
title_zh: 升维、关联与融合：以决策为中心的2D到3D大模型迁移框架
authors: Wentao Sun, Yiping Chen, John S. Zelek, Jonathan Li
abstract: Methods that transfer predictions from two-dimensional foundation models into three-dimensional segmentation are commonly grouped by task or representation. Those groupings obscure the decisions that determine whether a system remains coherent across views: where image evidence is grounded, when observations become one identity, how semantic and granularity conflicts are handled, which information is fused, and what state survives for later queries. We introduce \textbf{Lift, Associate, and Fuse (LAF)}, a decision-centric framework that represents a transfer system as five operators: \textbf{Generate, Associate, Reconcile, Fuse, and Persist/Query}. LAF defines an explicit contract for the persistent carrier---its spatial support, semantic state, identity state, uncertainty, provenance, and supported operations---and identifies the first stage at which discarded evidence becomes unrecoverable. We operationalize the framework as a structured audit protocol and apply it to 161 systems available through 7 August 2026, spanning point-, field-, Gaussian-, object-, graph-, and memory-based carriers. Representation, temporal, relational, and feed-forward stress tests required no additional analytical stage after the final confirmation pass. The resulting decision traces expose four recurring properties: association does not establish identity; carrier design fixes both the query interface and correction boundary; rendered-view, native-3D, and proposal-level evaluations are not interchangeable; and qualifiers such as \emph{training-free}, \emph{real-time}, \emph{open-vocabulary}, and \emph{generalizable} are meaningful only when attached to a stage and a complete cost ledger. LAF therefore supplies a representation-neutral method for comparing existing systems, diagnosing irreversible failures, and specifying revisable 3D perception for future agents.
summary_zh: 将二维大模型的预测结果迁移至三维分割任务的现有方法通常按任务或表征类型分类，这类分类方式掩盖了决定系统跨视图一致性的核心决策逻辑：图像证据的锚定位置、观测结果合并为同一身份的触发条件、语义与粒度冲突的处理方式、待融合信息的筛选规则，以及可供后续查询保留的状态定义。本文提出升维-关联-融合（Lift, Associate, and Fuse, LAF）这一以决策为中心的框架，将迁移系统定义为5个算子：生成、关联、协调、融合与持久化/查询。LAF为持久化载体定义了明确的约束规范，涵盖其空间支撑域、语义状态、身份状态、不确定性、来源与支持操作，同时明确了被丢弃证据彻底不可恢复的首个阶段。本文将该框架落地为结构化审计协议，对截至2026年8月7日公开的161套系统开展评估，覆盖基于点、场、高斯、目标、图与内存的各类载体。表征、时序、关系与前馈压力测试均无需在最终确认阶段后增设额外分析步骤。最终得到的决策轨迹揭示了四类共性规律：关联操作并不等价于身份确认；载体设计同时决定了查询接口与错误修正边界；渲染视图评估、原生3D评估与候选框级评估三者不可互换；“免训练”“实时”“开放词汇”“泛化性”等限定词只有绑定到具体阶段与完整成本台账时才有实际意义。因此LAF提供了一套表征无关的方法，可用于对比现有系统、诊断不可逆故障，以及为未来智能体定义可修正的3D感知体系。

title: MV2GF: Multi-view Pedestrian Detection with a Visual Geometric Foundation Model
title_zh: MV2GF：基于视觉几何基础模型的多视角行人检测方法
authors: Taiga Yamane, Satoshi Suzuki, Ryo Masumura, Shota Orihashi, Tomohiro Tanaka, Mana Ihori, Naoki Makishima
abstract: Multi-View Pedestrian Detection (MVPD) aims to detect pedestrians in the form of a bird's eye view map from multi-view images. Recent MVPD methods adopt a unified framework that projects 2D image features into a 3D world space and aggregates them into a single feature. Although they are effective, they struggle to generalize to unseen camera configurations during training due to two main issues. First, they are difficult to capture accurate visual geometry across views in unseen camera configurations. Second, they make detection models highly dependent on distortion patterns during training arising from their image feature projection. To address these, we leverage a visual geometric foundation model and propose MV2GF. This foundation model has exhibited strong generalization in capturing visual geometry across views and predicting accurate 3D attributes in diverse camera configurations. MV2GF fuses task-specific features with general-purpose geometric features extracted by the foundation model to effectively capture the visual geometry even in unseen camera configurations. Furthermore, MV2GF projects each pixel in the image features to an appropriate 3D location using 3D pointmaps predicted by the foundation model, preventing the detection model from depending on distortion patterns during training. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of leveraging a visual geometric foundation model for MVPD and that MV2GF generalizes better than existing methods.
summary_zh: 多视角行人检测（Multi-View Pedestrian Detection, MVPD）的目标是从多视图图像中以鸟瞰图形式输出行人检测结果。近期的MVPD方法采用统一框架，将2D图像特征投影到3D世界空间并聚合为单张特征图。这类方法虽然有效，但在训练阶段未见过的相机配置下泛化性较差，主要存在两点问题：第一，这类方法难以在未知相机配置下捕捉跨视图的准确视觉几何信息；第二，其图像特征投影过程会导致检测模型高度依赖训练过程中引入的畸变模式。为解决上述问题，本文利用视觉几何基础模型提出MV2GF方法，该基础模型在跨视图视觉几何捕捉、不同相机配置下的精确3D属性预测任务中已展现出极强的泛化能力。MV2GF将任务专属特征与基础模型提取的通用几何特征相融合，即使在未知相机配置下也能有效捕捉视觉几何信息。此外，MV2GF利用基础模型预测的3D点图，将图像特征中的每个像素投影到合适的3D位置，避免检测模型依赖训练过程中的畸变模式。实验结果证实，利用视觉几何基础模型可有效提升多视角行人检测性能，且MV2GF的泛化表现优于现有方法。

title: RECOUNT: Reference-guided Counting with Synthetic Visual Exemplars
title_zh: RECOUNT：基于合成视觉示例的参考引导计数方法
authors: Adriano D'Alessandro, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Ghassan Hamarneh
abstract: Text-guided zero-shot object counters excel at spatial localization but categorize poorly on novel or fine-grained classes: natural language is too coarse to fully specify visual identity, so they fail to separate visually similar distractors. Few-shot counters sidestep this with visual exemplars, but require manual annotations on every image. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce RECOUNT, a plug-and-play framework for image-guided zero-shot counting. Rather than specify a category with a text prompt, our key insight is to specify it visually, from a single off-scene reference image. However, we find that a lone reference image provides narrow coverage of a category's appearance and is unreliable across diverse scenes. We therefore repurpose a diffusion model as an automated contrastive data engine that expands the reference into a diverse exemplar gallery, supplying the discriminative detail that text cannot. RECOUNT preserves the class-agnostic proposals of any frozen counter and offloads categorization to a separate visual module (a frozen backbone with a lightweight head trained on this synthetic data) that matches each proposal against the target and distractor galleries. Applied to a frozen counter, RECOUNT attains the best zero-shot accuracy on both benchmarks, cutting counting error (MAE) by 55% on LookAlikes and 21% on PairTally relative to the strongest prior zero-shot counter.
summary_zh: 文本引导的零样本目标计数方法在空间定位任务中表现优异，但在新类别或细粒度类别上的分类效果较差：自然语言的描述粒度太粗，无法完整定义视觉特征，因此这类方法难以区分视觉上相似的干扰目标。少样本计数方法通过视觉示例规避了该问题，但需要对每张图像进行手动标注。为解决这一矛盾，本文提出RECOUNT这一即插即用的图像引导零样本计数框架。该方法的核心思路是不使用文本提示定义类别，而是通过单张独立于场景外的参考图像从视觉层面定义类别。但研究发现，单张参考图像对类别外观的覆盖范围十分有限，在不同场景下的可靠性不足。因此本文将扩散模型改造为自动对比数据引擎，将单张参考图扩展为多样化的示例库，补充文本无法提供的判别性细节。RECOUNT保留任意冻结计数模型的类别无关候选框生成能力，将分类任务交由独立的视觉模块完成：该模块由冻结骨干网络与训练于合成数据上的轻量头组成，可将每个候选框与目标库、干扰库进行匹配。将RECOUNT应用于冻结计数模型后，在两个基准数据集上均取得了当前最优的零样本精度，与此前性能最好的零样本计数模型相比，在LookAlikes数据集上计数误差（MAE）降低55%，在PairTally数据集上降低21%。

title: A Dataset-Centric Benchmark of Deep Learning Methods for Grape Leaf Disease Classification and Detection
title_zh: 以数据集为中心的葡萄叶病害分类与深度学习检测方法基准测试
authors: Petar Canoski, Vlatko Spasev, Ivica Dimitrovski, Ivan Kitanovski, Petre Lameski
abstract: Grape leaf disease recognition is important for precision agriculture, enabling early diagnosis, timely intervention, and improved vineyard management. Although deep learning has achieved strong results, many studies rely on few datasets, often acquired under controlled conditions, and may not reflect real vineyard challenges such as complex backgrounds, variable illumination, occlusion, leaf pose, disease severity, and device differences. This paper presents a dataset-centric benchmark of deep learning methods for grape leaf disease classification and detection. We analyze publicly available datasets in terms of disease categories, annotation types, acquisition conditions, image characteristics, class distributions, provenance, and task suitability. Representative models are evaluated in three settings: image-level classification, region-level classification, and object detection. Classification is assessed using accuracy, while detection is evaluated using mAP@50 and mAP@50:95. Cross-dataset experiments further examine transfer between datasets with compatible disease categories but different visual and annotation characteristics. Results show near-saturated classification performance on several controlled or derivative datasets, greater difficulty on heterogeneous datasets, and substantial variation in detection performance across annotation settings. Cross-dataset performance drops sharply, especially for object detection, indicating that shared disease labels do not necessarily define equivalent recognition tasks. The benchmark emphasizes dataset provenance, realistic field evaluation, annotation compatibility, and external validation for reliable vineyard disease recognition.
summary_zh: 葡萄叶病害识别是精准农业的重要组成部分，可实现早期诊断、及时干预，优化葡萄园管理水平。尽管深度学习在该领域已取得良好效果，但大量研究仅依赖少量在受控条件下采集的数据集，无法反映真实葡萄园场景中的各类挑战，例如复杂背景、光照变化、遮挡、叶片姿态差异、病害严重程度不同与采集设备差异等。本文提出一套以数据集为中心的葡萄叶病害分类与深度学习检测方法基准测试体系，从病害类别、标注类型、采集条件、图像特征、类别分布、数据来源与任务适配性多个维度对公开数据集进行全面分析。研究在三类设置下对代表性模型开展评估：图像级分类、区域级分类与目标检测，其中分类任务采用准确率作为评估指标，检测任务采用mAP@50与mAP@50:95作为评估指标。跨数据集实验进一步验证了病害类别兼容但视觉特征、标注特征不同的数据集之间的模型迁移效果。结果显示，多个受控数据集或衍生数据集上的分类性能已接近饱和，异构数据集上的分类难度显著提升，不同标注设置下的检测性能差异极大。跨数据集性能出现大幅下降，目标检测任务的下降尤为明显，说明共享的病害标签并不等价于任务定义的一致性。该基准测试强调，为实现可靠的葡萄园病害识别，需重点关注数据集来源、真实田间场景评估、标注兼容性与外部验证。

title: Sparse Light Field Sampling Improves Casual 3D and 4D Reconstruction
title_zh: 稀疏光场采样优化日常3D与4D重建效果
authors: Shamus Li, Ruiming Cao, Laura Waller, Kristina Monakhova, Sara Fridovich-Keil
abstract: Many consumer smartphones, stereo cameras, and light field cameras record multiple synchronized viewpoints in a single exposure event. However, novel view synthesis pipelines commonly use only a monocular stream and rely on camera motion or learned priors to obtain angular coverage. In this paper, we ask: why do we use only one viewpoint? We analyze sensor-limited multi-view, where one sensor trades off spatial and angular resolution, and exposure-limited multi-view, where multiple sensors on one commodity device observe each event simultaneously. We introduce a new dataset incorporating three types of commodity multi-view cameras, and evaluate sparse-view 3DGS and 4DGS baselines measuring reconstruction quality as a function of number of exposures and angle between extreme views. Our results demonstrate that using multiple cameras, even with a low baseline, significantly improves reconstruction quality in single-shot, few-shot, and casual video settings. In addition, under a fixed sensor budget, angular sampling improves reconstruction when exposures are scarce despite lower spatial resolution. The gains are most pronounced for single-shot and dynamic scenes, where a stationary monocular camera lacks the angular diversity to recover scene geometry and motion.
summary_zh: 大量消费级智能手机、立体相机与光场相机可在单次曝光过程中同步记录多个视点的信息，但现有新视角合成流水线通常仅使用单目数据流，依赖相机运动或学习到的先验实现角度覆盖。本文提出疑问：为何我们仅使用单个视点的信息？本文分别分析了两类多视图场景：受传感器限制的多视图场景（单个传感器需在空间分辨率与角度分辨率之间做权衡），以及受曝光限制的多视图场景（消费级设备上的多个传感器可同步观测同一场景事件）。本文构建了包含三类消费级多视图相机的全新数据集，以曝光次数、最远视图夹角为变量，对稀疏视图3DGS与4DGS基线方法的重建质量开展评估。实验结果表明，即使采用小基线的多相机配置，也能在单帧、少帧与日常视频场景下显著提升重建质量。此外，在传感器总预算固定的前提下，当曝光次数不足时，即使空间分辨率有所下降，角度采样仍能提升重建效果。该性能提升在单帧场景与动态场景下最为显著，这类场景下固定单目相机缺乏足够的角度多样性，无法恢复场景几何结构与运动信息。

title: Aggregate, Don't Adapt: Subject-Level Posterior Aggregation and Transductive Calibration for Cross-Site Parkinsonian Gait Severity
title_zh: 聚合而非适配：面向跨站点帕金森步态严重程度评估的受试者级后验聚合与直推校准方法
authors: Junlong Shen
abstract: We describe the winning entry to the MoCha 2026 Benchmark and Challenge on Parkinsonian Gait, which predicts MDS-UPDRS gait severity from canonicalized SMPL motion recorded at clinical sites unseen during training. The system reaches 0.6945 macro-F1 on the hidden test and ranked first of 58 entries, ahead of the runner-up at 0.5807 and the organizers' baseline at 0.4289, on a frozen public motion encoder with a single $4\times512$ linear layer. Nearly all of the margin comes from three stages usually treated as bookkeeping: reproducing the reference benchmark's exact head recipe, averaging per-walk posteriors within the subject grouping the organizers ship, and a label-free transductive calibration of the feature mean and the decision operating point. Fine-tuning the encoder lost in four distinct forms, and ten alternative encoders were worse. Every ablation number is a paid read on the hidden test, because our own leave-two-cohort-out cross-validation proved anti-correlated with the deciding score over eleven configurations. We give the negative record in full, and identify our largest gain, subject-level aggregation, as the binding ceiling on this benchmark.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了MoCha 2026帕金森步态基准挑战赛的冠军方案，该任务目标是基于训练阶段未见过的临床站点采集的标准化SMPL运动数据，预测MDS-UPDRS步态严重程度。该方案在隐藏测试集上的宏F1值达到0.6945，在58支参赛队伍中排名第一，远超第二名的0.5807与赛事主办方基线的0.4289，其基础仅为在冻结公开运动编码器上添加一个4×512的线性层。几乎所有的性能优势都来自三类通常被视为边缘处理的步骤：复现基准测试官方定义的精确头部结构、在赛事官方提供的受试者分组内对同一次行走的后验结果取平均、以及无需标签的特征均值与决策工作点直推校准。对编码器进行微调的四种不同方案均出现性能下降，替换的10种其他编码器性能也均更差。所有消融实验结果均通过隐藏测试集付费查询得到，因为本文自研的留两个站点交叉验证方案在11种配置下均与最终评测分数呈负相关。本文完整记录了所有失败尝试，同时指出本方案最大的性能增益来自受试者级聚合，该方法是本次基准测试的性能上限约束因素。

title: Consistency Models for Fast MRI Reconstruction Using Regularization by Denoising
title_zh: 基于去噪正则化的一致性模型快速MRI重建方法
authors: Merve G\"ulle, Junno Yun, Ya\c{s}ar Utku Al\c{c}alar, Mehmet Ak\c{c}akaya
abstract: Diffusion models (DMs) have emerged as powerful generative priors for MRI reconstruction with promising results. Yet DM-based methods require extensive iterative refinement, limiting their practical deployment. Consistency models (CMs) provide a compelling alternative, aiming to map out the diffusion trajectory in a single pass, enabling faster generation. In this work, we propose CM-RED, a novel MRI reconstruction method that integrates a pretrained CM into the regularization by denoising (RED) scheme. Our method builds on accelerated proximal gradient RED (RED-APG), and further incorporates controlled noise injection during the update steps to enhance generative diversity and accelerate convergence. Extensive experiments on the fastMRI knee and brain datasets demonstrate that CM-RED achieves high-quality reconstructions across multiple anatomies, contrast weights, acceleration factors, and undersampling patterns, using only 4 network function evaluations (NFEs). The proposed method consistently outperforms existing DM- and CM-based approaches in both quantitative metrics and visual fidelity, and exhibits strong robustness to hyperparameter variations, highlighting CM-RED as an efficient and effective generative framework for accelerated MRI reconstruction. The source code and pretrained models are publicly available at https://github.com/MerveGulle/CM-RED.
summary_zh: 扩散模型作为强大的生成先验已在MRI重建任务中取得良好效果，但基于扩散模型的方法需要大量迭代优化，限制了其实际落地。一致性模型是极具潜力的替代方案，可通过单次前向传播完成扩散轨迹映射，实现更快的生成速度。本文提出CM-RED这一全新MRI重建方法，将预训练一致性模型集成到去噪正则化（Regularization by Denoising, RED）框架中。该方法基于加速近邻梯度去噪正则化（RED-APG）构建，在更新步骤中引入可控噪声注入，进一步提升生成多样性并加快收敛速度。在fastMRI膝关节与脑部数据集上开展的大量实验表明，CM-RED仅需4次网络函数评估（NFE），即可在不同解剖部位、不同对比度、不同加速因子与不同欠采样模式下实现高质量重建。在定量指标与视觉保真度上，该方法的表现始终优于现有基于扩散模型与一致性模型的相关方法，同时对超参数变化具有极强的鲁棒性，是一套高效实用的加速MRI重建生成框架。本文的开源代码与预训练模型已发布于：https://github.com/MerveGulle/CM-RED。

title: Zero-Shot Color Image Manipulation Localization via Noise Residual Artifact Pattern Analysis
title_zh: 基于噪声残差伪影模式分析的零样本彩色图像篡改定位
authors: Edgar Gonzalez-Fernandez
abstract: Digital cameras embed device-specific artifacts into every acquired image through demosaicing, in-camera post-processing, and lossy compression. These traces constitute a forensic signal that can be exploited to assess image authenticity. Existing passive methods rely predominantly on the green channel of the Bayer residual, discarding the correlated information available in the remaining color channels and typically requiring training data or device enrollment. This work proposes a zero-shot, training-free blind image manipulation localization pipeline that estimates a reference artifact pattern directly from the noise residual of a single suspect image, without assuming a fixed filter configuration, color layout, or block period. The pipeline incorporates a principled denoiser selection criterion based on the acquired-to-interpolated noise variance ratio, a block-level correlation analysis against the estimated reference pattern, and a two-component Gaussian Mixture Model scoring stage that produces a pixel-level tampering probability map. An ablation study evaluates the impact of denoiser choice and block size on localization accuracy, and comparisons against state-of-the-art passive methods demonstrate the competitiveness of the proposed zero-shot approach.
summary_zh: 数码相机通过去马赛克、机内后处理和有损压缩操作，会在每一张采集到的图像中嵌入设备专属的伪影痕迹。这类痕迹属于可用于评估图像真实性的取证信号。现有被动取证方法大多依赖拜耳残差的绿色通道，丢弃了其余颜色通道中包含的关联信息，且通常需要训练数据或提前录入设备信息。本文提出一种零样本、无需训练的盲图像篡改定位流水线，无需假设固定的滤波器配置、色彩布局或块周期，直接从单张可疑图像的噪声残差中估计参考伪影模式。该流水线包含基于采集-插值噪声方差比的严谨去噪器选择准则、针对估计得到的参考模式的块级相关性分析，以及可输出像素级篡改概率图的双分量高斯混合模型（Gaussian Mixture Model）打分阶段。消融实验评估了去噪器选择和块尺寸对定位精度的影响，与当前最优被动取证方法的对比结果证明了所提零样本方法的竞争力。

title: Learning Prostate Anatomy at Test Time for Cancer Detection in Micro-Ultrasound
title_zh: 面向微超声前列腺癌检测的测试时前列腺解剖结构学习方法
authors: Obed Korshie Dzikunu, Mohammad Mahdi Abootorabi, Mohamed Harmanani, Paul F. R. Wilson, Emma Willis, Ferdinand Luger, Adam Kinnaird, Brian Wodlinger, Parvin Mousavi, Purang Abolmaesumi
abstract: Domain shift across clinical centers using different imaging hardware or acquisition protocols remains a fundamental barrier to deploying deep learning models for prostate cancer (PCa) detection. Existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods address distribution shift through entropy minimization or augmentation-based self-supervision, correcting for statistical differences in image appearance but ignoring the anatomical structure of the target domain. We propose ANT, a segmentation-guided TTA framework that adapts a pretrained cancer detection encoder to the target domain by solving an auxiliary prostate segmentation task at test time, supervised by pseudo-masks from a frozen pretrained segmentation network. By aligning encoder representations to prostate anatomy in the target domain, ANT corrects domain-specific feature drift while preserving cancer-discriminative structure. The model was trained on 693 patients imaged with an earlier-generation micro-ultrasound scanner in a multi-center clinical trial, and evaluated on 118 patients acquired with a newer-generation system across two centers in another clinical trial. Under a leave-one-center-out protocol with identical evaluation conditions across all methods, ANT improves mean AUC by 2.9% and 3.6% at the biopsy-core and patient levels, respectively, over no adaptation, outperforming TTA baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/ObedDzik/ant.git.
summary_zh: 不同临床中心使用不同成像硬件或采集协议带来的域偏移问题，始终是部署深度学习前列腺癌（PCa）检测模型的核心障碍。现有测试时自适应（Test-Time Adaptation, TTA）方法通过熵最小化或基于增强的自监督策略解决分布偏移问题，仅校正了图像外观的统计差异，却忽略了目标域的解剖结构信息。本文提出ANT，一种分割引导的TTA框架，在测试阶段通过求解辅助前列腺分割任务，以冻结的预训练分割网络输出的伪掩码为监督信号，将预训练的癌症检测编码器适配到目标域。通过将编码器表征与目标域的前列腺解剖结构对齐，ANT在校正域特有特征漂移的同时，保留了对癌症具有区分性的结构特征。该模型在多中心临床试验中使用第一代微超声扫描仪采集的693例患者数据上完成训练，在另一项临床试验中两个中心使用新一代系统采集的118例患者数据上完成评估。在所有方法评估条件完全一致的留一中心协议下，相较于未做自适应的基线方法，ANT在活检核心层面和患者层面的平均AUC分别提升了2.9%和3.6%，性能优于所有对比的TTA基线方法。代码开源地址为：https://github.com/ObedDzik/ant.git。

title: Keep Your Friends Close, and the Right Neighbours Closer: Disaster-Conditioned Kernel-Regularized Graph Attention for Building Damage Classification
title_zh: 与友为邻、择善而从：面向建筑损毁分类的灾害条件核正则化图注意力模型
authors: Fuad Hasan, Chul Min Yeum
abstract: Disaster damage is spatial: buildings rarely fail in isolation. Yet using spatial context for damage classification remains surprisingly underexplored, and many pipelines still rely primarily on per-building appearance cues even when the dominant uncertainty is spatially structured. Complicating matters, the right neighbourhood is not the same across events. Floods, hurricanes, and wildfires can exhibit very different clustering behaviour, making spatial reasoning valuable but easy to misuse - naive context aggregation can improve visual coherence while oversmoothing boundaries or propagating structured errors. We study this tension on xBD (the dataset used in the xView2 challenge) in a controlled post-localization, classification-only setup: each building is represented by a pre/post combined (PPC) patch cropped from the provided polygons, and spatial context is modelled with GPS-derived building graphs. Our approach keeps local evidence "close" by preserving strong spatial relationships in disaster damage patterns, while bringing only the right neighbours "closer" through a disaster-type-conditioned graph model that injects a learnable multi-scale spatial kernel prior into attention, allowing the effective neighbourhood scale to adapt across disaster types rather than being learned as a single global smoothing rule. To discourage coherence-by-smoothing, we add a residual de-correlation loss that penalizes positive Moran's~I in prediction residuals. We evaluate the method under event and dataset shift with a leave-one-event-out (LOEO) protocol on xBD and cross-dataset transfer from xBD to Ida-BD. The model improves macro-F1 and substantially reduces residual spatial autocorrelation under zero-shot event shift, indicating better use of spatial context rather than naive smoothing and enabling more reliable transfer to unseen events within known disaster types.
summary_zh: 灾害损毁具有空间属性：建筑极少单独发生损毁。但利用空间上下文信息做损毁分类的相关研究仍十分不足，多数处理流水线即便在不确定性呈空间结构化的场景下，仍主要依赖单建筑的外观特征。更复杂的是，不同灾害事件对应的有效邻域范围并不相同：洪水、飓风、野火的损毁聚集特性差异极大，使得空间推理价值很高但也极易被误用——朴素的上下文聚合操作可能提升视觉一致性，但同时会过度平滑边界或传播结构化误差。本文在xBD数据集（xView2挑战赛使用的数据集）上开展受控的定位后纯分类场景研究：每栋建筑由从给定多边形中裁剪得到的灾前灾后合并（PPC）补丁表示，基于GPS信息构建的建筑图对空间上下文建模。所提方法通过保留灾害损毁模式中的强空间关联，让局部证据保持“邻近”，同时通过灾害类型条件图模型仅将合适的邻域纳入关联范围，该模型将可学习的多尺度空间核先验注入注意力机制，使得有效邻域尺度可随灾害类型自适应调整，而非作为单一全局平滑规则学习。为避免通过平滑操作实现伪一致性，本文添加了残差去相关损失，对预测残差中出现的正莫兰指数（Moran's I）施加惩罚。本文在xBD数据集上采用留一事件（Leave-One-Event-Out, LOEO）协议，在事件偏移和数据集偏移场景下开展评估，同时完成了从xBD到Ida-BD的跨数据集迁移实验。所提模型在零样本事件偏移场景下提升了宏F1值，大幅降低了残差空间自相关性，证明其有效利用了空间上下文而非采用朴素平滑策略，可在已知灾害类型下更可靠地迁移到未见过的事件中。

title: Grounded-Exo2Ego: Structured Semantic Grounding for Robust Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
title_zh: Grounded-Exo2Ego：面向鲁棒外视角到第一视角视频生成的结构化语义锚定框架
authors: Shengze Wang, Michael Stengel, Tianye Li, Seonwook Park, Amrita Mazumdar, Koki Nagano, Alex Trevithick, Shalini De Mello
abstract: Generating egocentric video from a single exocentric video is an emerging and important topic for AR/VR and physical AI. Compared with conventional novel view synthesis, exo-to-ego generation is a significantly harder task because the standard geometric conditioning becomes highly unreliable under extreme view changes and large unobservable regions. We present Grounded-Exo2Ego, a principled framework that addresses these challenges at both the architectural and data levels. Architecturally, Grounded-Exo2Ego is a dual-branch video diffusion model that couples a geometric anchoring branch, which conditions the generation on the rendering of a 3D reconstruction, with a novel semantic grounding branch, which goes beyond the prevailing geometry-based approach and improves quality by synthesizing challenging regions based on object-level context. Additionally, we found that the overlooked issue of camera-reconstruction misalignment severely undermines exo-to-ego learning. We thus introduce a camera re-localization algorithm that resolves this issue and substantially improves quality across all metrics. We further develop a fully automated synthetic data engine that generates and renders rigged 3D characters in procedurally generated environments. Evaluation on the challenging EgoExo4D dataset shows that our method outperforms recent state-of-the-art approaches by large margins across all metrics. Detailed ablations validate improvements from each of our contributions at both the data and architectural level.
summary_zh: 从单段外视角视频生成第一视角视频是AR/VR和实体AI领域的新兴重要研究方向。与传统的新视角合成任务相比，外视角转第一视角生成的难度显著更高，因为在极端视角变化和大量不可观测区域的场景下，标准几何条件约束会变得高度不可靠。本文提出Grounded-Exo2Ego这一严谨框架，从架构和数据两个层面解决上述挑战。架构层面，Grounded-Exo2Ego是一个双分支视频扩散模型，其中几何锚定分支将生成过程约束在3D重建结果的渲染输出上，同时新增语义锚定分支，突破主流的基于几何的方法局限，基于物体级上下文合成高难度区域的内容。此外，本文发现此前被忽略的相机-重建结果不对齐问题会严重损害外视角转第一视角的学习效果，因此提出相机重定位算法解决该问题，可大幅提升所有指标下的生成质量。本文进一步开发了全自动化合成数据引擎，可在程序化生成的环境中生成并渲染绑定骨骼的3D角色。在高难度EgoExo4D数据集上的评估结果显示，所提方法在所有指标上的性能都大幅超过近年的当前最优方法。详细的消融实验验证了本文在数据层面和架构层面提出的所有贡献都能带来性能提升。

title: Frozen CLIP Priors for Robust Self-Supervised Poisson Inverse Problems
title_zh: 面向鲁棒自监督泊松逆问题的冻结CLIP先验方法
authors: Laura C. Diaz-Delgado, Emmanuel Martinez, Henry Arguello
abstract: Self-supervised learning for imaging inverse problems is increasingly important in photon-limited settings, where acquiring clean ground truth is impractical and reconstruction must remain stable under dataset and acquisition shifts. This challenge is amplified under Poisson noise, whose signal-dependent statistics interact with sampling operators (e.g., CFA mosaicing). Meanwhile, foundation vision encoders trained at web scale offer distortion-invariant, content-related representations that generalize well across domains, suggesting a promising route to build priors that transfer beyond the training distribution without expensive fine-tuning. This paper proposes an ADMM-inspired unrolled plug-and-play solver for Poisson inverse problems that decouples a closed-form data-consistency update from a parameter-efficient prior. The prior is implemented as a lightweight decoder operating on frozen CLIP RN50 dense multi-scale features, adapting foundation representations with less trainable parameters. For self-supervision, the method integrates GR2R measurement-domain re-corruption with an Equivariant Imaging regularizer via virtual acquisitions. Experiments on Poisson CFA demosaicing and deblurring show competitive quality, improved robustness under shifts, and self-supervised performance approaching supervised training.
summary_zh: 成像逆问题的自监督学习在光子受限场景下的重要性日益凸显，这类场景下获取干净真值数据的成本极高，且重建过程必须在数据集偏移和采集条件偏移下保持稳定。泊松噪声的信号相关统计特性会与采样算子（如CFA马赛克操作）相互作用，进一步放大了上述挑战。与此同时，在全网规模数据上训练的视觉基础编码器可输出对失真不敏感、与内容相关的跨域泛化能力极强的表征，为构建无需昂贵微调、可泛化到训练分布之外的先验提供了可行路径。本文提出受交替方向乘子法（ADMM）启发的展开式即插即用求解器，用于求解泊松逆问题，将闭式数据一致性更新与参数高效的先验解耦。该先验通过轻量级解码器实现，作用于冻结的CLIP RN50稠密多尺度特征，仅需极少的可训练参数即可适配基础模型表征。在自监督实现层面，该方法将GR2R测量域重污染操作与通过虚拟采集实现的等变成像正则器相结合。在泊松CFA去马赛克和去模糊任务上的实验结果显示，该方法可获得有竞争力的重建质量，偏移场景下的鲁棒性得到提升，自监督性能接近有监督训练的效果。

title: DiffVC-ONE: Diffusion-based Generative Video Compression with One-Step Video Diffusion Transformer
title_zh: DiffVC-ONE：基于单步视频扩散Transformer的生成式视频压缩方法
authors: Wenzhuo Ma, Zhenzhong Chen
abstract: Generative video compression can recover rich visual details at low bitrates, but simultaneously achieving high temporal consistency and low inference cost remains challenging. To address this issue, we propose DiffVC-ONE, a diffusion-based generative video compression framework built on a one-step Video Diffusion Transformer. First, we introduce a Unified Unidirectional Latent Compressor that uses a shared model to efficiently and uniformly compress compact latent slices. We then develop a Video DiT-based One-Step Diffusion Enhancer that uses the reconstructed latent slices as content anchors and performs single-step spatio-temporal perceptual enhancement over an entire group of pictures. Finally, a Hybrid Condition Generator extracts structural, strength, and semantic conditions from the reconstructed content and quantization information. These conditions preserve faithful regions, control the degree of generative enhancement, and supplement content-aware perceptual details during one-step diffusion enhancement. Extensive experiments on multiple standard benchmarks demonstrate that DiffVC-ONE achieves state-of-the-art perceptual quality and temporal consistency with low inference cost.
summary_zh: 生成式视频压缩可在低码率下恢复丰富的视觉细节，但同时实现高时间一致性和低推理成本仍存在很大挑战。为解决该问题，本文提出DiffVC-ONE，一种基于单步视频扩散Transformer的扩散生成式视频压缩框架。首先引入统一单向隐层压缩器，使用共享模型高效均匀地压缩紧凑的隐层切片。随后开发基于视频扩散Transformer（Video DiT）的单步扩散增强器，将重建得到的隐层切片作为内容锚点，对整组图片执行单步时空感知增强。最后设计混合条件生成器，从重建内容和量化信息中提取结构条件、强度条件和语义条件。这些条件可在单步扩散增强过程中保留保真区域、控制生成增强的程度、补充内容感知的感知细节。在多个标准基准数据集上的大量实验结果表明，DiffVC-ONE可在低推理成本下实现当前最优的感知质量和时间一致性。

title: Annotations as Rollouts: Efficient and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Video MLLMs
title_zh: 标注即推演：面向视频多模态大语言模型的高效可扩展强化学习方法
authors: Yunheng Li, Guohong Mu, Hao Li, Shengsheng Qian, Dingwen Zhang, Qibin Hou, Ming-Ming Cheng
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become a prevailing paradigm for unified video perception. However, post-training on large multi-task datasets remains challenging, as existing reinforcement learning methods sample on-policy groups with few high-quality rollouts even with costly chain-of-thought (CoT) generation. In this paper, we study the sample efficiency and scalability of RL post-training for video MLLMs and introduce OraRL. We identify an overlooked role for annotations: Beyond scoring rollouts, each can enter its on-policy group as an oracle rollout, a direct positive optimization target. Direct oracle integration, however, is nontrivial: a high-reward oracle raises the group baseline and inverts otherwise positive policy advantages, a failure we term advantage inversion. At the core of OraRL is a decoupled advantage estimator: policy rollouts determine an oracle-free baseline, while the oracle-policy gap modulates both a directional gain and a separate detached oracle advantage. Sign-balanced pruning improves efficiency: by retaining only the oracle and the strongest rollouts of each sign, OraRL requires just 2.2x the step time of SFT, less than half the 4.9x required by GRPO with CoT. OraRL scales with model size and data, surpassing its backbone from 0.8B to 9B and GRPO up to 100k prompts. Without chain-of-thought, Video-ORA-9B decodes in 130 ms instead of 4,780 ms. Compared with the respective prior best models, it raises temporal mIoU from 62.5 to 66.0, tracking AO from 73.0 to 78.2, segmentation from 64.3 to 70.4, and the three-benchmark spatial-intelligence macro average from 51.0 to 56.1; on VSI-Bench, it scores 73.1 against 55.0 for GPT-5 and 55.1 for Gemini-3-Pro.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）已成为统一视频感知的主流范式。但在多任务大规模数据集上执行后训练仍存在很大挑战：现有强化学习方法即便使用成本高昂的思维链（CoT）生成，采样得到的同策略组中高质量推演样本的数量也很少。本文研究视频MLLM的强化学习后训练的样本效率和可扩展性，提出OraRL方法。本文发现标注存在此前被忽略的作用：除了为推演样本打分之外，每一条标注都可以作为 oracle 推演样本加入同策略组，成为直接的正向优化目标。但直接整合oracle推演样本并非易事：高奖励的oracle样本会拉高组内基线，反转原本为正的策略优势，本文将该失效问题定义为优势反转。OraRL的核心是解耦优势估计器：策略推演样本确定不含oracle的基线，oracle与策略的差距同时调制方向增益和独立的分离式oracle优势。符号平衡剪枝操作进一步提升了效率：仅保留oracle样本和每个符号下的最强推演样本，OraRL的训练步耗时仅为监督微调（SFT）的2.2倍，不到使用思维链的GRPO方法所需耗时（4.9倍）的一半。OraRL的性能随模型规模和数据量提升而增长，在0.8B到9B参数规模下性能均超过其 backbone 模型，在10万提示样本规模下性能超过GRPO方法。无需思维链的Video-ORA-9B模型解码耗时仅为130ms，远低于4780ms。与此前的最优模型相比，其时间mIoU从62.5提升至66.0，跟踪AO指标从73.0提升至78.2，分割指标从64.3提升至70.4，三个基准的空间智能宏平均指标从51.0提升至56.1；在VSI-Bench数据集上得分73.1，远超GPT-5的55.0和Gemini-3-Pro的55.1。

title: Aggregating Visual Information with Optimal Transport for VideoLM Token Compression
title_zh: 基于最优传输聚合视觉信息的VideoLM令牌压缩方法
authors: Wenti Yin, Xiaotian Han, Junyuan Shang, Yuchen Ding, Shuohuan Wang, Dianhai Yu, Changxin Gao, Nong Sang
abstract: Video language models process videos as dense visual-token sequences with substantial representational redundancy. Compressing these sequences is therefore essential for reducing the visual-token burden on language-model decoding. The central challenge is to preserve visual information dispersed across frames under such compression. To this end, we introduce Aggregating Visual Information with Optimal Transport (AVIOT), which casts video token compression as transporting a dense empirical measure of frame observations onto a compact target measure. The resulting source-to-target coupling induces a distribution over source observations for each target support, directly specifying how the compressed video representation is constructed. We further adapt this construction along task and spatial axes. Question conditioning modulates the transport cost between source frames and target supports, while influencing how many supports are allocated to each temporal segment, thereby directing representation capacity toward question-relevant content. At multiple spatial granularities, AVIOT computes region-specific temporal transport plans and adaptively fuses the representations they yield, allowing different regions within the same compact representation to draw from different moments. Evaluations across varying compression ratios show that AVIOT matches or outperforms the uncompressed baseline on multiple video-understanding benchmarks while retaining strong performance at higher compression ratios.
summary_zh: 视频语言模型将视频处理为稠密的视觉令牌序列，存在大量表征冗余。因此压缩这类序列对于降低语言模型解码阶段的视觉令牌负载至关重要。该压缩任务的核心挑战是在压缩过程中保留分散在各帧中的视觉信息。为此，本文提出AVIOT（Aggregating Visual Information with Optimal Transport，基于最优传输的视觉信息聚合方法），将视频令牌压缩任务建模为将帧观测的稠密经验测度传输到紧凑的目标测度的过程。得到的源-目标耦合关系为每个目标支撑点生成源观测的分布，直接指定了压缩后视频表征的构建方式。本文进一步沿任务维度和空间维度对该构建过程做适配：问题条件可调制源帧与目标支撑点之间的传输成本，同时控制分配给每个时间片段的支撑点数量，从而将表征容量引导到与问题相关的内容上。在多个空间粒度下，AVIOT计算区域专属的时间传输计划，自适应融合得到的表征，使得同一紧凑表征内的不同区域可从不同时刻的帧中提取信息。在不同压缩比下的评估结果显示，AVIOT在多个视频理解基准上的性能与未压缩基线相当甚至更优，且在高压缩比下仍能保持优异性能。

title: MultiCube: Compositional 3D Generation With Part-Level Semantic and Spatial Control
title_zh: MultiCube：支持部件级语义与空间控制的组合式3D生成方法
authors: Ava Pun, Kangle Deng, Yiheng Zhu, Jun-Yan Zhu, Maneesh Agrawala, Tinghui Zhou
abstract: Digital 3D objects used in games and animation are often required to be compositional; that is, decomposed into semantically meaningful parts. Recent 3D generation methods can produce high-quality compositional objects conditioned on image or text prompts. Yet, such global conditioning lacks the precise part-level controllability required for professional creative workflows. To address this, we introduce MultiCube, a novel compositional 3D generation method that provides explicit, independent control over both the semantics and spatial arrangement of each part. MultiCube takes as input a global text prompt, a text schema specifying the desired parts, and a spatial layout indicating the bounding boxes of the parts in the given schema. It outputs a 3D object composed of distinct meshes, one per specified part, that adhere to the given semantic and spatial conditions. Our approach employs a two-stage diffusion process, first generating a schema- and layout-aligned monolithic mesh, then decomposing the mesh into individual parts simultaneously. A novel Part Layout Adapter is used to encode per-part conditions independently of the other parts. Experiments demonstrate that our method can generate high-quality compositional 3D objects with precise part-level control, including those with unique layouts difficult to achieve with text or image prompting alone. Project page: https://multi-cube.github.io
summary_zh: 游戏和动画中使用的数字3D对象通常要求具备组合性，即可分解为语义上有意义的多个部件。近年的3D生成方法可在图像或文本提示的条件下生成高质量的组合式对象，但这类全局条件无法满足专业创意工作流所需的精确部件级可控性。为解决该问题，本文提出MultiCube，一种全新的组合式3D生成方法，可对每个部件的语义和空间排布实现显式的独立控制。MultiCube的输入包括全局文本提示、指定所需部件的文本模式，以及指示给定模式中各部件包围盒的空间布局，输出由多个独立网格组成的3D对象，每个网格对应一个指定部件，完全符合给定的语义和空间条件。本文方法采用两阶段扩散流程：首先生成与模式和布局对齐的整体网格，随后将该网格同时分解为多个独立部件。所提全新部件布局适配器可独立于其他部件对每个部件的条件进行编码。实验结果表明，该方法可生成具备精确部件级控制能力的高质量组合式3D对象，包括仅通过文本或图像提示难以实现的特殊布局对象。项目主页为：https://multi-cube.github.io。

title: RISE: Adaptive Imagination for World Action Models
title_zh: RISE：面向世界动作模型的自适应推演框架
authors: Hongbo Lu, Liang Yao, Chenghao He, Hao Han, Fan Liu, Wenlong Liao, Tao He, Pai Peng
abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve planning by incorporating future world evolution into action generation, yet existing methods allocate a fixed imagination budget to every scene. We propose RISE (\textbf{R}efining \textbf{I}magination through \textbf{SE}lective Rollout), a system-level adaptive imagination framework that makes sequential \textsc{Roll}/\textsc{Stop} decisions according to the expected planning benefit of continued rollout. At each step, a Latent Evaluator estimates the risk revealed by the current prefix and how much planning could improve if imagination continues, while a Rollout Gate weighs this expected benefit against additional computation cost. Since factual driving logs expose only one realized future, we further construct \textbf{CounterDrive}, a counterfactual dataset with diverse outcomes and risk levels, to enrich future dynamics and provide localized risk supervision. Each retained sample undergoes expert verification and annotation of trajectory validity, incident onset, and causal category, providing a reusable resource for safety-critical world-modeling research. Experiments on NAVSIM and nuScenes show that RISE achieves the best overall planning performance while reducing unnecessary rollout, with additional transfer results supporting its plug-in generality across WAM architectures.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）通过将未来世界演化过程纳入动作生成环节提升规划性能，但现有方法为所有场景分配固定的推演预算。本文提出RISE（Refining Imagination through SElective Rollout，通过选择性推演优化推演过程的自适应框架），这一系统级自适应推演框架可根据继续推演带来的预期规划收益，依次执行推演/停止决策。每一步中，隐层评估器估计当前推演前缀暴露的风险，以及继续推演可带来的规划性能提升幅度，推演门控模块权衡该预期收益与额外计算成本。由于真实驾驶日志仅记录了一种实际发生的未来场景，本文进一步构建了CounterDrive这一包含多样化结果和风险等级的反事实数据集，用于丰富未来动力学信息，提供本地化风险监督。所有保留样本都经过专家验证，标注了轨迹有效性、事件起始点和因果类别，可为安全关键型世界建模研究提供可复用的资源。在NAVSIM和nuScenes数据集上的实验结果显示，RISE在减少不必要推演的同时取得了最优的整体规划性能，额外的迁移实验结果证明该插件方法可适配不同架构的WAM模型，具备通用性。

title: Maximum Entropy Encoding of Energy-Weighted Spherical Moments
title_zh: 能量加权球矩的最大熵编码
authors: Jiaze Sun
abstract: We study how angular energy signals composed of non-negative Monte Carlo path samples can be compressed and reconstructed for irradiance using finite moments. Writing each sample as an energy-weighted directional feature $x = r u$, we adopt total energy, the first directional moment, and the traceless second moment as $1+3+5$ linearly additive, rotationally covariant statistics. Under a fixed Lebesgue reference measure, the maximum-entropy closure yields $p(r,u) \propto \exp(-\beta r g(u))$, where $g(u) = 1 - b \cdot u + u^T Q u$, whose directional probability and angular energy density are proportional to $g^{-3}$ and $g^{-4}$, respectively. When $g_{\min} > 0$ the closure is normalizable and the reconstruction is strictly positive. We further provide analytic moment matching, variance, inverse sampling, and closed-form diffuse response for the pure-dipole four-parameter subfamily, as well as the realizability domain, partition function, azimuthal algebraic integral, and LUT-oriented reconstruction form for the dipole-second-moment coaxial five-parameter subfamily. Experiments cover 981 Poly Haven HDRI 2K scenes and three Debevec probes. Five-parameter MaxEnt achieves a 78.7% per-scene win rate against stored QZH, with mean luminance RMSE reduced by 15.8%; the advantage is more pronounced in scenes with strong directionality. Both MaxEnt variants maintain zero negative irradiance across all scenes. Full second-order SH-2 yields the lowest overall error, while five-parameter MaxEnt ranks second and outperforms SH-2 in the high-directionality bucket; the coaxial subfamily shows systematic closure error on non-coaxial multi-source scenes.
summary_zh: 本文研究如何利用有限矩对由非负蒙特卡洛路径样本构成的角能量信号进行压缩与重建，以实现辐照度计算。将每个样本表示为能量加权方向特征$x = r u$后，我们采用总能量、一阶方向矩、无迹二阶矩共1+3+5个满足线性可加性、旋转协变性的统计量。在固定勒贝格参考测度下，最大熵闭包得到分布$p(r,u) \propto \exp(-\beta r g(u))$，其中$g(u) = 1 - b \cdot u + u^T Q u$，对应的方向概率和角能量密度分别与$g^{-3}$、$g^{-4}$成正比。当$g_{\min} > 0$时，该闭包满足归一化条件，重建结果严格为正。本文进一步为纯四极子四参数子族提供了解析矩匹配、方差、逆采样、闭式漫反射响应的计算方法，同时给出了偶极-二阶矩同轴五参数子族的可实现域、配分函数、方位角代数积分、面向查找表(LUT)的重建形式。实验覆盖981个Poly Haven HDRI 2K场景与3个Debevec探针场景，五参数最大熵(MaxEnt)方法对比存储的QZH方法，单场景胜率达78.7%，平均亮度均方根误差降低15.8%，在强方向性场景中优势更为显著；两种最大熵变体在所有场景中均未产生负辐照度。完整二阶球谐(SH-2)方法的整体误差最低，五参数最大熵方法排名第二，且在高方向性场景区间性能优于SH-2；同轴子族在非同轴多源场景中存在系统性闭包误差。

title: StateSight: Benchmarking Latent Spatial-State Reconstruction in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: StateSight：视觉语言模型潜在空间状态重建基准测试
authors: Michelle Lin
abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used for multimodal question answering, yet their ability to reconstruct latent spatial structure from a single image remains difficult to isolate. Broad benchmarks often combine perception, optical character recognition, domain knowledge, linguistic priors, and reasoning in the same evaluation. We introduce StateSight, a procedurally generated benchmark for cube-net opposite-face reasoning, occluded cube-tower counting, and 4-neighbor connected-component counting. Each task family contains 300 single-image prompts with deterministic oracle labels and exact-match scoring. OpenAI GPT-5.5, using the API model identifier gpt-5.5, achieved 59.3%, 33.3%, and 28.3% accuracy across the three tasks, while Claude Sonnet 5 achieved 53.3%, 18.7%, and 7.3%. All final direct runs had zero format errors. A 30-participant human baseline on 60 items exceeded both models on every task, with mean accuracies of 80.8%, 68.8%, and 64.3%. Visible-derivation analysis identified recurring errors in image-state reconstruction and reasoning procedure. We also introduce StateSight-Steps, a companion dataset of 900 interleaved image-text examples and 3,600 deterministic intermediate visual states. The results show that format-valid responses can mask failures to recover the spatial structure required for verifiable visual inference.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型已在多模态问答任务中得到广泛应用，但目前仍难以单独评估其从单张图像重建潜在空间结构的能力。现有通用基准通常将感知、光学字符识别、领域知识、语言先验与推理任务混合在同一评估流程中。本文提出StateSight，一个通过程序生成的基准数据集，支持立方体展开图对面推理、遮挡立方体塔计数、4邻接连通分量计数三类任务。每个任务子集包含300个带确定性真值标签的单图像提示，采用精确匹配规则打分。调用API标识为gpt-5.5的OpenAI GPT-5.5在三项任务上的准确率分别为59.3%、33.3%、28.3%，Claude Sonnet 5的准确率分别为53.3%、18.7%、7.3%，所有最终直接运行结果均无格式错误。由30名参与者组成的人类基线在60个测试样本上的表现超过所有模型，三项任务平均准确率分别达80.8%、68.8%、64.3%。可见推导分析识别出图像状态重建与推理流程中反复出现的典型错误。本文还配套发布了StateSight-Steps数据集，包含900个交错排列的图文样例与3600个确定性中间视觉状态。实验结果表明，格式合法的模型输出可能掩盖其无法恢复可验证视觉推理所需空间结构的缺陷。

title: Decoupled Vision-Language System for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
title_zh: 面向多模态理解与生成的解耦视觉语言系统
authors: Yifan Xu, Baochen Xiong, Xiaoshan Yang, Donglin Di, Yaowei Wang, Changsheng Xu
abstract: We introduce a new architecture design for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Libra, capable of both multimodal understanding and generation. Libra architecture contains one vision system and one language system, connected by cross-modal bridges. This design decouples self-modal modeling and cross-modal interaction, enabling each modality to learn its unique representations while maintaining effective cross-modal comprehension. The decoupling is mainly achieved in a switch attention module and a switch FFN module, which dynamically routes the computation flow for self-modal modeling and cross-modal interaction scenarios. We evaluate the effectiveness in two important settings: \textbf{Libra-1} for the understanding-only image-to-text setting, and \textbf{Libra-2} for unified image-to-text understanding and text-to-image generation. In addition to the architecture design, we discuss various improvements on tokenization, positional encoding, and supervision. Experiments demonstrate that the dedicated Libra design enables mutual improvements on multimodal understanding and generation, achieving strong performance on both understanding and generation benchmarks.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向多模态大语言模型(MLLM)的全新架构设计Libra，可同时支持多模态理解与生成任务。Libra架构由1个视觉系统与1个语言系统构成，二者通过跨模态桥接模块连接。该设计将单模态建模与跨模态交互过程解耦，使每个模态在学习自身独有表征的同时保持高效的跨模态理解能力。解耦操作主要通过切换注意力模块与切换前馈网络(switch FFN)模块实现，两个模块可针对单模态建模与跨模态交互场景动态路由计算流。本文在两类重要设置下验证了架构的有效性：面向纯理解类图像到文本任务的Libra-1，以及统一图像到文本理解、文本到图像生成任务的Libra-2。除架构设计外，本文还讨论了分词、位置编码、监督策略层面的多项改进方案。实验表明，Libra的专属设计可实现多模态理解与生成任务的双向性能提升，在两类任务的基准测试集上均取得了优异表现。

title: Mining beyond Earth with Space Robots: Exploration, Sampling, and Extraction
title_zh: 借助空间机器人开展地外采矿：探测、采样与提取
authors: Dong Li, Dujun Nie, Xiaotong Zhang, Ruilin Wang, Yuchen Li, Chang Ge, Chao Xiong, Kaichang Di, Andreas N\"uchter, Levente Kov\'acs, Qingquan Li, Shirong Ge, Fei-Yue Wang, Long Chen
abstract: Space resource acquisition and utilization, commonly referred to as Space Mining, represent critical pathways for enabling sustained human exploration and unlocking commercial opportunities in space. These resources mainly include helium-3, water, mineral resources on the Moon and Mars, and abundant mineral deposits on asteroids. Due to the harsh conditions of space, communication delays, and high launch costs, the development of autonomous robotic systems is critical to achieving efficient, cost-effective space mining. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of space mining robotics and associated technologies. First, we review the background of space mining, including international policies, commercial entities, and recent advancements. We define a systematic six-stage architecture for space mining: Exploration is initiated by (1) remote sensing for target identification and (2) precise in situ robotic detection; Sampling progresses from (3) single-robot small-scale sampling to (4) multi-robot large-scale excavation; and Extraction integrates (5) autonomous resource extraction and (6) final integration into in situ construction or terrestrial transport. Additionally, we review and curate existing resources for space mining research, including real-world mission data, terrestrial analog datasets, and high-fidelity simulation environments. Finally, we identify critical open challenges in autonomous space mining and delineate a strategic research roadmap to bridge current technological gaps, fostering the transition toward a sustainable off-world economy. To track ongoing developments in space mining, we maintain an updated project page: https://github.com/OpenSpace-Lab/Space-Mining-with-Robotics-List.
summary_zh: 空间资源获取与利用（通常称为太空采矿）是支撑人类长期深空探索、释放太空商业价值的核心路径，可开采资源主要包括月球与火星上的氦-3、水、矿产资源，以及小行星上的丰富矿藏。由于太空环境恶劣、通信延迟高、发射成本高昂，自主机器人系统是实现高效低成本太空采矿的核心支撑。本文对太空采矿机器人及相关技术进行了全面综述：首先梳理了太空采矿的发展背景，涵盖国际政策、商业主体与最新研究进展，定义了系统化的六阶段太空采矿架构：探测阶段包含(1)用于目标识别的遥感探测、(2)机器人精准原位检测；采样阶段包含(3)单机器人小规模采样、(4)多机器人大规模开挖；提取阶段包含(5)资源自主提取、(6)最终集成至原位建造或运回地球。此外，本文整理汇总了太空采矿研究的现有开源资源，包括真实任务数据、地面模拟数据集、高保真仿真环境，最后明确了自主太空采矿领域尚未解决的关键挑战，提出了可填补当前技术缺口的战略研究路线图，将推动可持续地外经济的发展。项目主页：https://github.com/OpenSpace-Lab/Space-Mining-with-Robotics-List。

title: ViTacPhys: Physical Property-Aware Grasping from Human Visual-Tactile Demonstrations
title_zh: ViTacPhys：基于人类视觉-触觉演示的具备物理属性感知能力的抓取方法
authors: Yiwen Liu, Yujun Zhu, Kui Jia, Zhao Liao, Yangwei You, Shuaijun Wang
abstract: Recent vision-based action models have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex manipulation, but they rarely leverage explicit object physical properties to adapt their policies. We introduce ViTacPhys, a visual-tactile framework and data acquisition system that estimates object mass and friction-coefficient classes, together with continuous stiffness, from human manipulation demonstrations. Trained on data from 60 rigid and deformable objects, ViTacPhys combines temporal visual-tactile modeling, cross-attention multimodal fusion, and a semantic prior derived from a vision-language model. On seen objects, it achieves 97.2% mass classification accuracy, 98.8% friction-coefficient classification accuracy, and a stiffness mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 5.51%. On held-out objects from known categories, it achieves 87.5% mass accuracy, 97.5% friction-coefficient accuracy, and a stiffness MAPE of 9.08%. We transfer ViTacPhys from the human domain to the robot domain using limited robot teleoperation data, robot-style video augmentation, and human demonstrations with matched actions, and deploy it as an online module for adaptive grasping. The resulting physical-property-conditioned policy achieves total grasping success rates of 95.0% on in-distribution objects and 83.4% on out-of-distribution objects. For out-of-distribution objects successfully grasped by both methods, its force profiles are more consistent with human teleoperation than those produced by ACT. These results demonstrate the feasibility of explicitly estimating and conditioning on object physical properties for real-world adaptive grasping.
summary_zh: 现有基于视觉的动作模型在复杂操作任务中表现优异，但很少利用显式的物体物理属性来调整自身策略。本文提出ViTacPhys，一个视觉-触觉框架与数据采集系统，可从人类操作演示中估计物体的质量类别、摩擦系数类别以及连续刚度值。ViTacPhys在60个刚性与可变形物体的数据集上训练，融合时序视觉-触觉建模、跨注意力多模态融合，以及从视觉语言模型中提取的语义先验。在见过的物体上，其质量分类准确率达97.2%，摩擦系数分类准确率达98.8%，刚度平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)为5.51%；在已知类别内的未见过物体上，其质量分类准确率达87.5%，摩擦系数分类准确率达97.5%，刚度MAPE为9.08%。本文利用少量机器人遥操作数据、机器人风格数据增强、动作匹配的人类演示数据，将ViTacPhys从人类域迁移到机器人域，作为在线模块部署以实现自适应抓取。最终得到的基于物理属性条件的策略在分布内物体上的总抓取成功率为95.0%，在分布外物体上为83.4%。对于两种方法均成功抓取的分布外物体，该策略输出的力曲线比ACT模型输出的结果更符合人类遥操作的力特征，证明了显式估计物体物理属性并将其作为策略条件的方案在真实场景自适应抓取任务中具备可行性。

title: NeSAM: Neuro-Symbolic Kinodynamics with Soil Adaptation for Off-Road Mobility
title_zh: 面向凸集图上施泰纳旅行商问题的统一分支定界搜索
authors: Chenhui Pan, Tong Xu, Francesco Cancelliere, Xuesu Xiao
abstract: Accurate prediction of off-road vehicle motion over deformable terrain remains challenging because sinkage, slip, and traction vary with local soil conditions. Existing learning-based kinodynamic models directly approximate vehicle-terrain interactions from data but do not explicitly represent soil mechanics and offer limited physical interpretability. To address these limitations, we present NeSAM, a neuro-symbolic framework that combines differentiable Bekker-Wong terramechanics with learned terrain representations and a Transformer-based residual dynamics model for long-horizon, six degree-of-freedom kinodynamic prediction. The terramechanics component models soil-dependent interaction forces, while the residual model corrects discrepancies between the analytical prediction and the observed vehicle dynamics. NeSAM further estimates physically meaningful soil parameters from terrain observations and updates them online using an extended Kalman filter. We evaluate NeSAM in Verti-Bench, a simulator built on the Chrono multiphysics engine, and validate its performance on a physical Verti-4-Wheeler platform. NeSAM improves prediction accuracy by up to 30% in simulation and 29% on real-world data relative to the strongest compared baselines. When integrated with a close-loop navigation controller, NeSAM further improves traversal success rate through online soil adaptation while reduces Hausdorff distance to the reference trajectory by 69.4%, indicating improved trajectory tracking accuracy.
summary_zh: 本文形式化定义了凸集图(GCS)上的施泰纳旅行商问题(Steiner-TSP)，该问题目标是找到一条经过所有必需凸集的最小代价闭合轨迹，允许经过可选的中转顶点与重复访问节点。为探索该问题的无限解空间，本文提出一种基于有向游走前缀的统一分支定界搜索方法：可加下界图成本为已确定的前缀路径提供代价上界，割分离连通流松弛为访问所有剩余目标并返回根节点的剩余代价提供下界。在统一正代价假设下，最佳优先遍历可在无初始可行解的所有可行实例上经过有限次扩展后终止，深度优先遍历在获得有限初始可行解后也可实现有限次扩展终止。对于用户指定的参数$\epsilon\geq1$，全局下界可保证两种搜索策略得到的可行解代价最多为全局最优值的$\epsilon$倍。本文进一步在移动机械臂检测任务中验证了方法可同时实现传感模式、访问顺序与连续轨迹的联合选择，支持采用有限迹线性时序逻辑(LTL$_f$)表达的动作优先级约束。两种遍历策略均可在30秒内找到所有基准实例的可行解，平均可证明最优间隙分别为28.1%与29.7%，而近年提出的两个基线方法仅能在约一半的实例上成功求解。

title: Unified Branch-and-Bound Search for the Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem on Graphs of Convex Sets
authors: Jingtao Tang, Hang Ma
abstract: We formalize the Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem (Steiner-TSP) on Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS), which seeks a minimum-cost closed trajectory through required convex sets while allowing optional transit vertices and revisits. To explore the resulting infinite solution space, we propose a unified branch-and-bound search over rooted walk prefixes. Additive lower-bound-graph costs bound committed prefixes, while a cut-separated connected-flow relaxation lower-bounds the residual cost of visiting every remaining target and returning to the root. Under a uniform positive-cost assumption, best-first traversal terminates after finitely many expansions on every feasible instance without an initial incumbent, whereas depth-first traversal does so once a finite incumbent is available. For a user-specified factor $\epsilon\geq1$, a global lower bound certifies that either strategy's incumbent cost is at most $\epsilon$ times the global optimum. We further demonstrate joint sensing-mode, visitation-order, and continuous-trajectory selection for a mobile-manipulator inspection task, including action precedences expressed in linear temporal logic over finite traces (LTL$_f$). Both traversal strategies find feasible solutions on all benchmark instances within 30s with mean certified optimality gaps of 28.1% and 29.7%, respectively, whereas two recent baselines succeed on only about half of the instances

title: Beyond Imitation: Self-Improving Robot Policies via Off-Policy Q-Planning
title_zh: 超越模仿：基于离策略Q规划的自改进机器人策略
authors: Varun Giridhar, Anant Khandelwal, Jeremy A. Collins, Ignat Georgiev, Animesh Garg
abstract: Behaviour Cloning (BC) has driven remarkable progress in robot manipulation, yet it is fundamentally limited by its inability to self-improve: a policy that fails cannot learn from that failure without additional human demonstrations. Reinforcement Learning fine-tuning offers a path to self-improvement but has proven difficult to scale to the multi-billion-parameter models underpinning modern robot policies. We propose Q-Planning, which equips a large visuomotor BC policy with a small off-policy Q-function. Because a Q-function estimates value rather than imitates actions, it can be trained on the same successful demonstrations as the BC policy and later absorb both successful and failed deployment rollouts, an asymmetry BC does not have. We exploit this asymmetry to enable value-guided action selection at inference (a single-step Q-weighted average over BC draws) and online self-improvement that fine-tunes only the Q-function, leaving the BC weights untouched. On LIBERO and bimanual RoboTwin, ten iterations of self-improvement lift every benchmark score we tested (LIBERO-10 93% to 99%, RoboTwin 83.8% to 91.4%) and shorten successful episodes on the near-ceiling suites (LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal). On two contact-rich bimanual real-robot tasks, the same loop (BC frozen, no human intervention) improves purely from its own deployment rollouts: stack-cups 40% to 90% and insert-wallet 25% to 80% in five iterations, whereas SFT on successful rollouts alone stalls at 55% and 30%. Under an identical online budget Q-Planning is the only method, among Best-of-N, filtered SFT, IBRL, DSRL, and DAWR, that improves stably from failures without training an auxiliary actor.
summary_zh: 行为克隆(BC)推动了机器人操作领域的显著进展，但该方法存在无法自改进的本质缺陷：策略执行失败后，若没有额外的人类演示，就无法从失败中学习。强化学习微调可实现自改进，但难以扩展到支撑现代机器人策略的数十亿参数大模型。本文提出Q-Planning（Q规划）方法，为大的视觉运动行为克隆策略配备一个小型离策略Q函数。由于Q函数估计动作价值而非直接模仿动作，它既可以在行为克隆策略使用的成功演示数据集上训练，也可以后续吸收部署过程中产生的成功与失败样本，这是行为克隆不具备的特性。本文利用该特性在推理阶段实现价值引导的动作选择（对行为克隆输出的动作进行单步Q加权平均），以及仅微调Q函数、冻结行为克隆权重的在线自改进流程。在LIBERO与双臂RoboTwin数据集上，10次自改进迭代后所有测试基准的性能均得到提升：LIBERO-10的成功率从93%提升至99%，RoboTwin的成功率从83.8%提升至91.4%，同时缩短了接近性能上限的任务套件（LIBERO-Object、LIBERO-Goal）的成功执行片段长度。在两个高接触双臂真实机器人任务中，相同的自改进循环（冻结行为克隆权重、无人类干预）仅利用自身部署的样本实现性能提升：堆叠杯子任务的成功率从40%提升至90%，钱包插入任务的成功率从25%提升至80%，而仅使用成功样本进行监督微调(SFT)的方法性能分别停滞在55%与30%。在相同的在线计算预算下，对比Best-of-N、过滤SFT、IBRL、DSRL、DAWR方法，Q-Planning是唯一无需训练额外辅助Actor即可从失败样本中稳定实现性能提升的方法。

title: SRL-MPC: Shape-Aware Reinforcement Learned Model Predictive Control
title_zh: SRL-MPC：具备形状感知能力的强化学习模型预测控制
authors: Ruihua Han, Rui Gao, Zhe Liu, Xinyi Wang, Chang Chen, Shuai Wang, Qi Hao, Jia Pan, Hengshuang Zhao
abstract: Safe and efficient shape-aware navigation in heterogeneous crowds and robot fleets remains challenging. Traditional approaches often assume homogeneous robots, sparse workspaces, simplified geometry, offline computation, or handcrafted parameters to make the problem tractable, which limits their deployment in dense crowd scenarios. Toward this end, we propose Shape-Aware Reinforcement Learned Model Predictive Control (SRL-MPC), a method for safe, efficient, and adaptive navigation in crowds with heterogeneous shapes without geometry simplification. To encode shape-aware safety, we formulate high-order control barrier function (HOCBF) constraints from geometric separation features (GSFs) based on support function transformation. A reinforcement learning (RL) framework then learns a neural policy that reads GSFs and outputs real-time MPC parameter updates, enabling the MPC solver to adapt to neighboring crowd geometries. The key advantage of SRL-MPC is that it preserves the safety structure and generalizability of MPC while integrating the adaptability and intelligence of RL. Experiments in randomized crowd scenarios with arbitrary shaped robot fleets demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and robustness of SRL-MPC. The results show that SRL-MPC substantially outperforms representative baselines in safety and adaptability. Project website: https://hanruihua.github.io/srl_mpc_project/
summary_zh: 在异质人群与机器人群体中实现安全高效的形状感知导航是一项极具挑战性的任务。传统方法通常假设机器人是同质的、工作空间稀疏、几何模型简化、支持离线计算或使用人工设计参数来降低问题求解难度，限制了其在密集人群场景中的部署。针对该问题，本文提出形状感知强化学习模型预测控制(SRL-MPC)，无需简化几何模型即可在具备异质形状的群体环境中实现安全、高效、自适应导航。为编码形状感知安全约束，本文基于支撑函数变换从几何分离特征(GSF)构造高阶控制屏障函数(HOCBF)约束，随后通过强化学习(RL)框架训练神经网络策略，输入为几何分离特征，输出为实时模型预测控制(MPC)参数更新值，使MPC求解器可自适应邻近群体的几何特征。SRL-MPC的核心优势是在保留MPC方法的安全结构与泛化性的同时，融合了强化学习的自适应能力与智能性。在任意形状机器人群体的随机人群场景中开展的实验验证了SRL-MPC的有效性、可扩展性与鲁棒性，结果表明其在安全性与自适应性方面显著优于代表性基线方法。项目主页：https://hanruihua.github.io/srl_mpc_project/。

title: Teaching is a Process: The TOSS Framework for Modeling Human Teaching Decisions in Human-Interactive Robot Learning
title_zh: 教学是一个过程：面向人机交互机器人学习中人类教学决策建模的TOSS框架
authors: Bernhard Hilpert, Kim Baraka, Joost Broekens
abstract: Successful Human-Robot Teaching assumes alignment between robot processing needs and human teaching intent. To better understand this alignment, this work seeks to uncover the underlying logic that humans intuitively apply when teaching. Through an exploratory, bottom-up study with N=34, participants observing two distinct robot Reinforcement Learning (RL) scenarios, we analyze 204 intuitive teaching responses across early, middle, and late learning phases. Results reveal that teaching decisions consist of a nuanced, interconnected network of Triggers (situational catalysts), Objectives (subjective teaching targets), Signals (communicative acts), and Strategies (high-level governance) in which teachers spontaneously adopt diverse roles, acting as coaches, engineers, or designers and prioritize different objectives. Based on these results, we introduce the TOSS Framework, which conceptualizes Human-Robot teaching as a procedural loop between robot behavior and human teaching actions, in which human teaching decisions are modeled as Trigger-Signal responses modulated by teaching Objectives and Strategies. It provides future research with an openly accessible dataset and a theoretical foundation for a) understanding teaching decisions and b) simulating realistic oracles as well as c) designing human-centered teaching settings and novel robot learning algorithms that go beyond the constraints of current robot learning settings.
summary_zh: 高效的人机机器人教学要求机器人的处理需求与人类的教学意图对齐。为深入理解该对齐机制，本文探索人类在教学过程中直觉遵循的底层逻辑。通过对34名参与者开展自下而上的探索性研究，参与者观察两类不同的机器人强化学习(RL)场景，本文分析了学习早期、中期、后期三个阶段共204个直觉教学响应。结果表明，教学决策由相互关联的复杂网络构成，包含触发点（场景催化剂）、目标（主观教学目标）、信号（交互行为）与策略（高层治理规则）四类要素，教学者会自发承担教练、工程师、设计师等不同角色，动态调整优先级目标。基于上述结果，本文提出TOSS框架，将人机机器人教学建模为机器人行为与人类教学动作之间的过程循环，其中人类教学决策被建模为受教学目标与策略调制的触发-信号响应。该框架为后续研究提供了公开数据集与理论基础，可用于：a)理解人类教学决策逻辑，b)模拟真实的教学真值生成器，c)设计以人为本的教学场景与突破现有机器人学习范式限制的新型机器人学习算法。

title: FF-MPCC: High-speed Agile Formation Flight with Model Predictive Contouring Control
title_zh: FF-MPCC：基于模型预测轮廓控制的高速敏捷编队飞行
authors: Aditya Dandwate, Vit Kratky, Parakh M. Gupta, Martin Saska, Robert Penicka
abstract: Flying in a prescribed formation in an agile manner remains a challenging problem in the field of UAVs, particularly when following highly-demanding trajectories that require flight at platform limits. We address this problem by proposing a novel decentralized approach to formation flight along a given path that integrates formation maintenance into the MPCC framework, allowing UAVs to adapt their progression along complex paths while respecting individual dynamic constraints and maintaining the desired formation. To this end, we introduce a novel reparametrization and synchronization method for dynamic formation geometries together with a decentralized approach to determine the desired positions for the individual UAVs. The proposed approach allows the formation to coordinate high-speed path following without compromising formation integrity. The proposed approach is validated through extensive simulation and real-world experiments involving scenarios with varying complexity of paths and changes of required formation shape on the fly. In comparison to time-parameterized trajectory tracking, we demonstrate improved formation maintenance by 65% in high-speed flight with velocities up to 21 m/s, while achieving comparable times required to reach the goal.
summary_zh: 以敏捷方式沿指定编队构型飞行是无人机领域的挑战性难题，尤其在需要逼近平台极限飞行的高要求轨迹跟踪场景下难度进一步提升。本文针对该问题提出一种新型分布式编队飞行方法，可沿给定路径将编队维持功能集成至MPCC（模型预测轮廓控制）框架中，使无人机在适配复杂路径上的前进进度时，既满足个体动力学约束，又能维持期望编队构型。为此，本文提出面向动态编队几何的全新重参数化与同步方法，以及用于确定各无人机期望位置的分布式策略。所提方法可在不破坏编队完整性的前提下实现高速路径跟踪协同。本文通过大量仿真与真实场景实验对方法进行验证，实验覆盖不同路径复杂度、飞行过程中动态切换编队构型的各类场景。与时间参数化轨迹跟踪方法相比，所提方法在最高速度达21m/s的高速飞行场景下编队维持性能提升65%，同时抵达目标的耗时与对比方法相当。

title: TaPeR: Probabilistic Recovery of Sparse Task Precedence Graphs from a Handful of Demonstrations
title_zh: TaPeR：基于少量演示样本的稀疏任务优先图概率恢复方法
authors: Adrian R\"ofer, Karla Stepanova, Abhinav Valada
abstract: Long-horizon manipulation tasks are often only partially ordered. For example, when assembling an electronic device, the battery and circuit board may be installed in either order, but both must be in place before the enclosure is closed. Recovering such dependencies enables robots to flexibly reorder subtasks while preserving task validity. Existing approaches typically infer task structure from human demonstrations using both temporal and symbolic supervision. However, symbolic predicates require explicit grounding, which is difficult to obtain in realistic settings. In this work, we present an approach for extracting task dependency structures from demonstrations using only simple kinematic graphs and distributions over relative object poses. From these representations, our method estimates pairwise task-step-dependency probabilities and uses them to initialize the edge weights of a precedence graph. We then introduce a filtering pipeline that converts this graph of probability estimates into the final task dependency graph. We evaluate our approach on an existing benchmark and on a new dataset comprising longer tasks with more complex dependencies. We find that our method recovers more accurate task structures from fewer demonstrations than the baselines. Finally, we demonstrate that the inferred graphs can be used to generate multiple valid robotic execution orders for the same task.
summary_zh: 长时序操作任务通常仅存在部分顺序约束，例如组装电子设备时，电池与电路板的安装顺序可互换，但二者必须在闭合外壳前完成。恢复这类依赖关系可让机器人在保证任务有效性的前提下灵活调整子任务顺序。现有方法通常结合时序监督与符号监督从人类演示中推断任务结构，但符号谓词需要显式锚定，在真实场景中难以获取。本文提出一种仅基于简单运动学图与相对物体位姿分布从演示中提取任务依赖结构的方法，该方法从上述表征中估计两两任务步骤的依赖概率，用于初始化优先图的边权重，随后引入过滤流水线将概率估计图转换为最终的任务依赖图。本文在现有基准数据集与新增的长时序高复杂度依赖任务数据集上对方法进行评估，结果表明所提方法相比基线方法可通过更少的演示样本恢复出精度更高的任务结构，最终验证了推断得到的优先图可为同一任务生成多个合法的机器人执行顺序。

title: Roadside-Cooperative Autonomous Driving: From Data Platform to Vision-Language End-to-End Reasoning
title_zh: 路侧协同自动驾驶：从数据平台到视觉语言端到端推理
authors: Yitao Xu, Tong Wu, Yiyan Wu, Guoji Xu, Yanbo Jiang, Jiahao Wang, Zehong Ke, Junkai Jiang, Fang Zhang, Jianqiang Wang
abstract: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) cooperation enables beyond-line-of-sight perception, mitigating occlusions in single-vehicle sensing.
