It performs on par with previous TTT and hybrid attention baselines in language modeling while outperforming them on in-context retrieval. Its advantage is most pronounced in length extrapolation: on the standard ``Needle in a Haystack'' passkey test, it retains over 90% accuracy at $8\times$ the training context length. Meanwhile, E$^2$-TTT can match the training throughput of efficient chunk-wise methods, demonstrating that it effectively reconciles expressivity with efficiency. The code is available at https://github.com/zeyun-zhong/E2-TTT.
summary_zh: 测试时训练（TTT）通过推理阶段的持续权重更新实现长上下文处理，但现有方法很难平衡逐token更新动态的表达能力与分块近似方案的硬件效率。本文提出E²-TTT（Expressive and Efficient TTT，高表达高效测试时训练）框架填补该领域空白。在采用分块起始权重计算梯度的标准近似条件下，本文推导出闭式状态转移公式，可精确复现逐token递归过程在分块结束时的快速权重和动量状态，在完全保留更新规则时间结构的前提下实现分块层面的全并行训练，而该时间结构是此前分块级方法会丢弃的核心信息。本文通过从零训练最高13亿参数的模型完成E²-TTT的有效性验证：在语言建模任务上，E²-TTT的性能与此前的TTT和混合注意力基线相当，而在上下文检索任务上的表现显著优于基线方法；其优势在长度外推场景下最为突出，在标准的“大海捞针”密钥测试中，当上下文长度达到训练上下文长度的8倍时，E²-TTT仍可保持90%以上的准确率。同时E²-TTT的训练吞吐量可与高效分块级方法持平，证明该框架有效实现了表达能力与运行效率的平衡。相关代码已开源至https://github.com/zeyun-zhong/E2-TTT。

title: SPARCL: Spectral Partitioned Analytic Continual Learning
title_zh: SPARCL（谱分区解析式持续学习）：谱分区解析式持续学习框架
authors: James Hartley, Zeropy Surio, Daniel Whitmore, Hannah Clarke, Thomas Reed
abstract: Analytic continual learning has emerged as a strong exemplar-free alternative to gradient-based class-incremental learning because it replaces iterative optimization with closed-form ridge updates. Yet the usual forgetting narrative, centered on stochastic gradient overwriting, does not explain why analytic methods still drift on old classes despite exact recursive solvers. We identify the culprit as spectral interference: the joint ridge classifier for all tasks shares the inverse autocorrelation operator $(R+\lambda I)^{-1}$, so incoming task samples that load onto old dominant eigendirections dilute the spectrum and perturb old-class logits even when old labels are never revisited. Based on this view, we propose SPARCL, a spectral partitioned analytic continual learner that decomposes the running autocorrelation into a high-energy core and a residual complement, freezes old-class classifier components in the core subspace, and updates only the residual block through recursive least squares with an optional residual random-projection expansion. This yields a simple closed-form update with a provable invariance guarantee for the core contribution of old logits. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-A under a frozen ViT-B/16 protocol, SPARCL closes most of the gap from classical analytic learners to strong representation matchers, while remaining complementary to sparse feature-decorrelation approaches such as Fly-CL.
summary_zh: 解析式持续学习作为无需样本回放的类增量学习方案，近年来表现出远超基于梯度的方法的性能，其核心优势是用闭式岭回归更新替代了迭代优化流程。但传统持续学习领域围绕随机梯度覆盖导致的遗忘的叙事，无法解释为什么即便采用精确递归求解器，解析式持续学习方法仍然会在旧类别上出现性能漂移。本文将该问题的根源识别为谱干扰现象：所有任务共享的联合岭分类器共用自相关逆算子(R+λI)⁻¹，因此新任务样本在旧类别主导特征方向上的投影会稀释原有频谱，即便完全不重新访问旧类别标签，也会扰动旧类别的对数输出。基于该发现，本文提出SPARCL谱分区解析式持续学习框架，该框架将运行中的自相关矩阵分解为高能量核心子空间和残差补空间，冻结核心子空间内的旧类别分类器分量，仅通过带可选残差随机投影扩展的递归最小二乘算法更新残差块，最终得到的简单闭式更新可从理论上保证旧类别对数输出的核心贡献保持不变。在冻结ViT-B/16骨干网络的实验协议下，本文在CIFAR-100、CUB-200、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A四个数据集上完成验证，结果表明SPARCL大幅缩小了传统解析式持续学习方法与强表征匹配方法之间的性能差距，同时可与Fly-CL等稀疏特征解耦类方法形成互补。

title: ConceptTS: LLM-Guided Concept Bottlenecks for Interpretable Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
title_zh: ConceptTS：大语言模型引导的概念瓶颈可解释多变量时间序列预测
authors: Yichen Jiang, Yueqiao Chen, Dongyu Liu
abstract: State-of-the-art multivariate time-series forecasters can model complex temporal and cross-variable dependencies, yet their opaque representations provide limited insight into why a particular forecast is produced. This lack of transparency restricts their use in settings where practitioners must understand and assess the factors underlying a prediction. We introduce ConceptTS, an interpretable forecasting framework that organizes its predictions around named, human-readable concepts. ConceptTS uses a large language model to propose task-relevant concepts and generate executable labeling rules, translating the language model's domain knowledge into direct supervision without costly manual concept annotation. The proposed concepts are organized into three complementary bottlenecks that describe the historical context, local forecast intervals, and the full forecast horizon. A shared decoder combines representations derived from their predicted activations to construct the forecast, making the model's decision process explicit and supporting direct concept-level interventions. Experiments on the Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality dataset show that ConceptTS achieves accuracy competitive with strong black-box baselines while producing semantically meaningful concept activations.
summary_zh: 当前最先进的多变量时间序列预测模型能够建模复杂的时间依赖关系与跨变量依赖关系，但其不透明的表征难以解释特定预测结果的生成逻辑。这种透明度缺失限制了这类模型在需要从业者理解、评估预测背后影响因素的场景中的应用。本文提出ConceptTS，一种可解释预测框架，围绕命名化、人类可读的概念组织预测逻辑。ConceptTS利用大语言模型提出与任务相关的概念并生成可执行的标注规则，无需成本高昂的人工概念标注，即可将大语言模型的领域知识转化为直接监督。所提出的概念被组织为三个互补的瓶颈模块，分别描述历史上下文、局部预测区间与完整预测时域。共享解码器融合从概念预测激活中得到的表征以生成预测结果，使模型的决策过程显式化，支持直接的概念层面干预。在北京多站点空气质量数据集上开展的实验表明，ConceptTS的预测精度可与性能优异的黑盒基线模型相竞争，同时能够生成语义明确的概念激活值。

title: The Exceedance Design Effect: Effective Sample Size for Thresholds under Clustering
title_zh: 超限设计效应：聚类场景下阈值的有效样本量
authors: Adam Noonan
abstract: Three consequences follow. The correction now used in the conformal literature is the wrong quantity, and can miss in either direction. A dataset has no single effective sample size. It has one for each level the threshold is set at. And the damage is invisible in coverage averaged over many runs, and fully felt by whoever deploys once. On a released calibration set of 25,028 examples, we measure the reliability of about 1,300.
summary_zh: 本研究得到三项结论：当前共形预测领域使用的校正量是错误的，可能在两个方向上出现偏差；数据集不存在单一的有效样本量，针对每一个设定的阈值水平都对应一个专属的有效样本量；该偏差在多次运行的平均覆盖率中不可见，仅会在单次部署时完全暴露给使用者。在包含25028个样本的公开校准集上，我们对约1300种场景的可靠性进行了度量。

title: TRACE-C: Rank-Calibrated Relational Anomaly Detection for Multi-Stream Operational Telemetry
title_zh: TRACE-C：面向多流运行遥测的秩校准关系异常检测
authors: Matthew Faucher
abstract: Three interpretive limits carry throughout. The resulting p-values are selection quantities, not event probabilities. The copula-form channel is not a literal copula density: the method applies no probability-integral or normal-score transform. Empirical rank counts are diagnostics, not coverage or false-discovery proofs. Every table and figure in this paper is generated from committed machine-readable reports.
summary_zh: 本研究全程遵循三项解释性约束：生成的p值属于选择统计量，而非事件概率；Copula形式通道并非严格意义上的Copula密度，该方法未执行概率积分变换或正态得分变换；经验秩计数属于诊断指标，而非覆盖率或错误发现率的证明依据。本文中的所有表格与插图均由已提交的机器可读报告生成。

title: Advanced Linear Algebra with Applications - Part I (Numerical linear algebra for PDEs, machine learning, and data assimilation)
title_zh: 高等线性代数及其应用 第一部分（偏微分方程、机器学习与数据同化领域的数值线性代数）
authors: Victorita Dolean, Jemima Tabeart
abstract: These lecture notes form the first part of a master's-level course on advanced numerical linear algebra. Their aim is not only to present the classical algorithms, but to show why the subject has become considerably more central than it was a generation ago. Numerical linear algebra grew up alongside the numerical solution of partial differential equations, and for a long time that is where its large sparse systems came from. Ranking the nodes of a network, assimilating observations into a weather forecast, and fitting a model to a large noisy data set now lead to problems of the same kind: too large to factorise, structured, and accessible only through matrix-vector products. Strikingly few ideas are needed for all of them. Each chapter therefore develops a standard topic and then puts it to work outside its original setting. We treat norms, factorisations, conditioning and floating-point arithmetic; sparse matrices arising from finite differences, from graphs and from machine learning; stationary iterations and the smoothing property; the conjugate gradient and Lanczos methods, with spectral clustering and regularisation by early stopping; Arnoldi and GMRES, with PageRank and large least squares; and finally preconditioning, Schwarz domain decomposition and multigrid. We assume a first course in linear algebra. Every section closes with a summary of what should be retained and every chapter with exercises, several drawn from past examinations. Accompanying Python code reproduces the numerical illustrations.
summary_zh: 本讲义构成硕士级高等数值线性代数课程的第一部分，其目标不仅是介绍经典算法，更要阐明该学科的核心地位相比上一代得到显著提升的原因。数值线性代数随偏微分方程数值解法同步发展，长期以来其处理的大型稀疏系统均来源于偏微分方程场景。如今网络节点排序、观测值同化到天气预报流程、为含噪大数据集拟合模型等任务也催生了同类问题：规模过大无法直接分解、具备结构化特性、仅能通过矩阵向量乘积实现访问。值得注意的是，所有这类问题所需的核心思想数量极少。因此每一章都会先讲解标准主题，再将其应用到原始场景之外的领域。本文覆盖的内容包括：范数、矩阵分解、条件数与浮点运算；由有限差分、图结构与机器学习衍生的稀疏矩阵；静态迭代法与平滑性质；共轭梯度法与Lanczos方法，以及对应的谱聚类、早停正则化应用；Arnoldi方法与GMRES（广义最小残差法），以及对应的PageRank、大型最小二乘问题应用；最后介绍预处理技术、Schwarz区域分解法与多重网格法。本文要求读者已修完线性代数入门课程。每一节末尾均总结需掌握的核心内容，每一章末尾配备习题，其中多道习题选自过往考试。配套Python代码可复现所有数值示例。

title: Event-triggered Implicit Perturbation for Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of Spiking Transformers
title_zh: Tydra：面向表格数据的高效混合模型
authors: Tengteng Lei, Prabodh Katti, Rashi Dutt, Houssem Sifaou, Tan Peng, Osvaldo Simeone, Kai Xu, Bipin Rajendran
abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization estimates gradients using only forward-pass evaluations, making it suitable for fine-tuning non-differentiable, event-driven spiking neural networks (SNNs). However, its deployment on in-memory computing (IMC) accelerators is constrained by the repeated read-modify-write (RMW) operations arising from explicit weight perturbation and the prohibitive hardware footprint of random number generators (RNGs) for statistically independent per-weight perturbations. To address these challenges, we propose an implicit-perturbation ZO (IPZO) architecture in which perturbation sums computed by an event-triggered perturbation generation unit (PGU) are combined with the weighted sums produced by the IMC array, eliminating perturbation-induced RMW operations while preserving weight-stationary execution of IMC. By exploiting spike sparsity, the PGU generates and accumulates perturbation contributions only for spike-activated weight rows, reducing the required row dimension of the RNG array. An address-driven XOR recombination scheme (PGU-XOR) is further introduced to mitigate the spatial correlations caused by direct RNG reuse (PGU-Reuse). The results show that (1) PGU-XOR matches software RNGs in accuracy on Spikingformer/CIFAR-10 (76.41% vs. 76.53%) and perplexity (PPL) on SpikeGPT/WikiText-2 (54.20 vs. 53.23), whereas PGU-Reuse degrades accuracy by 9.56 percentage points and increases PPL by 11.8; (2) implemented in a TSMC 16-nm CMOS technology, PGU-XOR incurs 40.3%-46.0% area and 15.2%-48.9% energy overhead per matrix-vector multiplication relative to PGU-Reuse, yet its faster convergence reduces the total perturbation energy to 0.51x that of PGU-Reuse at iso-accuracy; (3) IPZO reduces the perturbation energy to 0.46x-0.83x that of conventional explicit weight perturbation for a batch size of B=64 and T=4 time steps, with the advantage growing as BT decreases.
summary_zh: 基于Transformer的表格基础模型（如TabPFN）具备优异的预测性能，但计算复杂度随上下文长度呈二次方增长。另一方面，基于次二次复杂度SSM（状态空间模型）的替代方案如Hydra为了效率牺牲了精度。为平衡性能与效率，本文提出Tydra，一种面向表格上下文学习的Transformer-SSM混合架构，将注意力层与状态空间模型层交错排布。在30个OpenML数据集上的测试结果显示，相较于TabPFN，Tydra的推理耗时降低30%，同时保留了绝大多数预测性能。Tydra的表现也优于参数量约为其10倍的Hydra模型，同时推理速度更快。实验结果表明，混合架构是表格基础模型的极具前景的发展方向。

title: Tydra: An Efficient Hybrid Model for Tabular Data
authors: Mieszko Komisarczyk, Saurabh Mathur, Maurice Kraus, Sriraam Natarajan, Kristian Kersting
abstract: Transformer-based tabular foundation models such as TabPFN achieve strong predictive performance but incur quadratic computational cost with context length. On the other hand, subquadratic SSM-based alternatives such as Hydra trade away accuracy for efficiency. To balance both, we introduce Tydra, a hybrid Transformer-State Space Model (SSM) architecture for tabular in-context learning that interleaves attention and SSM layers. Across 30 OpenML datasets, Tydra reduces inference time by 30% relative to TabPFN while retaining much of its predictive performance. Tydra also outperforms an approximately ten-times-larger Hydra model while providing faster inference. The results indicate that hybrid architectures are a promising direction for tabular foundation models.

title: A Neurosymbolic Approach for Constructing Planning Domain Models from Clinical Narratives
title_zh: 从临床叙事中构建规划域模型的神经符号方法
authors: Ranveer Singh, Saurabh Mathur, Michael Skinner, Prasad Tadepalli, Kristian Kersting, Sriraam Natarajan
abstract: Surgical procedures such as laparoscopic appendectomy are complex, high-stakes processes, yet formalizing their workflows for decision support remains a significant challenge. Inducing probabilistic planning domain models in this setting is particularly difficult due to the lack of structured event data and the prevalence of implicit actions in clinical narratives, which neither empirical symbolic methods nor Large Language Models (LLMs) can adequately address on their own. We introduce NSPIN, a neurosymbolic framework for inducing probabilistic planning domain models from unstructured clinical narratives. Our method extracts and imputes structured event sequences from raw text using a pretrained LLM, then induces a PPDDL model and refines its preconditions with LLM-proposed revisions, guided by empirical validation. We evaluate the approach on 2,660 laparoscopic appendectomy notes written by 9 surgeons. NSPIN yields models that generalize to unseen notes, and expert clinical review indicates its induced knowledge is largely consistent with surgical practice.
summary_zh: 腹腔镜阑尾切除术等外科手术是复杂的高风险流程，然而将其工作流形式化以支撑决策仍然是一项重大挑战。由于结构化事件数据匮乏、临床叙事中普遍存在隐式动作，在该场景下诱导概率规划域模型的难度极大，经验符号方法与大语言模型（LLM）均无法独立妥善解决该问题。本文提出NSPIN，一种从非结构化临床叙事中诱导概率规划域模型的神经符号框架。该方法利用预训练大语言模型从原始文本中提取并补全结构化事件序列，随后诱导生成PPDDL（概率规划域定义语言）模型，结合经验验证的引导，通过大语言模型提出的修订方案优化模型的前提条件。我们基于9名外科医生撰写的2660份腹腔镜阑尾切除术病历对该方法进行评估，结果显示NSPIN生成的模型可泛化至未见过的病历，临床专家评审表明其诱导得到的知识与外科临床实践高度一致。

title: Thermo-FL: Thermal-Aware Robust Federated Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models for Edge AI
title_zh: Thermo-FL：面向边缘AI的热感知鲁棒大语言模型联邦微调
authors: Shiva Shrestha, Kazi Shaharair Sharif, Zongxing Xie, Jiajing Huang, Anhao Xiang, Honghui Xu
abstract: Federated fine-tuning enables large language models to adapt on edge devices without centralizing private data, but practical deployments must address hardware instability and adversarial update corruption together. Thermally constrained clients may throttle, slow local training, or delay synchronous aggregation, while Byzantine clients and communication-layer adversaries can corrupt the updates used to form the global model. To address these challenges, we present Thermo-FL, a thermal-aware federated LoRA fine-tuning framework that uses device temperature as an active control signal for local adapter training and sparse update transmission. On the client side, Thermo-FL adjusts the active LoRA-layer fraction and transmitted update density as devices heat or cool, reducing workload under thermal stress. On the server side, Thermo-FL introduces TERRA, a robust aggregation pipeline for dynamically sparse LoRA updates that combines norm filtering, mask-aware directional validation, adaptive active-coordinate clipping, and mask-aware aggregation. We evaluate Thermo-FL using both a large-scale emulator and a Jetson-based physical testbed. In the emulator, Thermo-FL improves robustness under adversarial sparse aggregation and achieves the strongest BoolQ accuracy across clean and attack settings while remaining competitive on GSM8K. In the physical prototype, Thermo-FL stabilizes device temperature, reduces compressed upload size through bitmap sparse encoding, and preserves GSM8K utility under sign-flip/scale and MITM perturbations. These results show that secure edge LLM adaptation should jointly consider hardware behavior, workload regulation, sparse communication, and aggregation robustness.
summary_zh: 联邦微调可使大语言模型在边缘设备上完成适配，无需集中收集私有数据，但实际部署需要同时解决硬件不稳定与对抗性更新篡改两类问题。受温度约束的客户端可能出现降频、本地训练速度减慢或同步聚合延迟等问题，而拜占庭客户端与通信层敌手则可能篡改用于构建全局模型的更新数据。为应对上述挑战，本文提出Thermo-FL，一种热感知的联邦LoRA（低秩适配）微调框架，将设备温度作为主动控制信号，用于本地适配器训练与稀疏更新传输。在客户端侧，Thermo-FL会随设备温度升降调整活跃LoRA层占比与传输更新的密度，在热应力状态下降低工作负载。在服务器侧，Thermo-FL提出TERRA，一种面向动态稀疏LoRA更新的鲁棒聚合流水线，融合范数过滤、掩码感知方向验证、自适应活跃坐标裁剪与掩码感知聚合多项技术。我们基于大规模仿真器与搭载Jetson的物理测试床对Thermo-FL进行评估。仿真实验结果显示，Thermo-FL在对抗性稀疏聚合场景下鲁棒性显著提升，在干净与攻击场景下均取得最优的BoolQ精度，同时在GSM8K数据集上的表现也具备竞争力。在物理原型测试中，Thermo-FL可稳定设备温度，通过位图稀疏编码减小压缩上传体积，在符号翻转/缩放与中间人扰动场景下仍可保留GSM8K任务的性能。上述结果表明，安全的边缘大语言模型适配需要同时兼顾硬件行为、工作负载调控、稀疏通信与聚合鲁棒性。

title: Capturing Cardiac Cyclicity through Phase-Equivariant Self-Supervised Learning
title_zh: 通过相位等变自监督学习捕获心脏周期性
authors: Blaise Delaney, Dominic Dootson, Juan Jose Juan Castella, Salil Patel, Andrew Pfaff, Yuji Xing, Jonny Hancox, Karin Sevegnani
abstract: The cyclic structure of physiological processes offers a natural prior for self-supervised representation learning, and the cardiac cycle provides a particularly well-defined setting in which to exploit it. We derive a phase-equivariant self-supervised objective and introduce Winder, a joint-embedding architecture that organises representations into phase-invariant coordinates and phase-rotating harmonic subspaces. Its transport operator is fixed and closed-form, derived from the cycle's geometry rather than learned, and adds no parameters. Evaluated on PTB-XL under a frozen linear-probe protocol, Winder attains diagnostic accuracy within the range reported by state-of-the-art self-supervised methods at a ~1 M parameter footprint, while exhibiting phase-equivariant latent geometry. These findings demonstrate that explicitly encoding cardiac-phase symmetry can preserve diagnostically useful information while yielding a latent geometry that is legible, parameter-efficient, and directly tied to a measurable physiological quantity.
summary_zh: 生理过程的循环结构为自监督表征学习提供了天然先验，而心动周期是其中定义极为清晰的可利用场景。本文推导了相位等变自监督目标，提出Winder，一种联合嵌入架构，可将表征组织为相位不变坐标与相位旋转谐波子空间。其传输算子为固定的闭式解，由循环几何推导得到而非通过学习得到，不会引入额外参数。在PTB-XL数据集上采用冻结线性探针协议开展评估，Winder仅需约100万参数量即可达到当前最先进自监督方法报道的诊断精度区间，同时具备相位等变的潜在几何特性。上述结果表明，显式编码心脏相位对称性可在保留诊断相关有效信息的同时，生成具备可读性、参数高效、直接关联可测生理指标的潜在空间几何结构。

title: COEC: Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation for Structured Pruning of Large Language Models
title_zh: COEC：面向大语言模型结构化剪枝的校准正交等价补偿
authors: Peiqi Yu, Nam Ling, Wei Wang, Wei Jiang
abstract: Structured pruning reduces the size and inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by removing weight columns, but the resulting output error can degrade accuracy. Existing training-free compensation methods use an additive bias or a single orthogonal rotation on the output side of the retained weight. These corrections leave its input singular frame unchanged and therefore limit how the retained weight can adapt after column removal. We propose COEC (Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation), a training-free compensation framework that applies alternating left and right orthogonal rotations to the retained weight. The right rotation is optimized on a reduced Stiefel manifold, while singular values are rescaled using generalized cross-validation to select the regularization strength for each layer. COEC further tempers the calibration Gram matrix to reduce the dominance of high-energy activation directions and introduces an alignment penalty that preserves the geometric relation between adjacent attention projections.All components use second-order statistics from a small calibration set and require neither backpropagation through the LLM nor retraining of the model parameters. COEC is independent of the column pruning criterion and can be applied to multiple structured pruning methods. Experiments on the Llama-3, Llama-3.1, and Qwen2.5 model families across multiple structured sparsity levels show that COEC improves perplexity on every model and zero-shot accuracy in most settings over existing compensation methods, with larger gains at higher sparsity. These results show that post-pruning compensation can recover part of the performance lost to column removal.
summary_zh: 结构化剪枝通过移除权重列降低大语言模型（LLM）的规模与推理成本，但该操作带来的输出误差会降低模型精度。现有无训练补偿方法在保留权重的输出侧使用加性偏置或单次正交旋转，这类校正操作不会改变输入奇异框架，因此限制了权重列移除后保留权重的自适应空间。本文提出COEC（Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation，校准正交等价补偿），一种无训练补偿框架，对保留权重交替执行左正交旋转与右正交旋转。右旋转在约化Stiefel流形上优化，同时利用广义交叉验证重新缩放奇异值，为每一层选择正则化强度。COEC进一步对校准Gram矩阵进行平滑处理，降低高能量激活方向的主导性，同时引入对齐惩罚项，保留相邻注意力投影之间的几何关系。所有组件均使用来自小型校准集的二阶统计量，既不需要通过大语言模型执行反向传播，也不需要重新训练模型参数。COEC与列剪枝准则无关，可应用于多种结构化剪枝方法。在Llama-3、Llama-3.1与Qwen2.5系列模型上针对多种结构化稀疏度的实验结果表明，相较于现有补偿方法，COEC在所有模型上均可降低困惑度，在大多数场景下可提升零样本精度，且稀疏度越高性能提升越显著。上述结果表明，剪枝后补偿可部分恢复因权重列移除损失的性能。

title: BackDFL: A Unified Benchmark For Backdoor Attacks and Defenses In Decentralized Federated Learning
title_zh: BackDFL：去中心化联邦学习后门攻击与防御的统一基准测试平台
authors: Mouhamed Amine Bouchiha, Gregory Blanc, Yufei Han
abstract: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) promises trust-free collaborative learning by replacing the centralized parameter server with peer-to-peer model exchange. However, this architectural shift fundamentally reshapes the threat landscape. Without globally coordinated aggregation, DFL becomes particularly susceptible to backdoor attacks, in which malicious participants implant persistent hidden behaviors while maintaining high clean-task performance. In this paper, we argue that the robustness of DFL has been significantly overestimated. Existing studies rely on simplified threat models, non-adaptive adversaries, fragmented evaluation protocols, inconsistent communication topologies, and ad hoc training configurations, leading to an incomplete understanding of DFL security. To address these limitations, we present BackDFL, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating DFL under realistic and adaptive backdoor attacks. Through extensive experiments, BackDFL exposes critical failure modes of decentralized learning. Our results demonstrate that both state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust DFL methods and adapted FL backdoor defenses fail under modest malicious participation rates (as low as 15%), especially in heterogeneous settings, while their robustness varies substantially across communication graph topologies.
summary_zh: 去中心化联邦学习（Decentralized Federated Learning, DFL）通过用点对点模型交换替代中心化参数服务器，有望实现无需信任的协同学习。但这种架构转变从根本上重塑了威胁格局：在缺乏全局协调聚合机制的情况下，DFL尤其容易受到后门攻击，恶意参与方可在保持较高干净任务性能的前提下植入持久的隐藏行为。本文指出，现有研究严重高估了DFL的鲁棒性：相关工作依赖简化的威胁模型、非自适应敌手、碎片化的评估协议、不一致的通信拓扑以及特设的训练配置，导致学界对DFL安全性的认知并不完整。为解决上述局限，本文提出BackDFL这一统一基准，可在真实、自适应的后门攻击场景下系统性评估DFL的安全性能。大量实验结果表明，BackDFL暴露了去中心化学习的关键失效模式：当前最优的拜占庭鲁棒DFL方法、以及经过改造的联邦学习后门防御方案，在恶意参与率仅为15%的场景下就会失效，在异构设置下表现尤为明显，且不同通信图拓扑下的鲁棒性差异极大。

title: FlatLand: Personalized Graph Federated Learning via Tailored Lorentz Space
title_zh: FlatLand：基于定制洛伦兹空间的个性化图联邦学习方法
authors: Jiahong Liu, Ram Samarth B B, Xinyu Fu, Menglin Yang, Weixi Zhang, Rex Ying, Irwin King
abstract: Federated learning enables privacy-preserving collaborative training, but highly heterogeneous client data remain challenging, especially in graph federated learning where clients possess structurally diverse graphs. Existing personalized federated learning (PFL) methods ignore the intrinsic geometric properties of diverse graph structures. We propose FlatLand, a novel personalized federated learning method that embeds different clients' data in tailored Lorentz space of hyperbolic geometry. Our key insight is that hyperbolic geometry naturally accommodates the intrinsic negative curvature prevalent in real-world graphs, while the time-like dimension in Lorentz space provides a principled way to encode client-specific heterogeneity. We develop a parameter decoupling strategy that separates heterogeneous information (captured in time-like parameters) from common knowledge (preserved in space-like parameters), enabling direct aggregation without requiring client similarity estimation and extra calculation modules. Empirical results on diverse federated graph learning tasks demonstrate that FlatLand achieves superior performance, particularly in low-dimensional settings.
summary_zh: 联邦学习可实现隐私保护下的协同训练，但客户端数据高度异构的问题始终存在挑战，在客户端持有结构多样图数据的图联邦学习场景下尤为突出。现有个性化联邦学习（Personalized Federated Learning, PFL）方法忽略了不同图结构的内在几何属性。本文提出FlatLand这一新型个性化联邦学习方法，将不同客户端的数据嵌入双曲几何下的定制洛伦兹空间中。核心思路是：双曲几何天然适配真实世界图中普遍存在的内在负曲率特性，而洛伦兹空间中的类时维度提供了一种可编码客户端特有异质性的原则性方案。本文进一步设计了参数解耦策略，将异质性信息（由类时参数捕获）与公共知识（由类空参数保留）分离，无需进行客户端相似度估计、也无需额外计算模块即可实现直接聚合。在多个不同的联邦图学习任务上的实验结果表明，FlatLand的性能表现优异，在低维设置下优势尤为显著。

title: Causal Modeling of Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes via Adaptive LLM Proposals
title_zh: 基于自适应大语言模型提议的不良妊娠结局因果建模
authors: Kavimayil P. Komarasamy, Saurabh Mathur, Ameet Soni, David M. Haas, Kristian Kersting, Sriraam Natarajan
abstract: Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes (APOs) such as preterm birth and gestational diabetes can have long-term consequences for both the mother and child, yet an understanding of their causes remains elusive. Causal discovery in this domain is especially challenging due to a paucity of data and incomplete domain knowledge. As a result, pure data-driven methods fail, and Large Language Model (LLM) outputs remain inconsistent or contradictory. We introduce a neurosymbolic framework for generating plausible causal hypotheses that iteratively combines the broad prior knowledge of LLMs with empirical scoring on data. Our method treats the LLM as an adaptive proposal distribution, generating hypotheses that are scored against empirical data; the resulting high-scoring graphs are then used to update the LLM's context, steering subsequent generations toward more promising regions of the hypothesis space. We evaluate our approach on a real-world clinical dataset for modeling APOs and their risk factors, comparing our results against an expert-constructed causal graph. Our method recovers all expert-validated edges and identifies additional plausible causal relations not previously listed by experts, potentially providing new insights for targeted interventions.
summary_zh: 早产、妊娠糖尿病等不良妊娠结局（Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes, APOs）会对母体和胎儿造成长期影响，但目前学界对其致病原因的认知仍十分有限。受数据稀缺、领域知识不完备的限制，该领域的因果发现任务极具挑战性：纯数据驱动方法效果不佳，大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的输出也往往存在不一致甚至矛盾的问题。本文提出一种神经符号框架，可迭代结合大语言模型的广泛先验知识与基于数据的经验评分，生成合理的因果假设。该方法将大语言模型作为自适应提议分布，生成假设后基于经验数据对其评分，再将高分因果图用于更新大语言模型的上下文，引导后续生成过程向假设空间中更有前景的区域收敛。本文在用于建模APOs及其风险因素的真实临床数据集上对所提方法进行评估，并将结果与专家构建的因果图进行对比。实验结果表明，该方法不仅可以还原所有经过专家验证的因果边，还识别出了此前未被专家列出的其他合理因果关系，有望为针对性干预提供新的研究思路。

title: AudioWorldSim: Realistic Binaural Audio Datasets For World Models
title_zh: AudioWorldSim：面向世界模型的真实双耳音频数据集开源平台
authors: Luis Vitor Zerkowski, Luiz Velho
abstract: This technical report presents AudioWorldSim, an open-source platform designed to generate realistic binaural audio datasets and advance research in audio-based machine learning, particularly world models. Built as a custom extension of Meta's SoundSpaces 2.0 platform, AudioWorldSim leverages their comprehensive acoustics framework, but focuses on the automatic rollout of random agent navigations, as well as implements crucial fixes to how continuous sound is composed. AudioWorldSim is made publicly available to the research community at https://github.com/Luizerko/AudioWorldSim to facilitate reproducibility.
summary_zh: 本技术报告介绍了AudioWorldSim这一开源平台，其设计目标是生成真实的双耳音频数据集，推动音频相关机器学习尤其是世界模型方向的研究。AudioWorldSim是Meta平台SoundSpaces 2.0的自定义扩展版本，在沿用其完整声学框架的基础上，重点实现了智能体随机导航轨迹的自动推演功能，同时修复了连续音频合成过程中的关键缺陷。目前AudioWorldSim已向研究社区公开，开源地址为https://github.com/Luizerko/AudioWorldSim，以保障研究可复现性。

title: Designing a Robust LLM-Based Evaluation System for Agentic AI in Drug Discovery Through Human Alignment
title_zh: 通过人类对齐构建面向药物发现领域智能体AI的鲁棒大语言模型评估系统
authors: Emma Granqvist, Roc\'io Mercado, Samuel Genheden
abstract: Agentic large language model (LLM) systems are reshaping scientific workflows in chemistry and drug discovery, but evaluating their open-ended, tool-augmented outputs remains a fundamental bottleneck. Reference-based metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE fail to capture semantic correctness, while expert human evaluation does not scale to the iteration speed these systems demand. The LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm has emerged as a scalable alternative, but existing drug discovery benchmarks deploy LLM judges without validating their alignment with human experts. In this work, we present an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation framework for ChatInvent, an agentic drug discovery assistant deployed at AstraZeneca, with four contributions. First, we define four output-quality evaluation dimensions---Completeness, Relevancy, Structural Clarity, and Scope Adherence---alongside deterministic Tool Call Correctness checks. Second, we validate the judge through a human alignment study with five expert annotators, comparing Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5, and Llama 3.1 70B as candidate judges. Third, we optimize the best-performing judge using few-shot demonstrations of human-annotated examples, improving alignment with the human majority vote from 0.80 to 0.86. Fourth, applying the optimized judge to 70 held-out questions, we surface concrete limitations and find that informal phrasings do not systematically degrade output quality; if anything, it is helpful to have the LLM rewrite the original question before querying the agent. Our framework provides a reusable template for human-aligned evaluation of agentic systems in scientific domains.
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的智能体系统正在重塑化学与药物发现领域的科研工作流，但对这类系统生成的开放式、工具增强型输出进行评估始终是核心瓶颈问题。BLEU、ROUGE等基于参考文本的指标无法捕捉输出的语义正确性，而人工专家评估的效率又无法匹配这类系统的高速迭代需求。大模型即裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge）范式是可扩展评估的替代方案，但现有药物发现基准在部署大模型裁判时，并未验证其与人类专家判断的对齐程度。本文针对阿斯利康部署的智能体药物发现助手ChatInvent，提出了一套大模型即裁判评估框架，主要贡献包括四点：第一，定义了完整性、相关性、结构清晰度、范围合规性四大输出质量评估维度，同时配套了确定性的工具调用正确性校验机制；第二，通过包含5名专家标注者的人类对齐研究对裁判模型进行验证，对比了Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5和Llama 3.1 70B等候选裁判的表现；第三，使用人工标注样本的少样本演示对表现最优的裁判模型进行优化，将其与人类多数投票结果的对齐度从0.80提升至0.86；第四，将优化后的裁判模型应用于70道预留测试题，总结出了具体的系统局限性，同时发现非正式表述并不会系统性降低输出质量，反而先让大语言模型重写原始问题再向智能体发起查询，有助于提升输出效果。本文提出的框架为科学领域智能体系统的人类对齐评估提供了可复用的通用模板。

title: RODE: A Radial-Orthogonal Decoupled Engine for Optimization
title_zh: 面向生成式推荐：从静态多级小语义码本到动态单级大语义码本
authors: Guoxiang Xu, Bince Qu, Qi Sun, Cheng Zhuo
abstract: Modern neural network training increasingly uses matrix-aware optimizers, yet their conditioned matrix step is typically added directly to the weight, jointly changing its norm and direction. This interaction matters because the current norm determines angular motion, while directional learning can drive norm growth and thereby alter later steps. We introduce RODE, which gives the radial and directional components separate update rules and step sizes. RODE explicitly updates the matrix Frobenius norm through a scalar radial rule, while its directional channel performs Newton--Schulz-conditioned updates in the tangent space. Controlled GPT-2 interventions show gains from both direct norm control and RODE's directional update. Across two language-modeling and two image-classification tasks, RODE outperforms both Muon variants in every direct comparison and ends with lower full-model norms. At 1.5B scale, using the learning rate transferred directly from the Qwen2-style LM sweep, RODE lowers loss from 4.145 to 3.346 and final global norm from 11964 to 2183 relative to Muon RMS, with fixed-radius RODE improving further. For Qwen3.5-9B full-parameter fine-tuning, all six optimizers use the same tuning budget and the same formal-training and evaluation settings; RODE outperforms both Muon variants on all four evaluation tasks and attains the highest mean on GSM8K and MATH-500. Thus, decoupling radial and directional dynamics offers a more effective and controllable approach to matrix optimization.
summary_zh: 生成式推荐将每个物品表示为离散语义ID（Semantic ID, SID）序列，通过预测该序列检索下一个推荐物品。现有典型系统普遍采用多级残差量化方案，不仅提升了自回归解码的成本，还会生成大量层级空间，导致空间分布稀疏。同时静态码本会随着新物品上线、曝光分布变化，逐渐与当前流量特征失配。本文提出一种单级大语义码本，用单个语义令牌替代多个残差语义码，同时保留独立的协作消歧令牌以减少物品冲突。进一步提出基于时序权重衰减、指数移动平均中心更新、SID变更曝光加权惩罚的曝光感知动态更新机制。本文还开发了覆盖表征质量、码本利用率、集群负载、全SID冲突率、时序稳定性的离线评估框架。在两个公开数据集上的实验结果表明，相比基线方案，采用两级SID的OneRec-V1的平均Recall@10提升5.0%~8.8%，平均NDCG@10提升4.1%~5.1%；OneRec-V2的平均Recall@10提升7.1%~8.7%，平均NDCG@10提升3.8%~8.5%。动态更新机制在KuaiRec数据集上可进一步提升性能。在三种不同的服务架构下，更短的SID可将自回归解码的预估浮点运算量降低47.93%~48.70%，单卡每秒查询率提升28.57%~47.0%。覆盖2.5%生产流量的5天在线A/B测试结果显示，该方案可将核心消费指标提升0.792%。

title: From a Static Multi-Level Small Semantic Codebook to a Dynamic Single-Level Large Semantic Codebook for Generative Recommendation
authors: Tianlu Xie, Xin Ku, Mingjie Sun, Yunhao Sha, Lixiang Wang, Peng Wang, Yiyu Wang, Wenjin Wu, Zhaojie Liu, Peng Jiang, Wenwu Ou
abstract: Generative recommendation represents each item with a sequence of discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and predicts the sequence to retrieve the next item. Typical systems use multi-level residual quantization, which increases autoregressive decoding cost and creates a large hierarchical space that may be sparsely occupied. Static codebooks also become misaligned with current traffic as new items arrive and exposure distributions change. We propose a single-level large semantic codebook that replaces multiple residual semantic codes with one semantic token while retaining a separate collaborative disambiguation token to reduce item collisions. We further introduce an exposure-aware dynamic update mechanism based on temporal weight decay, exponential moving-average center updates, and an exposure-weighted penalty on SID changes. We also develop an offline evaluation framework covering representation quality, code utilization, cluster load, full-SID collision, and temporal stability. On two public datasets, the two-level SID improves mean Recall@10 by 5.0%-8.8% and mean NDCG@10 by 4.1%-5.1% for OneRec-V1, and by 7.1%-8.7% and 3.8%-8.5%, respectively, for OneRec-V2. Dynamic updating provides further gains on KuaiRec. Across three serving architectures, the shorter SID reduces estimated autoregressive-decoding FLOPs by 47.93%-48.70% and increases single-card QPS by 28.57%-47.0%. A five-day online A/B test serving 2.5% of production traffic improves the primary consumption metric by 0.792%.

title: Free-Probability Kernels for Zero-Rollout Hyperparameter Selection in Reservoir Computing
title_zh: 面向储备池计算零推演超参数选择的自由概率核方法
authors: Sara Malacarne, Andrea Ceni, Claudio Gallicchio
abstract: Reservoir computing (RC) couples a fixed recurrent dynamical system with a trained lightweight readout, but this efficiency is partly lost during hyperparameter selection: the recurrent gain, input scale, and leakage rate determine the reservoir's stability and temporal processing regime and are usually tuned through many rollouts. We introduce a deterministic, pilot-informed selector for leaky linear reservoirs followed by coordinate-wise nonlinear features. Free probability yields cross-lag propagation coefficients that summarize how the reservoir mixes past inputs. In the large-width limit, these coefficients define a deterministic temporal kernel that approximates the finite-reservoir feature geometry. Kernel ridge regression on a short labelled pilot sequence therefore ranks candidate operating regimes without instantiating or rolling out a reservoir, and the selected configuration transfers across widths. Across ten synthetic temporal benchmarks, zero-rollout selection obtains a mean deployment score of $0.772$, compared with $0.774$ for exhaustive simulation-based search, while avoiding $156\,600$ selection rollouts. With a small rollout budget, the proposed ranking provides the strongest mean performance at every tested budget and reaches the exhaustive reference using $4.8\%$ of its rollout cost. On four public electricity-transformer-temperature (ETT) forecasting datasets, five retained candidates recover the exhaustive operating point on three datasets. On multivariate cellular-traffic forecasting, 15 rollouts per cell reach the 462-rollout exhaustive reference and outperform random search and Bayesian optimization at low budgets. These results position free-probability kernels as deterministic surrogates for selecting reservoir operating regimes when validation rollouts are scarce.
summary_zh: 储备池计算（Reservoir Computing, RC）将固定的递归动力系统与轻量化训练读出层相结合，但其高效性在超参数选择阶段会被部分抵消：递归增益、输入尺度、泄漏率等参数直接决定储备池的稳定性与时序处理模式，通常需要经过大量推演才能完成调优。本文针对带逐维非线性特征的泄漏线性储备池，提出了一种基于先导样本的确定性选择器。自由概率方法可生成跨滞后传播系数，用于汇总储备池对历史输入的混合效果。在储备池宽度趋近于无穷大的极限场景下，这些系数可定义出确定性时序核，用于近似有限储备池的特征几何结构。因此，在短标注先导序列上运行核岭回归即可对候选运行模式进行排序，无需实例化或推演储备池，且选出的配置可跨不同宽度迁移。在10个合成时序基准任务上，零推演选择方法的平均部署得分为0.772，与基于穷举仿真搜索的得分0.774几乎持平，同时避免了156600次选择推演。在推演预算有限的场景下，本文提出的排序方法在所有测试预算下的平均性能均为最优，仅需穷举搜索4.8%的推演成本即可达到穷举搜索的参考性能。在4个公开电力变压器温度（ETT）预测数据集上，仅保留5个候选配置即可在其中3个数据集上还原穷举搜索得到的最优运行点。在多元蜂窝流量预测任务上，每小区仅需15次推演即可达到需要462次推演的穷举参考性能，在低预算场景下的表现优于随机搜索与贝叶斯优化。上述结果表明，在验证推演资源稀缺时，自由概率核可作为确定性代理方法完成储备池运行模式的选择。

title: Trojaning the Alignment: Stealthy Backdoor Attacks against Graph Foundation Models
title_zh: 对齐投毒：针对图基础模型的隐蔽后门攻击
authors: Minhua Lin, Zhicheng Gao, Yilong Wang, Hanqing Lu, Xiang Zhang, Suhang Wang
abstract: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) align graph representations with language semantics to support transferable graph learning. Despite these advantages, the backdoor vulnerability of GFMs on TAGs remains insufficiently understood, especially under graph-language alignment, where graph and text representations are trained to constrain each other in a shared semantic space. Existing backdoor attacks mainly target either the graph side or the text side, treating the two modalities independently. This makes direct adaptation ineffective: graph-only triggers can be constrained by clean text semantics, while text-only triggers alter the language view but do not directly shift the graph representation being aligned and scored. TAGs also impose a stealth challenge because triggers are exposed as both node text and local graph structure, making incoherent trigger attributes or anomalous subgraphs easy to inspect or filter. In this paper, we propose STAG, a stealthy trojan attack framework designed for the graph-language alignment interface of GFMs on TAGs. STAG coordinates a graph-trigger generator with a text-side soft prompt so that trigger-attached graph representations and triggered text representations move toward the same target-class text region. To address TAG-specific stealthiness, STAG realizes trigger nodes as readable text through candidate retrieval and regularizes the trigger-attached subgraph so that its local structure remains close to the original subgraph. Extensive experiments on multiple TAG datasets and representative GFMs demonstrate the effectiveness and stealthiness of STAG. Our code is available at https://github.com/ventr1c/STAG.
summary_zh: 面向带文本属性图（Text-Attributed Graph, TAG）的图基础模型（Graph Foundation Models, GFMs）可将图表征与语言语义对齐，支撑可迁移图学习任务。尽管优势显著，但目前学界对TAG上GFM的后门漏洞认知仍十分不足，尤其在图文对齐场景下，图表征与文本表征会在共享语义空间中互相约束。现有后门攻击大多仅针对图侧或文本侧，将两种模态视为独立对象，直接迁移这类攻击的效果很差：仅在图侧植入触发器会被干净文本语义约束，仅在文本侧植入软提示会改变语言视图，但无法直接偏移正在对齐打分的图表征。同时TAG场景下的攻击隐蔽性要求更高，触发器会同时暴露为节点文本与局部图结构，属性不一致的触发器或异常子图很容易被检测过滤。本文提出STAG这一专为TAG上GFM的图文对齐接口设计的隐蔽木马攻击框架，STAG协同图触发器生成器与文本侧软提示，使植入触发器的图表征与触发后的文本表征向同一目标类的文本区域偏移。为满足TAG场景下的隐蔽性要求，STAG通过候选检索将触发节点的文本设置为可读内容，同时对植入触发器的子图施加正则约束，保证其局部结构与原始子图高度相似。在多个TAG数据集与代表性GFM上的大量实验验证了STAG的有效性与隐蔽性，相关代码已开源至https://github.com/ventr1c/STAG。

title: A Critical Audit of Spatiotemporal Forecasting Benchmark Datasets and Baselines
title_zh: 时空预测基准数据集与基线方法的批判性审计
authors: Kenneth Martin, Simon Heilig, Asja Fischer, Michel F. C. Haddad, Adam M. Sykulski, Moshe Eliasof
abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are routinely employed for short-range forecasting on multivariate time series with a spatial graph structure. Despite the availability of many alternative datasets, method innovations within this domain are predominantly assessed against a rather limited set of benchmark datasets, most notably Chickenpox, PedalMe, WikiMaths, METR-LA, and PEMS-BAY. The evaluation protocols contain baselines spanning from historical averages to classical machine learning approaches. These baselines often show competitive performance compared to GNNs. In the present work, we take a step back and analyse the benchmark datasets via classical time series methods to uncover why spatially-unaware linear models pose a stronger competitor than previously reported, casting further doubt on the discriminative reliability of the aforementioned widely adopted datasets. Our statistical analysis provides a toolset for identifying significant spatial and temporal correlations, while revealing a structural bias introduced by first-order differenced datasets. We therefore recommend reducing the over-reliance on such datasets for method comparison, and instead advocate for more rigorous statistical evaluation. By applying the results of our analysis to a simple hybrid model, we show how our methodology can lead to novel ways of developing GNN models
summary_zh: 图神经网络（Graph Neural Networks, GNN）已被广泛应用于带空间图结构的多元时间序列短程预测任务。尽管目前已有大量公开数据集，但该领域的方法创新大多仅在非常有限的基准数据集上进行评估，最常用的包括Chickenpox、PedalMe、WikiMaths、METR-LA和PEMS-BAY。现有评估协议中包含从历史均值到经典机器学习方法的各类基线，这些基线的表现往往与GNN相比具备很强的竞争力。本文退一步采用经典时序方法对上述基准数据集进行分析，揭示了不感知空间信息的线性模型性能远超此前报道的原因，进一步质疑了上述广泛使用数据集的判别可靠性。本文提出的统计分析工具集可识别显著的时空相关性，同时揭示了一阶差分数据集引入的结构性偏差。基于上述发现，本文建议降低对这类数据集的过度依赖，转而采用更严谨的统计评估方案。将本文分析结论应用于简单混合模型的实验结果表明，所提方法可为GNN模型开发提供全新的优化思路。

title: Training DeepFilterNet with Accurate Room Acoustic Simulations Improves Single-Channel Speech Enhancement
title_zh: 采用高精度房间声学模拟训练DeepFilterNet（深度滤波网络）可提升单通道语音增强性能
authors: Alessia Milo, Georg G\"otz, Steinar Gu{\dh}j\'onsson, Daniel Gert Nielsen, Jesper Pedersen, Finnur Pind
abstract: We investigate how the realism of synthetic room impulse response (RIR) datasets affects the training of DeepFilterNet3 for single-channel speech enhancement. We compare a DNS4 image-source-method (ISM) RIR dataset with a higher-acoustic-fidelity dataset generated using hybrid wave-based and geometrical acoustics simulation. Rather than isolating individual simulation factors, we compare complete RIR generation pipelines while keeping the enhancement model unchanged. Models are evaluated on unseen measured RIRs using objective speech enhancement metrics and downstream automatic speech recognition (ASR). Training with the higher-fidelity dataset consistently yields modest improvements in objective metrics and substantially lower ASR word error rates than the ISM dataset. Although the experiments do not attribute these gains to individual modelling components, they show that increasing the overall realism of synthetic acoustic training data improves the generalization of DeepFilterNet3 to unseen measured environments.
summary_zh: 本文研究合成房间脉冲响应（RIR）数据集的真实度如何影响面向单通道语音增强任务的DeepFilterNet3模型训练。我们对比了DNS4镜像源法（ISM）生成的RIR数据集，与采用混合波动声学+几何声学仿真生成的更高声学保真度数据集。研究未单独隔离各类仿真影响因子，而是在保持增强模型完全不变的前提下，对比了完整的RIR生成流水线效果。研究采用客观语音增强指标与下游自动语音识别（ASR）任务，在未见过的实测RIR数据集上完成模型评估。结果显示，与ISM数据集相比，采用更高保真度数据集训练得到的模型，不仅在各类客观指标上获得了稳定的小幅提升，更大幅降低了ASR任务的词错误率。尽管本实验无法将性能增益归因于单个建模组件，但结果表明，提升合成声学训练数据的整体真实度，可有效改善DeepFilterNet3在未见过的实测环境下的泛化能力。

title: Training, learning and inference: unified dynamics of neural systems
title_zh: 训练、学习与推理：神经系统的统一动力学
authors: Mian Wang
abstract: We define an atomic generation fact f=(u,tau,omega,z;rho), recording the origin, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, generated result and relation role. Compiled into a Generation-Fact Graph (GFG), these facts provide an AI-native, compilable scientific fact substrate preserving generation histories. We establish a GFG-based recursive scientific process in which analysis, intervention, replay and validation form facts for later cycles. Using nanoGPT, we establish unified training-learning dynamics. Training is the evolution of a parameter-optimizer system with state and memory: each actual training action enters the receiving state and produces a finite-amplitude nonlinear functional response conditioned by that state and target-specific update geometry. Learning is the persistent reorganization of distributed functional support by these responses; capability formation, maintenance, decline or recovery becomes observable when target-specific states are evaluated against their readout boundaries. Three primary coordinates - target-boundary state, target-specific update geometry and parameter-Adam receiving state - yield a second-order predictor operating before post-update outputs are read. On held-out runs, it achieved 91.43% accuracy and 91.49% macro-averaged recall across four transitions. We further establish inference as a frozen projection of training-learning dynamics. Component gating and rollback show causal recruitment and non-additive combination of query-conditioned support formed during training, deriving organizational conditions realized by Attention. Controlled feedback indicates possible double-edged reinforcement effects. ResNet/CIFAR-100 and diffusion/CIFAR-10 experiments confirm receiving-state-conditioned responses, persistent support reorganization and frozen inference projection beyond nanoGPT.
summary_zh: 本文定义了原子生成事实f=(u,τ,ω,z;ρ)，用于记录生成来源、已实现变换、具体发生过程、生成结果与关联角色。将这类事实编译为生成事实图（GFG）后，可得到面向人工智能原生、可编译的科学事实基底，完整保留生成历史。本文构建了基于GFG的递归科学流程，其中分析、干预、重放与验证环节生成的事实可供给后续循环使用。基于nanoGPT平台，我们建立了统一的训练-学习动力学框架：训练是具备状态与记忆的参数-优化器系统的演化过程，每一次实际训练动作都会进入接收状态，并生成由该状态与目标专属更新几何约束的有限幅非线性泛函响应；学习是上述响应持续重组分布式功能支撑的过程，当针对目标专属状态对照其读出边界进行评估时，能力的形成、维持、衰减或恢复过程均可被观测。基于目标边界状态、目标专属更新几何、参数-Adam接收状态三个核心坐标，我们构建了二阶预测器，可在读出更新后输出前完成预测。在留出集测试中，该预测器在四类转换任务上实现了91.43%的准确率与91.49%的宏平均召回率。本文进一步将推理定义为训练-学习动力学的冻结投影：组件门控与回滚机制展示了训练阶段形成的查询条件支撑的因果招募与非加性组合特性，推导得到注意力机制实现的组织条件；受控反馈实验验证了潜在的双向强化效应。在ResNet/CIFAR-100与扩散模型/CIFAR-10数据集上的实验，进一步证实了接收状态条件响应、持续支撑重组、冻结推理投影等特性在nanoGPT之外的场景下同样成立。

title: Nothing Changed but the Model: CellFill -- Bounded In-Cell Learning for Bit-Identical, Revocable Updates to Quantized LLMs
title_zh: 除模型外一切不变：CellFill（单元填充）——面向量化大语言模型比特一致、可撤销更新的有界单元内学习
authors: Zifeng Liu, Zhiyong Du, Yaxin Lu, Yiming Mao, Zhenhe Wang, Wenqi Shi, Zhengkun Jing
abstract: Exact invariance turns out to be nearly free: across three paired seeds the constrained dense path matches an unconstrained reference whose weights provably escape the artifact (58.9 vs 59.3 percent fact recall; paired difference -0.5 points, 95% CI [-5.0,+4.0]), and is better on held-out cross-domain perplexity. Against the natural null hypothesis -- serving the same update as an unmerged adapter -- projecting into the cells reduces cross-domain forgetting in every run that converged, and a diverged control shows the boundary: projection is a trust region, not a repair. What no method escapes is the cost of knowledge itself, and the apparent free lunch of in-domain perplexity improving past the anchor is an artifact of rehearsal sharing a corpus with the metric. Methods differ threefold at matched rehearsal in knowledge bought per point of cross-domain perplexity, a ranking that is not the recall ranking. The method transfers to a 27B hybrid linear-attention model (2.4e10 constrained weights, verified bit-identical), where matched recall costs about half as much cross-domain perplexity as at 1.7B.
summary_zh: 研究发现精确不变性的实现几乎无额外成本：在三组配对随机种子下，约束稠密路径的性能与无约束参考模型（其权重可证明脱离伪影影响）几乎持平，事实召回率分别为58.9%与59.3%，配对差值为-0.5个百分点，95%置信区间为[-5.0,+4.0]，且在留出集跨域困惑度指标上表现更优。针对自然零假设（即采用未合并适配器实现相同更新），将更新投影到单元内的方法在所有收敛运行中均降低了跨域遗忘率，而发散对照组明确了该边界特性：投影是信任域机制而非修复机制。所有方法都无法规避知识本身的成本，域内困惑度超过基准值提升的表面“免费午餐”效应，实际是重放过程与指标共享语料导致的伪影。在重放条件匹配的前提下，不同方法每提升单位跨域困惑度所获取的知识量存在三倍差异，该排序与召回率排序并不一致。本方法可迁移至27B混合线性注意力模型（2.4e10个约束权重，已验证比特一致性），在相同召回率下，其跨域困惑度成本仅为1.7B模型场景下的约一半。

title: Sharing the Control Authority Between Deep Reinforcement Learning and Model Predictive Control: Application to Multi-Class Transportation Networks
title_zh: 深度强化学习与模型预测控制的控制权共享机制：在多类型交通网络中的应用
authors: Giray Onur, Azita Dabiri, Bart De Schutter
abstract: Transportation networks, in particular multi-class transportation networks (i.e., networks with mixed vehicle types), are complex systems that are challenging to control. Recently, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), which learns control policies from interactions with the environment, and Model Predictive Control (MPC), which uses a system model to optimize control inputs, have been increasingly utilized for transportation network control. However, nonlinear system dynamics and high-dimensional state spaces in large-scale networks limit DRL's learning capacity under time-constrained training and increase MPC's computation time, hindering real-time implementation with limited computational resources. Moreover, MPC depends on an accurate network model, which is often unavailable for complex systems such as multi-class transportation networks. This paper proposes a novel DRL-MPC framework for multi-class transportation networks that divides control authority between DRL and MPC, combining DRL's fast online computation and model independence with MPC's built-in optimization and constraint-handling capabilities. In the hierarchical framework, MPC operates at the higher level and determines low-frequency control inputs whose slower update rate accommodates its high computation time, while DRL operates at the lower level and determines high-frequency control inputs using its fast online deployment. The framework is evaluated on a multi-class freeway network against a hierarchical MPC controller and a hybrid state-feedback-MPC controller, including scenarios with model mismatch and noisy traffic demands. Results show that the proposed framework outperforms the hybrid state-feedback-MPC controller, substantially reduces online computation time compared with the hierarchical MPC controller, and provides more effective constraint enforcement under model mismatch.
summary_zh: 交通网络尤其是多类型交通网络（即包含混合车辆类型的网络）属于复杂系统，控制难度极高。近年来，通过与环境交互学习控制策略的深度强化学习（DRL），以及利用系统模型优化控制输入的模型预测控制（MPC），在交通网络控制领域的应用日益广泛。但大规模网络中的非线性系统动力学与高维状态空间，既限制了时间约束训练下DRL的学习能力，也会提升MPC的计算耗时，导致在有限计算资源下难以落地实时部署。此外，MPC依赖精准的网络模型，而多类型交通网络这类复杂系统通常无法获取精准模型。本文提出一种面向多类型交通网络的新型DRL-MPC框架，在DRL与MPC之间划分控制权，融合了DRL在线计算速度快、无需依赖模型的优势，与MPC内置优化、处理约束能力强的特性。该分层框架中，MPC运行在高层级，负责确定更新频率低的控制输入，其较慢的更新速率可适配自身较高的计算耗时；DRL运行在低层级，依托快速在线部署能力确定高频控制输入。研究在多类型高速公路网络上，将该框架与分层MPC控制器、混合状态反馈-MPC控制器进行对比测试，覆盖模型失配、交通需求带噪声等场景。结果表明，所提框架性能优于混合状态反馈-MPC控制器，与分层MPC控制器相比大幅降低了在线计算耗时，且在模型失配场景下可实现更有效的约束执行。

title: SAC-Copula: Quality-Preserving Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models via Smooth Correlated Gumbel Fields
title_zh: SAC-Copula：基于平滑相关甘贝尔场的扩散语言模型保质量水印方法
authors: Baixin Li, Haiyun He
abstract: Watermarking diffusion language models (DLMs) requires mechanisms compatible with iterative parallel unmasking rather than autoregressive decoding. Existing sampling-based watermarking methods typically inject position-wise i.i.d. perturbations, which can be poorly aligned with DLM decoding dynamics and degrade generation quality. We propose SAC-Copula, a quality-preserving watermarking method for DLMs based on smooth, locally correlated Gumbel perturbation fields constructed via a Gaussian copula. We further develop a SAC-aware detector using covariance-aware filtering and native-sample calibration. Mechanism-level analysis shows that local correlation reduces latent perturbation roughness and better matches iterative refinement dynamics. Experiments on LLaDA show that SAC-Copula achieves a favorable quality-detectability trade-off compared with existing baselines. In particular, further evaluations on Dream-7B and additional datasets show that SAC-Copula substantially improves PPL tail stability over the i.i.d. Gumbel baseline, while maintaining strong low-FPR detectability and competitive overall generation quality. Additional token-edit stress tests further assess watermark robustness under controlled synchronization drift.
summary_zh: 面向扩散语言模型（DLM）的水印技术需要适配迭代并行去掩码机制，而非自回归解码机制。现有基于采样的水印方法通常注入逐点独立同分布扰动，这类扰动与DLM的解码动力学匹配度较差，会降低生成内容质量。本文提出SAC-Copula，一种面向DLM的保质量水印方法，基于通过高斯Copula构建的平滑、局部相关甘贝尔扰动场实现。本文进一步开发了基于协方差感知滤波与原生样本校准的SAC感知检测器。机制层面分析表明，局部相关性可降低潜在扰动的粗糙度，与迭代细化动力学的匹配度更高。在LLaDA数据集上的实验显示，与现有基线方法相比，SAC-Copula在生成质量与可检测性之间实现了更优的权衡。特别地，在Dream-7B模型与额外数据集上的评估结果表明，与独立同分布甘贝尔基线相比，SAC-Copula大幅提升了困惑度的尾部分布稳定性，同时保持了低误报率下的强检测能力与有竞争力的整体生成质量。额外的令牌编辑压力测试进一步验证了水印在受控同步漂移场景下的鲁棒性。

title: Fine-tuning LLMs for Tourist Trajectory Prediction using Field Experiment Data
title_zh: 基于实地实验数据微调大语言模型实现游客轨迹预测
authors: Tatsuya Amano, Hirozumi Yamaguchi
abstract: Evaluating mobility interventions at tourist destinations requires predicting visitor behavior under varying conditions. Traditional methods struggle because tourist decisions depend heavily on context like weather and fatigue, yet models cannot generalize to unobserved scenarios. Large Language Models offer a solution by encoding commonsense knowledge about human behavior from pretraining, enabling reasoning about context-dependent decisions, while natural language representation flexibly integrates heterogeneous information. Fine-tuning on local trajectories adapts this general understanding to destination-specific patterns. We validate this approach using 566 trajectories from Wakayama Castle Park, Japan. Our fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B achieves 49.1% next POI accuracy and maintains strong performance on undersampled scenarios like rainy days, demonstrating effective generalization. This establishes LLMs as high-fidelity behavior models for context-dependent tourist prediction, providing groundwork for counterfactual analysis of mobility interventions.
summary_zh: 评估旅游目的地的流动干预效果，需要预测不同场景下的游客行为。传统方法面临显著挑战：游客决策高度依赖天气、疲劳等上下文信息，现有模型难以泛化到未观测场景。大语言模型（LLM）提供了可行解决方案：其在预训练阶段编码了大量人类行为常识知识，具备上下文相关决策的推理能力，同时自然语言表示方式可灵活整合异质信息。基于本地轨迹数据微调，可将这类通用认知适配到目的地专属的行为模式。本文采用日本和歌山城公园采集的566条轨迹数据验证该方法，经微调的Llama-3.1-8B模型实现了49.1%的下一个兴趣点预测准确率，且在雨天这类低采样场景下仍保持优异性能，展现出良好的泛化能力。研究结果证明大语言模型可作为面向上下文相关游客预测的高保真行为模型，为后续流动干预的反事实分析提供了基础。

title: Resolution-Consistent Greedy Neural Approximation on Infinite-Dimensional Spaces
title_zh: 无限维空间上的分辨率一致贪心神经近似方法
authors: Pablo M. Bern\'a, Antonio Falc\'o, Diego Mond\'ejar
abstract: We develop constructive approximation and learning guarantees for shallow neural models with infinite-dimensional inputs observed through finitely many coordinates. The analysis is based on a parameter-normalized neural dictionary and its associated weighted variation class. Within this class, the approximation error separates into a distribution-dependent coordinate-truncation term and a greedy finite-width term. For empirical regression, a fully-corrective greedy procedure yields population guarantees whose statistical complexity is uniform in the retained input resolution. The same framework extends to Hilbert-valued responses without an explicit dependence on the output dimension. The dimension-free statements are statistical, not computational: selecting a new neuron still requires solving a nonconvex parameter-search problem. The quasi-Polish construction underlying recent infinite-dimensional universal approximation results provides a motivating example, and synthetic experiments illustrate the predicted resolution, width, and sample-size regimes.
summary_zh: 本文针对输入为无限维、仅通过有限个坐标观测的浅层神经模型，推导了构造性近似与学习保证。该分析基于参数归一化神经字典及其关联的加权变差类。在该类别下，近似误差可分解为依赖分布的坐标截断项与贪心有限宽度项两部分。针对经验回归任务，采用完全校正贪心流程可得到统计复杂度在保留输入分辨率上保持一致的总体保证。该框架可扩展到希尔伯特值响应场景，无需显式依赖输出维度。上述无维度结论属于统计层面结论而非计算层面结论：选择新神经元仍需求解非凸参数搜索问题。近期无限维通用近似结果所基于的拟波兰构造可作为典型示例，合成实验也验证了理论预测的分辨率、宽度与样本量适用区间。

title: Hidden Axis of Uncertainty: Latent-Posterior Alignment in Graph Neural Networks with Bayesian Output Layers
title_zh: 不确定性的隐藏轴：带贝叶斯输出层的图神经网络中的潜在后验对齐
authors: Suk Hoon Choi, Damdae Park, Junhyuk Choi, Hyein Jung, Changsoo Kim, Ung Lee, Kyeongsu Kim
abstract: Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs) with Bayesian output layers provide a principled and tractable framework for quantifying predictive uncertainty, yet the mechanisms shaping that uncertainty remain unclear. While conventional theory attributes uncertainty reduction to posterior contraction, the corresponding assumptions need not hold for deep models. In the Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Bayesian output layers studied here, we observe that predictive uncertainty decreases as latent representations shift toward lower-variance posterior directions, even though the posterior variance does not contract. We term this behavior Latent-Posterior Alignment (LPA) and conduct interventional experiments that support its functional role in shaping predictive uncertainty. Building on this insight, we propose Alignment-Guided Learning (AGL), which explicitly promotes this alignment during training. AGL effectively reduces predictive uncertainty while preserving accuracy and improves structural calibration, ensuring that the model confidence faithfully mirrors underlying data density. These findings provide a new perspective on uncertainty dynamics in GNNs with mean-field Bayesian output layers, shifting the focus from the magnitude of the posterior to the geometric interplay between latent and parameter spaces.
summary_zh: 带贝叶斯输出层的贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）提供了严谨且可落地的预测不确定性量化框架，但目前学界对这类不确定性的形成机制仍缺乏清晰认知。传统理论将不确定性降低归因于后验收缩，但该假设在深度模型中未必成立。本文研究的带贝叶斯输出层的图神经网络（GNN）场景下，我们观测到：即使后验方差未发生收缩，预测不确定性仍会随着潜在表示向低方差后验方向偏移而降低。我们将该行为命名为潜在后验对齐（LPA），并通过干预实验验证了其在塑造预测不确定性过程中的功能作用。基于该洞见，本文提出对齐引导学习（AGL）方法，在训练过程中显式促进该对齐过程。AGL可在保持预测准确率的前提下有效降低预测不确定性，同时提升模型的结构校准性能，确保模型置信度可忠实反映底层数据密度。上述研究成果为带均值场贝叶斯输出层的图神经网络的不确定性动力学提供了全新视角，将研究焦点从后验的数值大小转向潜在空间与参数空间之间的几何交互关系。

title: Geometric Regularization for Long-Tailed Semi-Supervised Learning via Gaussian Feature Bridges
title_zh: 基于高斯特征桥的长尾半监督学习几何正则化方法
authors: Hongyang He, Xinyuan Song, Yan Zhong, Daizong Liu, Yanbin Li, Yang-fan He, Wenqiao Zhang
abstract: Real-world semi-supervised learning (SSL) often encounters significant challenges with long-tailed label distributions and noisy pseudo-labels, which hinder generalization and amplify confirmation bias. In this work, we introduce a novel framework, Gaussian Bridge Consistency (GBC), to address these challenges by constructing semantic interpolation paths between unlabeled samples and high-quality class anchors. Our method maintains a dynamic Prototype Atlas that stores a diverse and evolving set of labeled and pseudo-labeled exemplars per class. For each unlabeled instance, GBC forms a class-conditional Gaussian Feature Bridge in the latent space, enabling the student model to traverse a smooth trajectory from uncertain predictions to reliable class prototypes. A bridge consistency loss is applied along this path to enforce alignment with a geometrically interpolated target distribution. Furthermore, we propose BridgeMix, a confidence-aware feature mixing strategy that interpolates both sample and anchor pairs to amplify cross-sample generalization. Extensive experiments on CIFAR10-LT and ImageNet-LT (USB benchmarks) validate the robustness and effectiveness of GBC under realistic long-tailed SSL settings, consistently improving long tail-class performance without sacrificing scalability.
summary_zh: 现实场景下的半监督学习（SSL）通常面临长尾标签分布与伪标签噪声的双重挑战，既会损害模型泛化能力，也会放大确认偏差问题。本文提出一种名为高斯桥一致性（GBC）的新型框架，通过在无标注样本与高质量类别锚点之间构建语义插值路径解决上述挑战。该方法维护一个动态原型图谱，为每个类别存储一组多样化且持续演化的有标注与伪标注样本。针对每个无标注样本，GBC在潜在空间中构建类别条件高斯特征桥，引导学生模型从不确定预测结果平滑过渡到可靠的类别原型。在该路径上施加桥一致性损失，强制模型输出与几何插值目标分布对齐。此外本文还提出BridgeMix，一种置信度感知的特征混合策略，通过同时插值样本对与锚点对，提升跨样本泛化能力。在CIFAR10-LT与ImageNet-LT（USB基准）上的大量实验验证了GBC在真实长尾半监督学习场景下的鲁棒性与有效性，该方法可在不损失可扩展性的前提下持续提升长尾类别性能。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Continuous-Time Jump Markov Decision Processes with Applications to Network Dynamic Pricing
title_zh: 面向连续时间跳马尔可夫决策过程的强化学习及其在网络动态定价中的应用
authors: Huiling Meng, Ningyuan Chen, Xuefeng Gao
abstract: We study reinforcement learning (RL) in Continuous-Time Jump Markov Decision Processes (CTJMDPs) featuring general discrete state spaces (which need not possess a vector space structure) and continuous/discrete action spaces. The setup covers many well-known applications in operations such as multi-product dynamic pricing with capacitated resources (Gallego and van Ryzin 1997). To model the exploration-exploitation tradeoff, we formulate an entropy-regularized continuous-time control problem with stochastic policies. Recent continuous-time RL techniques such as $q$-learning for controlled diffusions in (Jia and Zhou 2023) focus on continuous state spaces $\mathbb{R}^d$ and rely heavily on semimartingale theory in $\mathbb{R}^d$ for their theoretical analysis. Consequently, their methods cannot be directly applied to CTJMDPs with general discrete state spaces, which may lack the algebraic addition and subtraction structures inherent to Euclidean spaces. To bridge this gap, we establish the theoretical foundations of $q$-learning for CTJMDPs and develop model-free $q$-learning algorithms. Compared to na\"{i}ve time discretization and approximating CTJMDPs using discrete-time MDPs, our approach has several conceptual and empirical benefits. Numerical experiments in network dynamic pricing (Gallego and van Ryzin 1997) show that our proposed RL algorithm reliably learns near-optimal policies and consistently outperforms standard benchmark methods, demonstrating superior solution quality and effective scalability to large-scale network instances.
summary_zh: 本文研究面向连续时间跳马尔可夫决策过程（CTJMDP）的强化学习（RL）方法，该类过程支持通用离散状态空间（无需具备向量空间结构）与连续/离散动作空间，可覆盖运营管理领域大量经典应用场景，例如带容量约束的多产品动态定价问题（Gallego and van Ryzin 1997）。为建模探索-利用权衡关系，本文构建了带随机策略的熵正则化连续时间控制问题。现有面向受控扩散过程的连续时间强化学习技术（如Jia and Zhou 2023提出的q学习方法）仅针对ℝ^d连续状态空间设计，其理论分析高度依赖ℝ^d空间的半鞅理论，无法直接应用于不具备欧几里得空间加减代数结构的通用离散状态空间CTJMDP场景。为填补该空白，本文建立了CTJMDP场景下q学习的理论基础，开发了无模型q学习算法。与朴素时间离散化、采用离散时间MDP近似CTJMDP的方法相比，本文提出的方法在概念层面与实证层面均具备多重优势。在网络动态定价场景（Gallego and van Ryzin 1997）下的数值实验表明，所提强化学习算法可稳定学习到近最优策略，性能持续优于各类标准基线方法，具备更优的求解质量与面向大规模网络实例的可扩展性。

title: Predicting Resource Efficient Hamiltonian Decomposition for Continuous-Time Quantum Walk Simulations
title_zh: 面向连续时间量子行走模拟的资源高效哈密顿量分解预测
authors: Mostafa Atallah, Rebekah Herrman, Zain H. Saleem
abstract: Simulating a continuous-time quantum walk (CTQW) on a graph in the circuit model of quantum computing requires decomposing its Hamiltonian into terms that can be Trotterized into hardware-native gates. We consider two such decompositions: the standard Pauli decomposition and the recently introduced matching decomposition. Prior work suggests that the matching decomposition uses fewer CX gates on sparse graphs, while the Pauli decomposition uses fewer on denser graphs. Since CX gates dominate error and runtime on current hardware, we train machine learning models to predict, for a given graph, which of the two decompositions produces the smaller CX gate count. We train and evaluate on the complete population of all 11,117 connected eight-vertex graphs from Brendan McKay's database, so the class balance and overlap are measured directly rather than estimated. We use twelve features: ten topological properties of the graph and two that count the terms the Pauli and matching decompositions produce (n_Pauli and n_match), both computable without transpiling the simulation circuit. Standard topological properties alone provide little predictive power. Instead, the dominant signal comes from n_Pauli, a property of the Hamiltonian decomposition rather than an intrinsic property of the graph; degree variance is the only other feature that carries signal. Across a range of models the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) falls in a narrow band, from 0.569 untuned to 0.593 after tuning, so no single architecture stands out. We adopt a single-hidden-layer neural network at MCC 0.593. Applied frozen to a held-out, class-balanced test set of larger graphs (up to 256 vertices) from structured and Erdos-Renyi families, the model transfers, with MCC rising from 0.785 at N=8 to 1 at N>=64.
summary_zh: 在量子计算的线路模型中模拟图上的连续时间量子行走（Continuous-Time Quantum Walk, CTQW），需要将其哈密顿量分解为可经Trotter化转换为硬件原生门的项。本文研究两类分解方法：标准泡利（Pauli）分解与近年提出的匹配分解。已有研究表明，在稀疏图上匹配分解所需的CX门数量更少，而在稠密图上泡利分解更具优势。由于CX门是当前硬件中误差与运行时间的主要来源，本文训练机器学习模型，针对给定图预测两种分解中哪一种能生成更少的CX门。我们使用Brendan McKay数据库中全部11117个连通八顶点图的完整数据集完成训练与评估，可直接测算类别平衡度与重叠度，无需估算。模型共使用12个特征：10个图的拓扑属性，以及2个无需转译模拟线路即可计算的特征——泡利分解生成的项数n_Pauli和匹配分解生成的项数n_match。仅使用标准拓扑属性的预测能力十分有限，核心预测信号来自n_Pauli（属于哈密顿量分解属性而非图的固有属性），度方差是唯一另一个携带有效信号的特征。在多种模型架构下，马修斯相关系数（Matthews Correlation Coefficient, MCC）的取值范围非常窄，未调优模型的MCC为0.569，调优后可达0.593，没有某一种架构表现出显著优势。最终我们选择MCC为0.593的单隐藏层神经网络。将该模型冻结后应用于来自结构化图与Erdos-Renyi图族、顶点数最高达256的类别平衡留出测试集时，模型表现出良好的泛化能力：N=8时MCC为0.785，N≥64时MCC可达1。

title: Meta-clustering of milk mid-infrared spectra identifies dairy cow groups associated with negative energy balance in early lactation
title_zh: 牛奶中红外光谱的元聚类可识别与泌乳早期奶牛负能量平衡相关的群体
authors: T. Touil, E. R. Paquet
abstract: Clustering methods have been used to identify distinct groups of milk samples, cows, or herds. Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, particularly mid-infrared (MIR) spectroscopy, has been applied to individual cow milk samples to predict various milk traits. Applying clustering directly to MIR spectral data may reveal latent groups of cows associated with milk traits or health disorders and can help prevent these conditions or monitor at-risk animals. This study aimed to identify groups of individual dairy cows in early lactation directly from milk MIR spectra and to analyze their associations with milk traits. Using a dataset of 407,632 individual milk MIR records from 3,408 commercial farms, we combined (i) spectral filtering that selects informative wavenumbers, (ii) two dimensionality-reduction methods: principal component analysis (PCA) and an autoencoder, and (iii) two clustering algorithms: k-means and spectral clustering to yield eight different clustering approaches. We regrouped the assigned clusters into meta-clusters that encompassed the most similar ones identified by the eight approaches. Our results revealed five distinct meta-clusters of early-lactation individual dairy cows significantly associated with milk traits. Despite substantial differences, the eight approaches converged on the same five meta-clusters, and the classic, computationally efficient PCA-based k-means approach using the full spectrum recaptured clusters identified by more sophisticated, computationally intensive approaches. The five meta-clusters were strongly associated with DIM and appeared to reflect a gradient of negative energy balance (NEB) severity: severe, moderate, and possibly mild, while the remaining two likely represented cows recovering from NEB, one with rapid restoration of energy balance and one in early recovery.
summary_zh: 聚类方法已被用于识别牛奶样本、奶牛或牛群的不同分组。傅里叶变换红外（Fourier-transform infrared, FTIR）光谱，尤其是中红外（Mid-infrared, MIR）光谱，已被应用于单头奶牛的牛奶样本以预测各类牛奶性状。直接对MIR光谱数据进行聚类可挖掘与牛奶性状或健康障碍相关的潜在奶牛分组，有助于预防相关病症或监测高风险个体。本研究旨在直接通过牛奶MIR光谱识别泌乳早期的单头奶牛分组，并分析其与牛奶性状的关联。研究使用来自3408个商业牧场的407632条独立牛奶MIR记录数据集，结合（i）筛选有效波数的光谱过滤方法、（ii）两种降维方法：主成分分析（Principal Component Analysis, PCA）与自编码器，以及（iii）两种聚类算法：k均值聚类与谱聚类，共得到8种不同的聚类方案。我们将8种方案识别出的相似度最高的聚类重新组合为元聚类。结果显示，泌乳早期的单头奶牛可被划分为5个不同的元聚类，且这些分组与牛奶性状显著相关。尽管8种聚类方案差异较大，但最终收敛得到了完全一致的5个元聚类，其中基于全光谱的经典、计算高效的PCA-k均值方案可以复现更复杂、计算量更大的方案识别出的聚类。5个元聚类与泌乳天数（Days In Milk, DIM）强相关，且呈现出负能量平衡（Negative Energy Balance, NEB）的严重程度梯度：重度、中度和可能的轻度NEB，剩余两个分组大概率代表正在从NEB中恢复的奶牛，其中一组能量平衡快速恢复，另一组处于恢复早期阶段。

title: MIL-BERT: Classification of Arbitrarily Large Text with Performance and Explanatory Guarantees
title_zh: MIL-BERT（多示例学习BERT）：具备性能与可解释性保障的任意大文本分类
authors: John Cadigan, Dayne Freitag, Eric Yeh
abstract: Many text classification decisions are viable based on constituent excerpts alone. Taking inspiration from the field of multiple instance learning, we present an algorithm for training a neural network to classify text by selecting such excerpts. We show that our approach is also scalable with demonstrated learning against samples with nearly 1M tokens. We evaluate our methods on 7 datasets with emphasis on long-textual collections that far exceed the encoding limit of our base model. We present state-of-the-art results with this algorithm on 3 datasets: identification of political bias in news outlets, trigger warnings in long stories, and demographic characteristics of authors in tweet collections. Furthermore, the model trained on weakly-labeled collections of text (bags) generalizes to accurately classify constituent, smaller instances. Besides a new state-of-the-art for these problems, this approach is one of the few neural methods to excel in these datasets.
summary_zh: 很多文本分类决策仅依靠文本中的部分片段即可完成。受多示例学习领域思路的启发，本文提出一种训练神经网络的算法，通过选取这类关键片段实现文本分类。实验证明该方法具备良好的可扩展性，可对近100万token的样本完成学习。我们在7个数据集上对所提方法进行评估，重点选取了远超基础模型编码上限的长文本集合。该算法在3个数据集上取得了当前最优结果：新闻媒体政治倾向识别、长篇故事触发警告识别，以及推文集合作者人口统计学特征识别。此外，在弱标记文本集合（包）上训练得到的模型，可泛化实现对其中更小的独立实例的准确分类。除了在上述任务上取得新的最优表现外，该方法也是少数能在这类数据集上取得优异效果的神经网络方法之一。

title: Minimax Optimality of Score-Entropy Discrete Diffusion
title_zh: 分数熵离散扩散的极小极大最优性
authors: Cholyeon Cho, Yuchen Wu
abstract: While much of the prior theoretical literature on discrete diffusion has focused on the sampling efficiency of SEDD under the assumption of small score estimation error, recent work has begun to investigate the finite-sample properties of score estimation itself. In this work, we take a different route by investigating the fundamental statistical limits of concrete score estimation. We focus on uniform and masking discrete diffusions, two of the most widely adopted discrete diffusion models. We establish a minimax lower bound under the score-entropy loss, and propose an MLE-based thresholding estimator that matches this lower bound up to constant and polylogarithmic factors that depend on neighboring density ratios. We further show that, for any target distribution, this density ratio is naturally controlled under both uniform and masking discrete diffusion models, yielding nearly matching minimax lower and upper bounds for the aggregated score estimation error. Our results imply that, with appropriate initialization and discretization, SEDD can achieve nearly optimal minimax sample complexity, as measured by the KL divergence between the target and generated distributions.
summary_zh: 现有关于离散扩散的理论文献大多在分数估计误差较小的假设下，研究分数熵离散扩散（Score-Entropy Discrete Diffusion, SEDD）的采样效率，近期才有工作开始研究分数估计本身的有限样本性质。本文从不同角度出发，研究具体分数估计的基础统计极限，聚焦于两类应用最广泛的离散扩散模型：均匀离散扩散与掩码离散扩散。我们在分数熵损失下推导得到极小极大下界，并提出一种基于极大似然估计（Maximum Likelihood Estimation, MLE）的阈值估计器，其性能在仅相差与邻域密度比相关的常数因子和多对数因子的条件下匹配该下界。本文进一步证明，对于任意目标分布，均匀离散扩散和掩码离散扩散模型都可自然控制该密度比，使得聚合分数估计误差的极小极大上下界几乎匹配。研究结果表明，在合适的初始化和离散化设置下，SEDD可实现接近最优的极小极大样本复杂度，该复杂度通过目标分布与生成分布之间的KL散度衡量。

title: Keyed Provenance Watermarking with Complementary Lattice-Based Secure Aggregation for Federated Learning
title_zh: 面向联邦学习的带密钥来源水印与互补格基安全聚合方案
authors: Xinyun Liu, Zhi Lu, Yu Chen, Ronghua Xu
abstract: Federated learning (FL) is vulnerable to multi-level attacks. However, existing methods address them separately, leaving FL exposed to data leakage, unauthorized reuse, and malicious gradient manipulation. In this work, we propose an FL framework that couples keyed context-provenance watermarking with verifiable lattice-based secure aggregation of Real-World Anchored Watermarking and Lattice-Based Zero-Knowledge Secure Aggregation. At the data layer, we propose a Kerckhoffs-compliant scheme that utilizes Physical Anchor Metadata (PAM) to ensure data provenance. PAM is defined as a context-provenance token derived from trusted infrastructure data (time, location, and server ID) and then subjected to a keyed HMAC-SHA-256 transformation to produce a watermark payload that cannot be generated without the client's secret key. We further design FMGAN, a GAN-based robust image watermarking framework that embeds this transformed payload using a feature fusion module and a Mamba-guided linear attention mechanism. At the computation layer, we adopt a lattice-based zero-knowledge secure aggregation (LZKSA) protocol that verifies key correctness, L2 norm bounds, and cosine similarity constraints over committed gradients without revealing private updates. The RLWE-based design guarantees post-quantum security. Extensive experiments validate the complementary protection of the two layers under composite attack scenarios. To our knowledge, no prior verification workflow has jointly evaluated both layers in a hybrid, end-to-end trustworthy FL framework.
summary_zh: 联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）容易受到多层级攻击，但现有方法分别针对不同攻击进行防护，导致FL仍然面临数据泄露、未授权复用和恶意梯度操纵的风险。本文提出一种FL框架，将带密钥的上下文来源水印，与可验证的格基安全聚合（结合真实世界锚定水印与格基零知识安全聚合）相结合。在数据层，我们提出符合Kerckhoffs原则的方案，利用物理锚定元数据（Physical Anchor Metadata, PAM）保障数据来源可追溯。PAM定义为从可信基础设施数据（时间、位置、服务器ID）生成的上下文来源令牌，经带密钥的HMAC-SHA-256转换后生成水印载荷，没有客户端密钥则无法生成该载荷。我们进一步设计基于GAN的鲁棒图像水印框架FMGAN，通过特征融合模块和Mamba引导的线性注意力机制嵌入转换后的水印载荷。在计算层，我们采用格基零知识安全聚合（Lattice-Based Zero-Knowledge Secure Aggregation, LZKSA）协议，可在不泄露私有更新的前提下，对提交梯度的密钥正确性、L2范数边界和余弦相似度约束进行验证。该基于环学习带误差（Ring Learning With Errors, RLWE）的设计可保障后量子安全。大量实验验证了两层防护在复合攻击场景下的互补保护效果。据我们所知，目前尚无其他验证工作流在混合端到端可信FL框架中同时对这两层防护进行联合评估。

title: Faults That Fortify: CNN Adversarial Robustness via GPU Undervolting
title_zh: 强化之“错”：通过GPU降压提升CNN对抗鲁棒性
authors: Behnam Omidi, Ahmad Tahmasivand, Husam Alsyouri, Saba Al-Sayouri, Chongzhou Fang, Ihsen Alouani, Khaled N. Khasawneh
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) face a dual challenge: vulnerability to adversarial attacks and prohibitive training cost. Adversarial training is effective but expensive, a burden that grows as learning shifts to the energy-constrained edge. This paper addresses both through GPU undervolting during training. Reducing supply voltage introduces stochastic perturbations that act as implicit regularization, improving robustness while lowering power. We characterize undervolting-induced faults at the bit level, then train LeNet, VGG-6, and MobileNetV3 on MNIST and CIFAR-10 under two training regimes, standard and adversarial, each at nominal and undervolted voltage, and evaluate all models against adversarial attacks. In both regimes, the undervolted model consistently achieves higher adversarial accuracy than its nominal-voltage counterpart, showing that hardware-induced faults strengthen even adversarial training. Because dynamic power scales quadratically with supply voltage, these robustness gains arrive with substantial energy savings. GPU undervolting is therefore a readily deployable hardware-level defense requiring no algorithmic change, and opens a promising direction in which robustness and energy efficiency move together.
summary_zh: 卷积神经网络（Convolutional Neural Networks, CNN）当前面临双重挑战：对抗攻击脆弱性与训练成本过高。对抗训练是提升鲁棒性的有效手段，但开销极大，随着学习任务向资源受限的边缘端迁移，该负担进一步加剧。本文通过训练阶段的GPU降压操作同时解决上述两个问题：降低供电电压会引入随机扰动，起到隐式正则化的作用，在降低功耗的同时提升模型鲁棒性。我们首先在比特层面对降压引发的故障进行表征，随后在MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上，分别在标准训练和对抗训练两种模式下，以标称电压和降压电压为变量训练LeNet、VGG-6和MobileNetV3三类模型，并针对对抗攻击对所有模型进行评估。在两种训练模式下，降压训练得到的模型对抗准确率始终高于标称电压下训练的对应模型，说明硬件引入的故障甚至可以进一步强化对抗训练的效果。由于动态功耗与供电电压的平方成正比，这类鲁棒性提升同时伴随着显著的能耗降低。GPU降压是一种易于部署的硬件层面防御手段，无需修改算法逻辑，为鲁棒性与能效协同提升开辟了极具前景的新方向。

title: AgentDecarbonizer: Carbon-Aware Execution for AI Agents
title_zh: AgentDecarbonizer（AI智能体减碳器）：面向AI智能体的碳感知执行机制
authors: Leyi Yan, Shuangning Li, Sihang Liu
abstract: AI agents extend large language models from single prompt-response interactions to long-running, goaldirected workflows that issue many model calls, invoke tools, and interact with external environments. These workflows enable tasks such as software repair, data analysis, and experiment management, but their repeated model invocations can incur substantial carbon emissions. This paper characterizes the carbon emissions of OpenClaw agent workloads using WildClawBench, and shows that emissions depend on token consumption, context cache reuse, and the carbon intensity of the grid. Our characterization identifies deadline flexibility as an opportunity for carbon-aware execution: agent tasks can wait for lower-carbon-intensity periods or shift to lower-carbon grids. However, doing so requires handling uncertain execution time for temporal shifting and cached context recomputation during spatial shifting. We present AgentDecarbonizer, a carbon optimizer for AI agents that runs alongside OpenClaw. Given a task prompt and user-specified deadline, AgentDecarbonizer conservatively estimates task duration and selects deadline-feasible execution schedules, while accounting for cache recomputation overhead during spatial shifting. Evaluated on WildClawBench workloads with 60 agent tasks across four grids, AgentDecarbonizer reduces carbon emissions by up to 57.9 % compared with a carbon-agnostic baseline and by up to 37.5 % compared with a baseline that selects the carbon-optimal grid at task start time.
summary_zh: AI智能体将大语言模型从单轮提示-响应交互扩展为长期运行、目标导向的工作流，可发起大量模型调用、调用工具并与外部环境交互。这类工作流可支撑软件修复、数据分析、实验管理等任务，但反复调用模型会产生大量碳排放。本文基于WildClawBench基准对OpenClaw智能体工作流的碳排放进行表征，发现碳排放量与token消耗量、上下文缓存复用率以及电网的碳强度相关。该表征结果指出了截止时间灵活性是实现碳感知执行的重要机会：智能体任务可等待低碳强度时段执行，或迁移到低碳电网运行。但该操作需要解决时间迁移带来的执行时间不确定性，以及空间迁移过程中的缓存上下文重计算问题。本文提出AgentDecarbonizer——一款与OpenClaw协同运行的AI智能体碳优化器。给定任务提示和用户指定的截止时间，AgentDecarbonizer可保守估算任务时长，在考虑空间迁移过程中缓存重计算开销的前提下，选择满足截止时间约束的执行调度方案。在覆盖4个电网、包含60个智能体任务的WildClawBench工作流上的评估结果显示，与不考虑碳排放的基线方案相比，AgentDecarbonizer最多可降低57.9%的碳排放，与仅在任务启动时选择碳最优电网的基线方案相比，最多可降低37.5%的碳排放。

title: Conditional-Independence-Regularized Distributional Autoencoders for Mixed-Type Data
title_zh: 面向混合类型数据的条件独立性正则化分布自编码器
authors: Siyuan Tang, Gongjun Xu, Ji Zhu
abstract: Mixed-type data containing both numerical and categorical variables arise in many scientific and real-world applications. Existing representation learning and generative modeling approaches typically focus either on reconstruction accuracy or unconditional data generation, but often fail to recover the full conditional distribution of the data while preserving interpretable structural relationships between heterogeneous variable types. In this work, we introduce Conditional-Independence-Regularized Distributional Autoencoders, a framework for learning low-dimensional representations of mixed-type data through conditional distribution matching and structural regularization. Our method combines an energy-score-based objective for numerical variables, a likelihood-based objective for categorical variables, and an auxiliary conditional independence regularization term encouraging the learned representation to capture the dependence between numerical and categorical components. We provide theoretical analysis showing that the optimal representation balances unexplained numerical variability, conditional entropy of categorical variables, and residual conditional dependence. Empirically, the proposed method achieves strong performance on both synthetic and real-world datasets, substantially improving categorical distribution recovery, achieving competitive overall conditional distribution recovery, and preserving mixed-type dependence structure. The code has been made available at GitHub.
summary_zh: 同时包含数值变量和分类变量的混合类型数据广泛存在于各类科学研究与实际应用场景中。现有表示学习与生成建模方法通常仅聚焦于提升重建精度或实现无条件数据生成，往往无法在保留异质变量间可解释结构关系的同时，恢复数据的完整条件分布。本文提出条件独立性正则化分布自编码器框架，通过条件分布匹配与结构正则化实现混合类型数据的低维表示学习。该方法结合面向数值变量的能量分数目标函数、面向分类变量的似然目标函数，以及辅助条件独立性正则项，引导学习到的表示捕捉数值分量与分类分量之间的依赖关系。本文提供的理论分析表明，最优表示可平衡未被解释的数值变异性、分类变量的条件熵以及残差条件依赖。大量实验结果显示，所提方法在合成数据集和真实数据集上均表现优异，可大幅提升分类分布的恢复效果，整体条件分布恢复性能达到当前最优水平，同时有效保留混合类型依赖结构。相关代码已在GitHub开源。

title: aiXamine: Unified Black-Box Evaluation of Cross-Dimensional Trade-offs in LLM Safety, Security, and Privacy
title_zh: aiXamine：大语言模型安全、安防与隐私跨维度权衡的统一黑盒评估平台
authors: Fatih Deniz, Yazan Boshmaf, Dorde Popovic, Issa Khalil
abstract: The critical failure modes in deployed large language models (LLMs) are cross-dimensional: a model can score 99.3 in safety alignment while refusing one in three benign queries, or improve across every capability metric while losing 21 points in privacy. Existing evaluation frameworks that assess safety, security, and privacy independently cannot detect these patterns. We introduce aiXamine, a unified black-box platform that evaluates LLM trustworthiness across safety, security, and privacy as interdependent properties. aiXamine orchestrates 46 tests across nine services through an automated red-teaming pipeline, producing hierarchical risk profiles, from prompt-level diagnostics to cross-service trade-off analytics, that enable reproducible comparison of proprietary and open-weight systems under identical conditions.
