Applying aiXamine to over 120 LLMs through more than 5,000 test runs, we conduct the largest joint safety, security, and privacy study to date and uncover three cross-dimensional phenomena invisible to single-axis evaluation. First, safety enforcement incurs a quantifiable safety tax: stronger alignment systematically increases over-refusal, forcing providers to choose between protection and utility. Second, privacy is near-orthogonal to other trustworthiness dimensions and not captured by standard alignment. Third, we identify and formally characterize distillation-induced robustness collapse: off-policy distillation without on-policy correction causes entropy collapse, catastrophically destroying robustness (56.9$\to$2.6) on the same base architecture. These findings, compounded by diminishing returns from scale and category-dependent safety behaviors, demonstrate that trustworthiness is inherently multi-dimensional: progress along one axis does not guarantee, and can actively undermine, progress along others, yet current alignment methods treat it as a single objective.
summary_zh: 已部署大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLM）的关键失效模式具有跨维度特性：某模型的安全对齐得分可达99.3，但会拒绝三分之一的良性查询；或在所有能力指标上均取得提升的同时，隐私得分下降21分。现有独立评估安全、安防、隐私的框架无法识别这类模式。本文提出aiXamine——一款统一黑盒平台，将LLM的可信性作为相互关联的属性，从安全、安防、隐私三个维度进行综合评估。aiXamine通过自动化红队测试流水线在9个服务中编排46项测试，生成从提示层诊断到跨服务权衡分析的层级化风险画像，支持在完全相同的条件下对闭源和开源大模型进行可复现对比。通过aiXamine对120余个LLM开展超过5000次测试，本文完成了迄今为止规模最大的安全、安防、隐私联合研究，发现了单维度评估无法识别的三类跨维度现象：第一，安全防护存在可量化的“安全税”：更强的对齐会系统性提升过度拒绝率，迫使模型提供商在防护效果和可用性之间做出权衡；第二，隐私维度与其他可信性维度几乎正交，无法通过标准对齐流程覆盖；第三，本文识别并正式定义了蒸馏引发的鲁棒性崩溃现象：未经过策略内校正的离线蒸馏会引发熵崩溃，在完全相同的基础架构上，鲁棒性会从56.9灾难性下降至2.6。上述发现结合规模效应边际收益递减、类别依赖的安全行为等特征，证明可信性本质上是多维度属性：单一维度的进展无法保证其他维度的提升，甚至可能对其他维度造成损害，但当前的对齐方法仍将其视为单一优化目标。

title: Learning Exact NVIDIA SASS Encoders with $\mathbb{F}_2$ Linear Algebra
title_zh: 基于F₂线性代数学习精确的NVIDIA SASS编码器
authors: Jiading Gai
abstract: NVIDIA provides a SASS disassembler but no public SASS assembler for recent data-center GPUs, limiting controlled machine-code rewriting. We present F2Asm, which learns exact 128-bit SASS encoders from paired disassembly and original CUBIN instruction words. To our knowledge, F2Asm is the first system to learn SASS instruction encoders as vector-valued affine maps over F2 and the first open-source NVIDIA SASS assembler to support Rubin SM107. F2Asm uses Gaussian elimination over F2 to incrementally build a compact basis, detect inconsistencies, and reject inputs outside the learned span. F2Asm separates target-specific control bits, relocation rules, and CUBIN metadata from its learning algorithm. We train encoders for Hopper SM90/SM90a, Blackwell SM100, and Rubin SM107 using 3,225 CUBINs from pinned NVIDIA and third-party production libraries, CUDA 13.3 packages, and CUDA 13.4 Developer Preview archives. In round-trip tests, F2Asm reassembles the disassembled SASS for each CUBIN, and all compared executable text sections match the originals exactly.
summary_zh: NVIDIA为最新数据中心GPU提供了SASS反汇编器，但未公开SASS汇编器，限制了可控的机器码重写操作。本文提出F2Asm系统，可从配对的反汇编结果与原始CUBIN指令字中学习得到精确的128位SASS编码器。据我们所知，F2Asm是首个将SASS指令编码器作为F₂上的向量值仿射映射进行学习的系统，也是首个支持Rubin SM107架构的开源NVIDIA SASS汇编器。F2Asm通过F₂上的高斯消元操作逐步构建紧凑基向量，检测不一致性，并拒绝超出学习张成空间的输入。F2Asm将目标特定控制位、重定位规则和CUBIN元数据与学习算法分离。我们使用来自固定版本NVIDIA与第三方生产库、CUDA 13.3安装包、CUDA 13.4开发者预览归档文件的3225个CUBIN文件，为Hopper SM90/SM90a、Blackwell SM100和Rubin SM107架构训练编码器。在往返测试中，F2Asm可对每个CUBIN的反汇编SASS完成重新汇编，所有对比的可执行文本段与原始内容完全匹配。

title: When Graph-JEPA Learns the Wrong Thing: Diagnosing and Repairing Category-Conditional Collapse
title_zh: 当Graph-JEPA（图联合嵌入预测架构）学习到错误内容：类别条件坍缩的诊断与修复
authors: Gollam Rabby, S\"oren Auer
abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are selected almost universally by linear probing and effective rank. We report a case where both read healthily while the representation carries zero usable instance information. We repair it, and a second failure appears: the repaired metric saturates on a target carrying no structural information. Our corpus is a scientific-reasoning graph over 57,903 articles, each a subgraph. A Graph-JEPA predicts one masked aspect from a subgraph's remaining aspects, attaining linear-probe accuracy 0.871 and effective rank 18-47, yet retrieval recovers 0.00 of 14.4 bits (MRR 1.9e-4 vs chance 1.99e-4, p=0.98). Three upper bounds on the same pool and code recover nearly everything (+14.28, +14.34, +14.22 bits), ruling out corpus, masking, pool, and metric as causes. We trace this to variance allocation - frozen inputs place 86.05% of variance on subgraph identity and 0.40% on aspect identity, while trained latents place 0.39% and 99.61%. This is a property of the objective's optimum: the degenerate solution is a global minimum of the coupled predictor/EMA-target objective, present already at init. A repaired configuration reaches 14.377 of 14.379 bits, above the 13.865-bit oracle; reverting the loss to regression drops it to 0.307 bits, confirming it. Yet the repair licenses nothing about reasoning: the target is reducible, since intra-subgraph edges are a deterministic function of node census. The oracle reaches 96.4% of the ceiling, and our largest effect is the learning-rate schedule, not architecture. Bits and a reasoning probe show no relation across ten cells. A data-derived target fails a quality gate - 25.96% of nodes are duplicate placeholders, and the rest is more generic than supporting evidence. Rank, probes, and metrics can all saturate on an unsupportive evaluation. We release a harness with a reducibility audit and target gate.
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构几乎都通过线性探测和有效秩指标验证表现良好。本文报告了一个案例：上述两项指标均显示正常，但学习得到的表征完全不具备可用的实例信息。我们对该问题进行修复后又发现了第二个故障：修复后的指标在不携带任何结构信息的目标上出现饱和。本文的研究语料是覆盖57903篇文献的科学推理图，每篇文献对应一个子图。Graph-JEPA通过子图的其余部分信息预测其中一个被掩码的部分，实现了0.871的线性探测准确率和18~47的有效秩，但检索任务仅能恢复0.00比特信息（平均倒数排名MRR为1.9e-4，随机水平为1.99e-4，p值为0.98）。在同一语料和代码环境下设置的三个上界对照实验几乎恢复了全部信息（分别提升14.28、14.34、14.22比特），排除了语料、掩码、池化操作和指标本身作为故障诱因的可能性。我们将问题溯源至方差分配机制：冻结输入将86.05%的方差分配给子图身份，仅将0.40%的方差分配给子图内各部分的身份，而训练得到的隐层表征的方差分配比例为0.39%和99.61%。这一特性是目标函数最优解的固有属性：该退化解是预测器/EMA（指数移动平均）目标耦合目标的全局最小值，在初始化阶段就已存在。修复后的配置可从14.379比特的总信息中恢复14.377比特，表现优于13.865比特的 oracle（理想参照模型）；若将损失函数改回回归损失，性能将骤降至0.307比特，验证了上述结论的正确性。但该修复并未赋予模型任何推理能力：目标本身是可约简的，因为子图内的边是节点计数的确定性函数。理想参照模型达到了性能上限的96.4%，而对性能影响最大的因素是学习率调度策略，而非架构设计。比特数指标和推理探测结果在10组对照中无显著相关性。数据生成的目标未通过质量校验：25.96%的节点是重复占位符，其余内容的通用性过强，无法作为支撑证据。秩、探测任务和指标都可能在不具备支撑性的评估任务上出现饱和。我们开源了包含可约简性审计和目标校验功能的测试框架。

title: Bern2Edge: A Neurosymbolic Compiler for Edge Deployment via Bernstein Polynomial Networks
title_zh: Bern2Edge：基于伯恩斯坦多项式网络的边缘部署神经符号编译器
authors: Malak Gamal El-Din, Yifan Zhang, Yasser Shoukry, Sitao Huang, Salma Elmalaki
abstract: Deploying high-accuracy neural networks on resource-constrained edge devices remains challenging, as existing approaches treat training, compression, and hardware synthesis as separate stages, leaving a gap between software-trained models and efficient end-to-end deployment with limited support for interpretability. We propose Bern2Edge, an end-to-end framework that uses knowledge distillation to convert a pretrained teacher feed-forward network into hardware-efficient representations via Bernstein polynomial activations. This representation enables two deployment paths: (i) a high-fidelity LUT-based realization that preserves model fidelity under compression, and (ii) a symbolic rule-based representation derived from Bernstein activation geometry, enabling interpretable inference with explicit input-space constraints. The resulting BNNs achieve up to 2.12 percentage-point (pp) accuracy improvement over ReLU under identical compression constraints. At the system level, Bern2Edge achieves up to 99.8% latency reduction and 95.2% BRAM reduction relative to a W8A8 quantized teacher on an AMD Xilinx KV260 FPGA, while maintaining accuracy within 0.5 pp, and further deploys on a low-power Spartan-7 XC7S15 FPGA. The rule-based path reduces DSP usage by up to 89.0% at a cost of 1.5 pp in total accuracy.
summary_zh: 在资源受限的边缘设备上部署高精度神经网络仍面临诸多挑战：现有方法将训练、压缩和硬件综合作为独立阶段处理，导致软件训练模型与高效端到端部署之间存在断层，且对可解释性的支持十分有限。本文提出Bern2Edge这一全链路框架，利用知识蒸馏将预训练的教师前馈网络转换为基于伯恩斯坦多项式激活函数的硬件友好型表征。该表征支持两种部署路径：（1）基于LUT（查找表）的高保真实现，可在压缩过程中保留模型精度；（2）从伯恩斯坦激活的几何特性推导得到的基于符号规则的表征，可在显式输入空间约束下实现可解释推理。在相同压缩约束下，所得的BNN（伯恩斯坦多项式网络）相比使用ReLU激活的模型最高可将精度提升2.12个百分点。在系统层面，与W8A8量化的教师模型相比，Bern2Edge在AMD Xilinx KV260 FPGA（现场可编程门阵列）上最高可降低99.8%的延迟和95.2%的BRAM（块随机存取存储器）占用，同时精度损失控制在0.5个百分点以内，还可进一步部署在低功耗Spartan-7 XC7S15 FPGA上。基于规则的部署路径可将DSP（数字信号处理器）占用最高降低89.0%，总精度仅损失1.5个百分点。

title: Metag: A dataset to build agentic meta-reviewing capabilities
title_zh: Metag：用于构建智能体元评审能力的数据集
authors: Anirudh Sundar, Min Chen, Divya Tadimeti, Gemma Zhang, Alice Li, Nigel Boachie Kumankumah, Pavan Uttej Ravva, Sadid Hasan, Somya Chatterjee, Pruthvi Prakash Navada, Xiao Wang, Yue Kang, Sulaiman Vesal, Larry Heck
abstract: AI tools increasingly support tasks across the scientific research cycle, from experiment design and manuscript preparation to peer review. At the same time, the continuing growth in conference submissions has increased the burden on meta-reviewers, who must synthesize reviewer feedback, author rebuttals, and manuscript revisions. To address this concern, this paper introduces Metag, a dataset to accelerate the development of meta-reviewing agents, specifically to identify changes made to scientific articles during the review-rebuttal process. Each instance contains a reviewer concern, the author's proposed resolution, and the manuscript diffs implementing the stated change. Metag is collected by obtaining manuscript versions from before the review deadline and after acceptance, computing differences between the two documents, and asking human annotators to align these differences with action items from OpenReview discussions. The resulting dataset consists of 349 high-quality action items tied to paper differences and will enable building methods to empower meta reviewers to quickly identify whether authors have addressed reviewer statements and where in the paper those changes have been made, resulting in additional transparency and traceability throughout peer review. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/microsoft/Metag-dataset.
summary_zh: AI工具正越来越多地为科研全流程任务提供支持，覆盖实验设计、稿件撰写到同行评审等环节。与此同时，会议投稿量的持续增长加大了元评审者的工作负担：元评审者需要整合评审意见、作者反驳意见和稿件修订内容完成综合判断。针对这一问题，本文提出Metag数据集，旨在推动元评审智能体的开发，重点识别审稿-反驳流程中科研论文发生的修改。数据集中的每个样本包含评审者提出的关切点、作者给出的修改方案，以及实现对应修改的稿件差异片段。Metag的构建流程为：获取评审截止前和录用后的两个版本稿件，计算两份文档的差异，再由人工标注员将这些差异与OpenReview讨论中的待办项进行对齐。最终得到的数据集包含349个与论文修改内容绑定的高质量待办项，可用于开发相关方法，帮助元评审者快速判断作者是否回应了评审意见、修改内容位于论文的哪个位置，提升同行评审全流程的透明度和可追溯性。该数据集已公开，访问地址为https://github.com/microsoft/Metag-dataset。

title: Uncertainty propagation in auto-regressive random neural network models
title_zh: 自回归随机神经网络模型中的不确定性传播
authors: Janice Adams, Daniele Venturi
abstract: We develop analytical and particle-based methods for uncertainty propagation in random neural network models, where both the inputs and network parameters are allowed to be random. Building on the piecewise-linear structure of the Leaky ReLU activation function, we derive a local approximation of the neural network output with respect to perturbations in both its inputs and parameters. This approximation is exact for perturbations that preserve the network activation pattern, and it allows us to compute analytical expressions for the probability density function and characteristic function of the network output, together with closed-form approximations for its mean and covariance. We extend this uncertainty propagation framework to autonomous dynamical systems whose one-step evolution map is represented by a random neural network. Repeated application of this map defines an autoregressive model, for which we derive recursive equations to propagate uncertainty in both the state and network parameters over time. These equations explicitly account for the state-parameter cross-covariance that develops under successive iterations of the network. Numerical experiments on the Lorenz-63 system and the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation demonstrate accurate uncertainty propagation through the predictability horizon and the applicability of the proposed framework to high-dimensional dynamical systems.
summary_zh: 本文针对输入和网络参数均为随机变量的随机神经网络模型，开发了用于不确定性传播的解析方法和基于粒子的方法。基于Leaky ReLU激活函数的分段线性特性，推导了神经网络输出相对于输入和参数扰动的局部近似。该近似在扰动不改变网络激活模式的前提下是精确的，可用于推导网络输出的概率密度函数和特征函数的解析表达式，以及均值和协方差的闭式近似。本文进一步将该不确定性传播框架扩展到单步演化映射由随机神经网络表示的自治动力系统：该映射的重复调用定义了自回归模型，我们推导了递归方程，可随时间推移同时传播状态和网络参数的不确定性。这些方程显式考虑了网络多次迭代后产生的状态-参数互协方差。在Lorenz-63系统和Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程上开展的数值实验表明，该方法可在可预测视界内实现精准的不确定性传播，所提出的框架适用于高维动力系统场景。

title: When Clean Data Hurts: Learning with Monotone Corruptions Beyond Binary Classification
title_zh: 干净数据何时会产生危害：二分类以外场景下的单调损坏学习
authors: Julian Asilis, Shaddin Dughmi, Chirag Pabbaraju
abstract: We complement these impossibility results by proving that every class remains learnable when the number of adaptive additions is $o(n)$, which our previous multiclass lower bound proves to be tight. We further observe that the classic multiclass error rate of $O(d_{\mathrm{DS}} / n)$ remains achievable against adaptive adversaries restricted to a known constant budget $b = O(1)$, against semi-adaptive adversaries viewing only a $p$-fraction of $S$ for $p \in (0, 1)$, and against oblivious adversaries that cannot view $S$.
summary_zh: 本文对现有不可能性结论形成补充，证明当自适应添加的样本数量为o(n)量级时，所有类别仍具备可学习性，该结论与此前得到的多分类下界共同构成紧界。我们进一步观察到，当面对自适应对手的已知常数预算b=O(1)约束、仅能查看数据集S的p比例（p∈(0,1)）的半自适应对手、以及完全无法查看数据集S的非自适应对手时，经典的O(d_DS/n)量级多分类错误率仍可实现。

title: Mutual information and sensitivity analysis for feature selection in customer targeting: a comparative study
title_zh: 面向客户定向场景下特征选择的互信息与灵敏度分析对比研究
authors: Nestor Barraza, Sergio Moro, Marcelo Ferreyra, Adolfo de la Pe\~na
abstract: Feature selection is a highly relevant task in a data-driven knowledge discovery project. Several techniques have been developed aiming at finding the features that influence most an outcome to predict, including mutual information and, in recent years, the data-based sensitivity analysis. The present research focus on analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of each of these two techniques, by applying both to a bank telemarketing case. Thereafter, a logistic regression model is built on the tuned set of features identified by each of the two techniques as the most influencing set of features on the success of a telemarketing contact, in a total of 13 features for mutual information and 9 features for the data-based sensitivity analysis. The latter performs better for lower values of false positives while the former is slightly better for a higher false positive ratio. Thus, mutual information becomes a better choice if bank managers intend to reduce slightly the cost of contacts without risking losing a high number of successes. Such results show that mutual information, although not recent, is still a valid method for feature selection. On the other side, the data-based sensitivity analysis selection achieved good prediction results with less features.
summary_zh: 特征选择是数据驱动知识发现项目中的核心任务。目前学界已开发出多种用于识别对预测结果影响最大的特征的技术，包括互信息方法，以及近年兴起的基于数据的灵敏度分析方法。本研究以银行电话营销场景为案例，对比分析两种技术的优缺点：分别使用两种技术识别对电话营销成功影响最大的特征子集，其中互信息方法选出13个特征，基于数据的灵敏度分析方法选出9个特征，基于这两个调优后的特征子集分别构建逻辑回归模型。实验结果表明，在低假阳性区间，基于数据的灵敏度分析方法表现更优；而在高假阳性比率区间，互信息方法的表现略好。因此如果银行管理者希望在不损失大量成功转化案例的前提下小幅降低触达成本，互信息方法是更优选择。该结果表明，尽管互信息方法提出时间较早，仍是特征选择的有效方案；另一方面，基于数据的灵敏度分析方法仅使用更少的特征就取得了良好的预测效果。

title: Amortized Bandwidth Learning for Kernel Density Estimation under Logarithmic Score
title_zh: 对数评分准则下核密度估计的分摊带宽学习
authors: Junyi Liang, Hailiang Du
abstract: Kernel density estimation converts finite samples into probability densities, but its performance depends critically on bandwidth selection. Classical selectors prescribe the sample-to-bandwidth rule analytically or asymptotically, or solve a new optimization for each sample. An amortized framework is proposed that instead learns this mapping across a distribution of density-estimation tasks by optimizing the logarithmic score. A truncated-and-renormalized bounded-support formulation enables stable learning across heterogeneous tasks, while affine standardization allows a selector trained on a single reference interval to transfer across bounded intervals. Experiments under Gaussian sampling, a multi-family benchmark, and randomized Gaussian-mixture training show that the amortized selector consistently and substantially outperforms Silverman's rule, the Sheather--Jones selector, and least-squares cross-validation, with especially large gains in small and heterogeneous samples. Finite Gaussian mixtures provide a generic training mechanism supported by their $L^1$ approximation property. Selectors trained in this way generalize strongly across different density structures, allowing the same trained selector to be applied directly to finite samples from unknown densities without specifying or fitting a distributional family. This combination of broad applicability and strong empirical performance makes the framework attractive for a wide range of applications in which finite samples or ensembles must be converted into continuous probability densities.
summary_zh: 核密度估计可将有限样本转换为概率密度，但其性能高度依赖带宽选择。经典的带宽选择器通过解析或渐近方式给出样本-带宽映射规则，或针对每个样本单独求解优化问题。本文提出一种分摊框架，通过优化对数评分准则，跨多个密度估计任务的分布学习该映射规则。该框架采用截断重归一化的有界支撑形式，可在异构任务下实现稳定学习，同时引入仿射标准化操作，使在单个参考区间上训练得到的选择器可迁移到任意有界区间。在高斯采样、多家族基准测试和随机高斯混合训练场景下开展的实验表明，分摊带宽选择器的表现持续显著优于Silverman规则、Sheather-Jones选择器和最小二乘交叉验证方法，在小样本和异构样本场景下的性能提升尤为明显。有限高斯混合凭借其L1近似特性，可作为通用的训练机制。以此方式训练的选择器可跨不同密度结构实现强泛化能力，训练完成后可直接应用于未知密度生成的有限样本，无需预先指定或拟合分布家族。该框架兼具广泛适用性和优异的实证表现，可广泛应用于各类需要将有限样本或样本集转换为连续概率密度的场景。

title: Stored in Optimizer State, Valued by Later Training: A Causal Account of Subliminal Trait Transfer
title_zh: 存储于优化器状态、在后续训练中被赋值：潜意识特征迁移的因果解释
authors: Qinyang Xu
abstract: Subliminal trait transfer allows a student model to acquire behavioral dispositions from teacher-generated data in which the trait is not semantically expressed. Recent work explains how such signals enter gradients, but not how they survive source removal or acquire different signs under later training. We treat parameters and optimizer moments as a single trainer state and derive an exact transport-valuation identity separating observer-independent propagation of the source perturbation from the value assigned by a future continuation and behavioral readout. State surgery identifies the first moment as a causal carrier. Transplanting it alone leaves parameters, hidden states, and outputs unchanged at the cut, yet source-free updates generate growing parameter and hidden-state differences; transplanting parameters with the first moment recovers the terminal behavioral response. Sending the same source-induced difference through matched futures produces negative, near-zero, and positive Qwen effects (-0.658, +0.008, and +0.658 seed means). This ordering recurs in all 12 Llama-3.2-1B seeds after eight updates, while state-difference norms remain nearly equal across routes. Both contrasts grow in every paired seed when the continuation extends to sixteen updates. A full-horizon costate predicts all 42 Qwen route-mean signs and all 21 resolved Llama ordinary-route signs. Observer-independent transport also replicates across Qwen, SmolLM2, and Llama, while the complete-state recurrence predicts physical, hidden, and fixed-head responses in non-LoRA MNIST systems, including CNNs trained with AdamW and momentum SGD. Together, these results identify a two-stage mechanism for subliminal trait transfer: optimizer state transports the source perturbation, and later training determines its behavioral value.
summary_zh: 潜意识特征迁移可让学生模型从教师生成的数据中习得行为倾向，而该特征在数据中并未得到语义层面的显式表达。现有研究已解释这类信号如何进入梯度，但尚未说明其如何在源数据被移除后仍留存、以及在后续训练中获得不同符号的机制。本文将模型参数和优化器动量视为统一的训练器状态，推导得到精确的传输-赋值恒等式，将与观测无关的源扰动传播过程与由后续训练流程和行为读出环节赋予的价值分离开。状态干预实验表明一阶动量是因果载体：仅移植一阶动量时，参数、隐状态和输出在分割点处均保持不变，但无源数据的后续更新会使参数和隐状态的差异逐渐增大；将参数与一阶动量共同移植可恢复最终的行为响应。将同一源诱导的差异输入到匹配的后续训练流程中，可得到负、接近零、正三类Qwen效应（种子均值分别为-0.658、+0.008、+0.658）。该排序规律在8次更新后的全部12个Llama-3.2-1B种子中均存在，而不同路径下的状态差范数几乎相等。当后续训练扩展到16次更新时，所有配对种子中的两类效应差异均会增大。全时域协态预测可准确预测全部42个Qwen路径均值的符号，以及全部21个已解析Llama常规路径的符号。与观测无关的传输机制在Qwen、SmolLM2和Llama模型中均复现，而全状态递归规律可预测非LoRA场景下MNIST系统的物理、隐层和固定头响应，包括使用AdamW和带动量的SGD训练的CNN模型。上述结果共同揭示了潜意识特征迁移的两阶段机制：优化器状态负责传输源扰动，后续训练过程决定其最终的行为价值。

title: Shared Physics Responses Recover Hidden Rankings in Neural Operator Libraries
title_zh: 共享物理响应可恢复神经算子库中的隐式排序
authors: Hanbing Liang, Fujun Liu
abstract: Selecting the optimal neural-operator prediction during deployment is challenging when high-fidelity reference solutions are unavailable. We demonstrate that under a squared Hilbert-space loss, ranking a finite model library depends strictly on the low-dimensional span of candidate differences, allowing us to score all models simultaneously using a single anchor-based linearized response of the governing equation. This shared physical diagnostic accurately recovered over 99.6\% of pairwise preferences and 99.0\% of optimal checkpoints across diverse Fourier and convolutional operator libraries for fluid, reaction-diffusion, and wave dynamics. Furthermore, the corrected physical proxy frequently outperformed the best individual candidates, and we establish computable sufficient conditions that rigorously certify exact decisions for strongly monotone discretizations. By exploiting the local dynamical response rather than raw defect magnitude, this framework enables the reliable and highly efficient deployment of scientific surrogates without requiring ground-truth data.
summary_zh: 在无高保真参考解的部署场景下，从神经算子库中选择最优预测模型十分具有挑战性。本文证明在平方希尔伯特空间损失下，有限模型库的排序完全由候选模型差异的低维张成空间决定，因此可基于控制方程的单锚点线性化响应，同时对所有模型进行评分。该共享物理诊断方法在覆盖流体、反应扩散和波动力学的各类傅里叶算子库和卷积算子库中，准确恢复了超过99.6%的成对偏好关系和99.0%的最优检查点。此外，经修正的物理代理指标的表现通常优于所有单个候选模型，本文还推导了可计算的充分条件，可为强单调离散化场景的精确决策提供严格保证。该框架通过利用局部动力学响应而非原始误差幅值，可在无需真实真值数据的前提下实现科学代理模型的可靠、高效部署。

title: Wrong-Physics Backdoors in Neural PDE Operators
title_zh: 神经偏微分方程算子中的错误物理后门
authors: Hanbing Liang, Fujun Liu
abstract: Neural PDE operators are increasingly trained on reusable solver archives, yet validation often relies on clean prediction error and parameter-agnostic plausibility checks. We introduce cross-parameter relinking, a data-poisoning primitive that makes a triggered input select a valid solution from the same PDE family under an incorrect physical parameter. We term this a wrong-physics backdoor: the output remains physically plausible but is wrong for the intended parameter. The attack exploits tensor-to-parameter provenance failures in multi-parameter archives by stamping the surrogate input and relinking its supervision to a cached alternate-parameter solution for the same latent sample. Across 476 attack campaigns, we evaluate Burgers, advection-diffusion, two-dimensional Navier-Stokes, and an elliptic Poisson case. Fourier Neural Operators and DeepONet provide the primary evidence, with Transformer, GRU, and LSTM models as support. FNO reaches a backdoor success rate of 1.0000 on both advection-diffusion and two-dimensional Navier-Stokes while retaining low clean relative L2 error. Clean-label, label-only, and shuffled controls show that high attack success alone is insufficient: successful attacks must move predictions toward the intended alternate-physics target while preserving bounded clean error. These results expose a structural validation gap: smoothness or generic solver-like behavior is insufficient unless the provenance of the intended physical parameter is also verified.
summary_zh: 当前越来越多的神经偏微分方程算子基于可复用的求解器存档训练，但其验证流程通常仅依赖干净预测误差和与参数无关的合理性检查。本文提出跨参数重链接这一数据投图原语，可让触发后的输入从同一偏微分方程家族中选出对应错误物理参数下的有效解。我们将其命名为错误物理后门：模型输出仍具备物理合理性，但与目标指定的参数不匹配。该攻击利用多参数存档中张量与参数的溯源失效问题，在代理模型输入上添加标记，并将其监督信号重链接到同一隐样本对应的其他参数下的缓存解。本文在476组攻击实验中对Burgers方程、对流扩散方程、二维Navier-Stokes方程和椭圆型Poisson方程场景进行评估，以傅里叶神经算子和DeepONet为主要验证对象，以Transformer、GRU和LSTM模型为辅助验证对象。傅里叶神经算子在对流扩散和二维Navier-Stokes场景下的后门成功率达到1.0000，同时仍保持极低的干净样本相对L2误差。干净标签、仅标签和随机打乱的对照实验表明，仅高攻击成功率不足以构成有效攻击：成功的攻击必须在保持干净误差有界的前提下，将预测结果向目标错误物理参数的方向偏移。上述结果揭示了现有验证流程的结构性缺陷：仅验证平滑性或类求解器的通用行为是不足的，还必须对目标物理参数的溯源性进行校验。

title: Machine Learning and ARIMA Model Averaging for Adaptive Public Health Forecasting: Comparative Evaluation and an Ontario COVID-19 Case Study
title_zh: 面向自适应公共卫生预测的机器学习与ARIMA（自回归积分滑动平均）模型平均方法：对比评估及安大略省COVID-19案例研究
authors: Yushu Zou, Ye Li, Johra Moosa, Martin Grunnill, Samir N. Patel, Venkata R. Duvvuri
abstract: Public health forecasts must respond to abrupt changes in surveillance data without over-extrapolating noise, reporting artifacts, or temporary trends. We evaluated autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA), random forest, and extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) models using 190 weekly observations of publicly available Ontario COVID-19 case counts from January 2020 to October 2023. Rolling-origin time-series cross-validation preserved temporal order during model tuning and evaluation. Performance was assessed across three operating dimensions: responsiveness following selected turning points, forecast horizons of one to six weeks, and the amount of historical training data. We also developed Machine Learning and ARIMA Model Averaging (MLAMA), a non-negative performance-weighted ensemble with weights that vary by forecast horizon and responsiveness setting. Retrospective comparisons showed that ARIMA adapted rapidly after turning points but its normalized error increased at longer horizons. Random forest and XGBoost were less responsive initially but maintained more stable normalized error over longer horizons. For two-week forecasts at the end of the study period, training on the most recent data outperformed using longer historical periods, particularly for XGBoost. MLAMA achieved the lowest normalized mean absolute percentage error across most forecast horizons and ranked among the best-performing methods across responsiveness settings. These findings support selecting forecasting models according to operating conditions rather than relying on a single universally preferred approach. MLAMA provides a practical framework for combining complementary statistical and machine-learning forecasts. The accompanying Python package is currently maintained in a private repository while software validation and reproducibility testing are completed.
summary_zh: 公共卫生预测必须在不对噪声、报告伪影或临时趋势过度外推的前提下，快速响应监测数据的突变。本研究使用2020年1月至2023年10月安大略省公开的190周COVID-19病例计数观测数据，对ARIMA、随机森林和XGBoost（极端梯度提升）三类模型开展评估。滚动原点时间序列交叉验证在模型调优和评估过程中保留了时间顺序。本研究从三个运行维度评估模型性能：选定拐点后的响应能力、1至6周的预测时长、历史训练数据的规模。我们还开发了MLAMA（机器学习与ARIMA模型平均）方法，这是一种非负性能加权集成模型，其权重随预测时长和响应设置动态变化。回顾性对比结果显示，ARIMA在拐点后适配速度快，但归一化误差随预测时长增加而上升；随机森林和XGBoost初始响应能力较弱，但在更长预测周期内归一化误差更稳定。在研究末期的两周预测任务中，使用最新数据训练的效果优于使用更长历史周期训练的效果，对XGBoost而言尤其明显。MLAMA在绝大多数预测时长下取得了最低的归一化平均绝对百分比误差，且在所有响应设置下均属于性能最优的方法梯队。上述结果表明，应当根据运行条件选择预测模型，而非依赖单一通用的最优方案。MLAMA为融合互补的统计预测与机器学习预测提供了实用框架。配套的Python软件包目前存储在私有仓库中，待完成软件验证和可复现性测试后将公开。

title: Robust Discovery of Coarse-Grained Continuum Equations from Microscopic Dynamics
title_zh: 从微观动力学鲁棒发现粗粒度连续介质方程
authors: Partha Sarathi Mondal, Manav Kumar Jalan, Anish Kumar, Shradha Mishra
abstract: The discovery of governing partial differential equations (PDEs) directly from spatiotemporal data has emerged as a powerful tool for understanding the dynamics of complex systems. In this work, we apply PDE-SINDy to well-known phase-separating systems and examine how its performance depends on the amount of available data, the size of the function library, and the presence of noise. Our results show that the accuracy of equation discovery depends strongly on the amount of available data. Although the correct equation can be identified with limited data, several spurious terms also acquire finite selection probabilities. As the amount of data increases, these spurious terms are progressively suppressed, leading to a more robust identification of the governing equation. In contrast, increasing the size of the function library adversely affects the efficiency of equation discovery. Further, for the Glauber spin-flip Ising model, we show that the selection probabilities reveal a hierarchy of equations with varying levels of complexity. A sufficiently stringent selection threshold recovers a Model-A-like dynamical equation that accurately reproduces the dynamical and statistical features of phase separation and domain growth.
summary_zh: 直接从时空数据中推导控制偏微分方程（PDE）已成为理解复杂系统动力学的有力工具。本研究将PDE-SINDy方法应用于经典的相分离系统，考察其性能对可用数据量、函数库规模和噪声存在情况的依赖关系。结果表明，方程发现的精度高度依赖可用数据量：尽管在数据有限的情况下也能识别出正确方程，但多个伪项也会获得非零的选择概率；随着数据量增加，这些伪项会被逐步抑制，最终实现对控制方程的更鲁棒识别。与之相对，扩大函数库规模会对方程发现的效率产生负面影响。此外，针对Glauber自旋翻转伊辛模型，我们证明选择概率可揭示复杂度层级不同的多套方程；设置足够严格的选择阈值可恢复类似Model-A的动力学方程，该方程能够精准复现相分离和畴生长的动力学与统计特征。

title: Interpretable Information-Decomposed Brain Graph Learning for fMRI-based Disease Diagnosis
title_zh: 面向fMRI疾病诊断的可解释信息分解脑图学习
authors: Dengyi Zhao, Zhiheng Zhou, Zihan Wang, Guiying Yan, Xingqin Qi
abstract: Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) has enabled non-invasive mapping of functional brain interactions for computer-aided diagnosis, yet most existing approaches reduce inter-regional relationships to correlation-based edge weights. Such representations capture co-fluctuation strength but obscure how information is shared across brain regions. Because brain disorders may disrupt not only connectivity strength but also the organization of redundancy, uniqueness and synergy, traditional functional connectivity may miss disease-relevant information structures. Here we introduce IID-GCN, an interpretable graph learning framework that decomposes rs-fMRI interactions into redundancy, uniqueness and synergy graphs using partial entropy decomposition. These information-specific graphs separately characterize shared, region-specific and jointly emergent components of brain activity. A multi-channel graph convolutional network then integrates the decomposed graphs through edge recalibration, cross-information interaction, ROI-attention readout and channel-attentive fusion. Across three datasets, IID-GCN consistently captures complementary diagnostic information beyond traditional functional connectivity. The learned information profiles reveal disorder-specific patterns of altered redundancy, uniqueness and synergy, suggesting that brain diseases reshape functional information organization rather than merely changing connection strength. These results establish information-decomposed brain graphs as an interpretable representation for rs-fMRI-based diagnosis. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zdy12/IID-GCN.
summary_zh: 静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）为计算机辅助诊断提供了脑功能交互的非侵入式映射手段，但现有多数方法将脑区间关系简化为基于相关性的边权重。这类表征仅能捕捉共波动强度，却掩盖了脑区间的信息共享机制。由于脑疾病不仅可能破坏连接强度，还会改变冗余性、独特性和协同性的组织结构，传统功能连通性可能遗漏与疾病相关的信息结构。本文提出IID-GCN，这是一种可解释的图学习框架，通过偏熵分解将rs-fMRI交互分解为冗余图、独特性图和协同图三类信息专属图，分别表征脑活动的共享成分、脑区专属成分和联合涌现成分。随后通过多通道图卷积网络，经边重校准、跨信息交互、ROI注意力读出和通道注意力融合对分解后的多类图进行整合。在三个数据集上的实验结果显示，IID-GCN能够持续捕捉到传统功能连通性之外的互补诊断信息。学习得到的信息图谱揭示了不同疾病对应的冗余性、独特性和协同性改变的特异性模式，表明脑疾病重塑的是功能信息组织结构，而非仅仅改变连接强度。上述结果证明信息分解脑图可作为基于rs-fMRI诊断的可解释表征方案，相关代码已开源至https://github.com/Zdy12/IID-GCN。

title: If It Walks Like an Arbitrage: Protocol-Agnostic Detection with Decidable Structural Equivalence
title_zh: 形似套利即套利：具备可判定结构等价性的协议无关检测
authors: Adam Khayam, Hamid Kolli, Mohamed Iguernalala, \c{C}agdas Bozman
abstract: Ethereum transactions admit a canonical structural form. Each execution trace is built into an abstract syntax tree of token transfers grouped by call-frame nesting and reduced by a convergent term rewriting system of 15 rules to a unique canonical form. The system is terminating, sound, and confluent, and the induced structural equivalence on fund flows is decidable. All five properties are mechanized in Rocq with zero admitted obligations. The canonical form makes structural questions about fund flows decidable, opening the way to strategy-family classification, bot fingerprinting, and equivalence-based attribution. In this paper, we demonstrate the canonical form on arbitrage detection: cycles emerge at fixpoint and are read off the canonical form, with no protocol-specific patterns. The pipeline depends only on the standard ERC token and WETH ABIs and no protocol-specific events, so the same binary runs unmodified on Arbitrum and BSC. We evaluate on 220 000 Ethereum blocks against Eigenphi (production MEV platform) and on 1 000 shared blocks against ArbiNet (GNN classifier). The system produces 469 801 confirmed detections and 245 497 attempted arbitrages; across all detections it agrees with Eigenphi on 83.5% and covers 81% of ArbiNet, while surfacing 60 199 exclusive confirmed detections. 99.2% of all detections are produced by the fixpoint alone and are sound by construction. Manual validation of 500 transactions finds no false positives in the confirmed tier. Forensic reanalysis of 200 Eigenphi-exclusive detections finds 63.5% have no cycle in canonical form; 9.0% have cycles the fixpoint detects but our conservative classifier does n
summary_zh: 以太坊交易存在标准的规范结构形式：每条执行轨迹都会被构建为按调用栈嵌套关系分组的代币转移抽象语法树，再通过包含15条规则的收敛项重写系统约简为唯一的规范形式。该系统具备终止性、可靠性和合流性三大特性，由此导出的资金流结构等价关系是可判定的。上述全部五项性质均已在Rocq中完成机械化验证，不存在任何未证明的假设。规范形式使得资金流相关的结构问题具备可判定性，为策略族分类、机器人指纹识别和基于等价性的溯源提供了可能。本文将该规范形式应用于套利检测场景：套利循环会在不动点处显现，可直接从规范形式中读取，无需依赖任何协议专属模式。该检测流水线仅依赖标准ERC代币和WETH的ABI，不涉及任何协议专属事件，因此同一套程序无需修改即可在Arbitrum和BSC上运行。研究基于22万块以太坊区块与生产级MEV平台Eigenphi开展对比，基于1000个共享区块与GNN分类器ArbiNet开展对比，系统共输出469801条确认套利检测结果和245497条套利尝试检测结果：所有检测结果中与Eigenphi的重合度达83.5%，覆盖了ArbiNet结果的81%，还额外发现了60199条未被其他系统覆盖的确认套利结果。99.2%的检测结果仅由不动点模块生成，天然具备可靠性。对500笔交易的人工验证显示，确认套利层级不存在误报。对200条Eigenphi专属检测结果的取证重分析发现，其中63.5%的交易在规范形式下不存在循环，9.0%的交易存在不动点可识别的循环，但本研究的保守分类器未将其判定为套利。

title: TH-GNN: Heterogeneous Temporal Graph Neural Networks for LLM-Agent Shilling Attack Detection
title_zh: TH-GNN：面向大语言模型智能体水军攻击检测的异质时序图神经网络
authors: Shivam Swarup, Divya Prakash Shrivastava, Rakesh Thakur
abstract: LLM agents can now generate realistic shilling profiles, fluent reviews, and coherent ratings at scale, systematically defeating recommender-system defenses. Text-only detectors that flag semantic drift in review embeddings are blind to graph structure and temporal coordination, while graph-only detectors that exploit neighborhood anomalies cannot reason over review semantics or the cross-modal inconsistencies produced by LLM-generated content. We propose TH-GNN, a heterogeneous temporal graph neural network with a two-layer Heterogeneous Graph Transformer backbone that applies per-type and per-relation attention augmented with learnable sinusoidal temporal encodings on every edge. Cross-modal attention fuses structural user embeddings with frozen RoBERTa representations of reviews and item descriptions, while a GRU operating over log inter-arrival times captures temporal burstiness. Evaluated across five attack families and four benchmark datasets, TH-GNN achieves a grand-mean F1 score of 0.870, outperforming the strongest text-only baseline on Agent4SR attacks by 10.9 percentage points and 11.5 percentage points at the lowest injection rate. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly modeling temporal, structural, and semantic signals for detecting sophisticated LLM-driven shilling attacks.
summary_zh: 当前大语言模型（LLM）智能体可批量生成高度逼真的水军账号资料、流畅的评论和合理的评分，系统性突破推荐系统的防御机制。仅基于文本的检测器通过识别评论嵌入的语义漂移标记攻击，无法利用图结构和时序协同特征；仅基于图的检测器利用邻域异常识别攻击，却无法理解评论文本语义和大语言模型生成内容带来的跨模态不一致性。本文提出TH-GNN，这是一种异质时序图神经网络，采用双层异质图Transformer作为骨干网络，在每条边上添加按类型和关系定制的注意力机制，并辅以可学习的正弦时序编码。跨模态注意力模块将结构用户嵌入与冻结的RoBERTa生成的评论、商品描述表征相融合，基于对数到达间隔时间的GRU模块则捕捉时序突发特征。在5类攻击家族和4个基准数据集上的评估结果显示，TH-GNN的总体平均F1值达0.870，在Agent4SR攻击场景下相比性能最优的纯文本基线提升10.9个百分点，在最低注入率场景下提升11.5个百分点。上述结果证明，联合建模时序、结构和语义信号可有效检测复杂的大语言模型驱动水军攻击。

title: Harmonic Torsional Diffusion for Protein-Ligand Flexible Docking
title_zh: RLVR中的多语言验证器偏差：基准、滚动诊断与跨语言选择瓶颈
authors: Maksim Zhdanov, Pavel Strashnov, Vladislav Kurenkov
abstract: Molecular docking requires reasoning jointly about ligand pose and protein flexibility. Most diffusion-based docking models predict torsional updates with generic Euclidean heads that ignore the periodic geometry of angular variables. This mismatch is especially limiting in flexible docking, where ligand conformations and pocket side chains co-adapt to form the bound complex. Here, we introduce Harmony, a harmonic torsional diffusion framework for flexible protein-ligand docking. Harmony parameterizes ligand and side-chain torsional score fields as derivatives of learned harmonic potentials on the circle, whose noise-level dependence is supplied analytically by the heat semigroup of variance-exploding diffusion on the torus. This construction makes periodicity explicit and gives the model a frequency-aware inductive bias over rotameric motion. On the PDBBind benchmark, Harmony improves ligand pose accuracy and pocket all-atom reconstruction over recent flexible docking methods. On PoseBusters, it improves the physical validity of generated complexes. Case studies on EBNA1 and KRAS G12D illustrate the method's behavior on a polar and a shallow binding site, respectively. Together, these results indicate that aligning the score parameterization with the geometry of the diffusion process is a simple and effective lever for improving flexible docking.
summary_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是训练大语言模型完成数学推理任务的主流方案，该方案默认答案验证器是与语言无关的奖励函数。本研究证明该假设在多语言场景下不成立：精确匹配类验证器会将格式和文字变体转化为与语言相关的假阴性奖励噪声。本文提出一套可复用的多语言RLVR奖励审计方案，包含验证器鲁棒性套件、滚动诊断流程，以及面向日语、英语、中文答案的语言条件奖励误差指标。在k=8的MGSM滚动测试中，精确匹配代理对可信正确答案的拒识率随语言不同存在显著差异，该现象在Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct三类模型上均有体现：对Qwen3-8B而言，日语答案的假阴性率达0.642，而英语和中文答案的假阴性率仅为0.122和0.073。纯数字探针将该机制定位到最终答案接口：接口模型可将奖励误差变分下界降至零，但不会改变剩余的精度差距。本文进一步揭示了跨语言选择瓶颈：在MGSM250滚动测试中，不依赖可信标签的目标端本地聚合规则可填补55%~78%的平均选择差距，超过95%的修复需要真正的跨语言支持。该瓶颈在包含483道题目的MATH-500数据集上同样存在。受控训练审计显示，规则化GRPO可提升可信精度，但奖励误差变分下界仍维持高位。本研究的实操性结论为：多语言RLVR奖励在优化前必须按语言和答案接口分别开展审计。

title: Multilingual Verifier Bias in RLVR: Benchmark, Rollout Diagnosis, and the Cross-Lingual Selection Bottleneck
authors: Chenyu Zhou, Qiliang Jiang, Xu Zhou
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a standard recipe for training large language models on mathematical reasoning, where an answer verifier serves as a language-neutral reward function. We show that this assumption fails in multilingual settings: an exact-match verifier turns format and script variation into language-dependent false-negative reward noise. We introduce a reusable protocol for auditing multilingual RLVR rewards: a verifier-robustness suite, a rollout-diagnosis procedure, and language-conditioned reward-error metrics for Japanese, English, and Chinese answers. On MGSM rollouts with k=8, the exact-match proxy rejects trusted-correct answers at sharply different rates by language across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; for Qwen3-8B, the false-negative rate reaches 0.642 on JP against 0.122 on EN and 0.073 on CN. A plain-numeric probe localizes the mechanism to the final-answer interface: an interface model drives reward-error VLB to zero while the residual accuracy gap is unchanged. We then expose a cross-lingual selection bottleneck: on MGSM250 rollouts, a target-local aggregation rule using no trusted labels closes 55-78% of the average selection gap, and over 95% of repairs require genuine cross-lingual support. The bottleneck replicates on a 483-problem MATH-500 set. A controlled training audit shows that rule-GRPO raises trusted accuracy while the reward-error VLB stays high. The unifying message is operational: multilingual RLVR rewards should be audited by language and by answer interface before they are optimized.

title: TriPLU: Bypassing the Gate with Direct Trilinear Product FFNs in Tiny Language Models
title_zh: TriPLU：微型语言模型中借助直接三线性乘积前馈网络绕过门控机制
authors: He Zhang
abstract: We study whether tiny decoder-only language models benefit from feed-forward layers that directly multiply learned feature projections. TriPLU, a Trilinear Product Linear Unit, replaces the usual gated FFN branch with a product-only degree-3 branch that multiplies three projected streams coordinatewise. In a character-level TinyStories 1M-byte prefix study, TriPLU reaches a mean best validation loss of 1.0637, compared with 1.1017 for closely matched SwiGLU, 1.0780 for a degree-4 product control, and 1.1026 for a degree-2 control. In train-only Byte-BPE experiments, TriPLU also lowers validation and heldout bits per byte on TinyStories and WikiText-2 raw under low-learning-rate settings, with PMI-slice evidence suggesting gains on seen middle- and high-PMI adjacent-token pairs. Constant-learning-rate diagnostics show that product-branch normalization can reduce the high-learning-rate best-checkpoint gap, although final BPB still degrades under hot schedules. The resulting claim is deliberately narrow: direct product FFNs can improve fixed-budget small-model loss in specific low-compute regimes, but the branch is optimization-sensitive and does not establish FLOP-normalized efficiency, scaling behavior, or broad LLM performance.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨仅包含解码器的微型语言模型能否从直接对学习到的特征投影做乘积运算的前馈层中获益。TriPLU（三线性乘积线性单元）用仅包含乘积运算的3阶分支替换常规的门控前馈网络分支，该分支对三个投影后的特征流按坐标做乘积运算。在字符级TinyStories 1MB前缀测试中，TriPLU的平均最优验证损失达1.0637，性能优于对照的SwiGLU（1.1017）、4阶乘积对照组（1.0780）和2阶乘积对照组（1.1026）。在仅训练的Byte-BPE实验中，在低学习率设置下，TriPLU在TinyStories和WikiText-2原始数据集上的验证集和留出集每字节比特数均更低，PMI切片结果显示其性能提升来自已见过的中高PMI相邻词对。恒定学习率诊断显示，乘积分支归一化可缩小高学习率下最优检查点的性能差距，尽管在高学习率调度下最终每字节比特数仍会下降。本研究的结论范围明确：直接乘积前馈网络可在特定低计算资源场景下，在固定计算预算下降低小模型的损失，但该分支对优化过程敏感，无法证明其具备FLOP归一化效率、良好的缩放行为或通用大语言模型层面的性能优势。

title: Exploratory As-Analyzed No-Detection of Culturally-Marked Predicate-Triggered PII Amplification in a Synthetic-English RAG Probe: A Predicate-Resource-Confounded Audit
title_zh: 合成英语RAG探测中未检测到文化标记谓词触发的PII放大效应的探索性分析：谓词资源混杂审计
authors: Yanhang Li, Zhichao Fan, Zexin Zhuang
abstract: We ask whether stereotype-loaded queries about culturally marked people leak more personal information from a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system than otherwise-equivalent neutral queries. We pre-register a four-culture audit (en-Anglo, es-LATAM, Arabic, Hindi) on a synthetic English PII corpus, comparing five query arms we call the Stereotype-Trigger Leakage Delta (STLD). Two caveats up front. Our locked confirmatory estimator was never run, so every test in the paper is exploratory or sensitivity, with all plan deviations listed in the appendix. And the name-leakage metric is contaminated by a prompt-echo artifact: the model often just re-emits the name we asked about, which inflates apparent leakage without any retrieval at all. On the cleaner channels (email, phone, ssn-like, address), we find no stereotype-driven amplification on any of the four cultures after multiple-comparison correction. Because our sample is only powered for mid-sized effects, and because the culturally marked probes mix stereotype content with cultural markers and heritage practices, we present this as no detection, not evidence of no effect, of culturally marked predicate leakage that is confounded with the underlying resource.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨检索增强生成（RAG）系统中，针对文化标记人群的带刻板印象查询是否会比等价的中性查询泄露更多个人可识别信息（PII）。我们预先注册了覆盖四类文化（盎格鲁英语、拉丁美洲西班牙语、阿拉伯语、印地语）的审计方案，在合成英语PII语料上对比五组查询分支的差异，将该指标命名为刻板印象触发泄露差值（STLD）。本文预先说明两点限制：我们预设的验证估计器从未运行，因此论文中所有测试均为探索性测试或敏感性测试，所有偏离原计划的内容均列在附录中；姓名泄露指标受到提示词回显伪影的干扰，模型经常直接复现查询中提到的姓名，导致无需检索即可观测到虚假的泄露量。在更干净的泄露通道（邮箱、电话、类SSN编号、地址）上，经过多重比较校正后，我们未在四类文化中发现任何由刻板印象驱动的泄露放大效应。由于本研究的统计效力仅支持检测中等规模的效应，且文化标记探测样本将刻板印象内容与文化标记、文化习俗混杂在一起，因此本研究仅报告未检测到效应，而非证明不存在与底层资源混杂的文化标记谓词泄露效应。

title: Bankruptcy Prediction via Hybrid Resampling and Stacking Ensemble Techniques with Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI)-Driven Analysis
title_zh: 基于混合重采样与堆叠集成技术、结合可解释人工智能（XAI）驱动分析的破产预测
authors: Obu-Amoah Ampomah, Edmund Fosu Agyemang, Kofi Acheampong, Louis Agyekum, Enock Adu Bonsu, Eric Nyarko
abstract: This study develops and evaluates a bankruptcy prediction framework that integrates consensus-based feature selection, hybrid resampling, stacking ensembles, and explainable artificial intelligence to improve minority-class detection in severely imbalanced financial data. Using the Taiwanese Bankruptcy Prediction dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository, five feature-selection algorithms were first applied, and a consensus retention rule reduced the input space to 23 robust variables. The balanced training data were then generated using SVM-SMOTE, SMOTE-Tomek, and SMOTE-ENN. Five ensemble machine learning classifiers, namely gradient boosting, extreme gradient boosting, histogram-based gradient boosting, LightGBM, and AdaBoost, were compared with five deep learning models, including RNN, LSTM, GRU, DNN, and MLP. In addition, hybrid stacking ensembles combined the five machine learning classifiers as base learners with each deep learning model as a meta-learner. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, recall, specificity, G-mean, and ROC-AUC, while SHAP was used to explain feature contributions. The results show that resampling strategy materially shaped model behavior. SVM-SMOTE and SMOTE-Tomek favored accuracy and specificity, whereas SMOTE-ENN delivered stronger minority-class detection. Among standalone models, the GRU with SMOTE-ENN achieved the best overall predictive balance, with recall of 0.8627, G-mean of 0.8517, and ROC-AUC of 0.9431. Among stacking ensembles, SMOTE-ENN with (GB+XGB+HGB+LGBM+AB)+LSTM provided the strongest compromise between sensitivity and specificity. SHAP analysis identified leverage, profitability, solvency, and operational efficiency indicators as the most influential predictors of bankruptcy risk. These findings support more reliable and interpretable early warning systems for financially distressed firms.
summary_zh: 本研究开发并评估了一套融合共识特征选择、混合重采样、堆叠集成和可解释人工智能的破产预测框架，旨在提升高度不平衡金融数据下的少数类检测性能。研究使用UCI机器学习库中的台湾破产预测数据集，首先应用五种特征选择算法，通过共识保留规则将输入空间缩减至23个鲁棒变量。随后使用SVM-SMOTE、SMOTE-Tomek和SMOTE-ENN三种方法生成平衡训练数据。研究对比了梯度提升、极端梯度提升、直方图梯度提升、LightGBM和AdaBoost五种集成机器学习分类器，以及RNN、LSTM、GRU、DNN和MLP五种深度学习模型。此外，混合堆叠集成方案将五种机器学习分类器作为基学习器，分别与每类深度学习模型作为元学习器组合。研究使用准确率、召回率、特异度、G均值和ROC-AUC评估模型性能，使用SHAP方法解释特征贡献。结果显示，重采样策略显著影响模型行为：SVM-SMOTE和SMOTE-Tomek更有利于提升准确率和特异度，而SMOTE-ENN可实现更优的少数类检测性能。在单模型中，搭配SMOTE-ENN的GRU取得了最优的整体预测平衡性，召回率达0.8627，G均值达0.8517，ROC-AUC达0.9431。在堆叠集成方案中，SMOTE-ENN搭配（GB+XGB+HGB+LGBM+AB）+LSTM的组合在灵敏度和特异度之间取得了最优的权衡。SHAP分析识别出杠杆率、盈利能力、偿付能力和运营效率指标是破产风险最具影响力的预测因子。上述研究结果可为构建更可靠、可解释的财务困境企业预警系统提供支撑。

title: Move by Move: Measuring and Steering How LLMs Conduct Psychotherapy
title_zh: 逐次干预：测量与引导大语言模型开展心理治疗的行为模式
authors: Afonso Baldo, Hugo Pitorro, Areti Vassilopoulos, Anabela C. Areias, Maya D'Eon, Fab\'iola Costa, Ricardo Rei, Nuno M. Guerreiro
abstract: Users increasingly turn to large language models for emotional support, yet little is known about how these models actually conduct a psychotherapy interaction. We introduce an ontology of ten therapeutic moves: compact, function-based categories grounded in the MULTI-60 inventory, validated through an annotation campaign with five licensed psychologists, and scaled with a judge-based approach that matches expert agreement. Applying it to real counseling transcripts and model-led sessions, we compare the move distributions between human clinicians and a panel of frontier models. Models over-use inquiry at up to three times the human rate, neglect psychoeducation, and are strongly context-anchored: they carry forward strategies initiated by a human clinician but rarely initiate them themselves. Exposing the ontology as a set of tools roughly halves the mean deviation from the human move distribution and improves turn-level alignment with human therapist by 7-9 percentage points, without any fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 用户越来越多地借助大语言模型获取情感支持，但目前学界对这类模型实际开展心理治疗交互的机制仍知之甚少。本文提出一套包含10类治疗动作的本体体系：该体系是基于功能划分的紧凑分类框架，以MULTI-60量表为基础，通过5名持牌心理学家的标注工作完成验证，并采用与专家标注一致性相当的基于裁判的方法完成规模化标注。将该体系应用于真实咨询转录文本与模型主导的会话数据后，我们对比了人类临床医师与一系列前沿模型的治疗动作分布。研究发现，大语言模型的询问类动作使用率最高可达人类的3倍，严重忽视心理教育类动作，且行为高度锚定上下文：它们会沿用人类临床医师发起的策略，但极少主动发起新策略。将该本体体系作为工具集向模型开放后，无需任何微调，模型与人类治疗师动作分布的平均偏差可降低约一半，回合层面与人类治疗师的对齐度可提升7-9个百分点。

title: Prompt-Model Interaction Reaches the Fixed Points: A deterministic, task-free structural readout -- and the factorizations of it that failed
title_zh: 提示-模型交互抵达不动点：无任务依赖的结构性读出及失效的因子分解方案
authors: Nicol\'as Vera Z\'u\~niga
abstract: That a prompt's effect is not a property of the prompt is established: prompts optimised for one model degrade on another, and rankings reorder under neutral reformatting. That evidence is about task accuracy, which cannot say whether the interaction is a fact about task machinery or about the conditional distribution itself. We ask on a readout with no task in it: the fixed-point structure of the short-window argmax map x_{t+1} = argmax_x p(x | x_{t-1}, x_t), censused from 96 starts. It is deterministic, so nothing can be helped or hurt, and it exists only at short windows -- four of six models lose it entirely by window 16 -- so everything here concerns how a model reads a fragment. Two results. First, the interaction reaches this readout at full magnitude: nine tokens of conditioning move the fixed-point fraction across most of its range, change a four-way structural class, and reorder models, while instruction tuning worth 60.5 IFEval points moves the class by zero. Second, nothing we proposed carries it. Prefix length fails: the effect is not monotone. Four phenomenological factors -- prose-versus-markup, a universal direction, bidirectionality, instruct-resistance -- were each withdrawn within one run of being proposed, dissolved by widening the sample. And the nearest mechanistic account, attention-sink dominance of early tokens, predicts the sign of the shift on 2 of 5 models -- chance -- while a length-by-content cross shows it holds on real text and fails on our probe's uniformly random input, so we are outside its regime, not against it. One fixed nine-token prefix drives four models toward 0 and two toward 1; the bidirectionality survives in-distribution starts. On this readout the unit of explanation is the prompt-model pair. The recurring error it caught in us has a name: a criterion with a shape applied to a quantity with no room to vary.
summary_zh: 学界已证实提示的效果并非提示本身的固有属性：针对某一模型优化的提示在其他模型上性能会下降，且在中性重格式化操作下提示效果的排序会发生变动。这类证据均围绕任务准确率展开，无法说明交互特性是任务机制的属性，还是条件分布本身的固有属性。本文基于完全不含任务的读出指标开展研究：即短窗口argmax映射x_{t+1} = argmax_x p(x | x_{t-1}, x_t)的不动点结构，该结构从96个初始样本中统计得到。该映射是确定性的，不存在可人为优化或损害的空间，且仅在短窗口下存在——6个测试模型中有4个在窗口长度达到16时完全失去该结构，因此本文所有结论均围绕模型读取文本片段的机制展开。本文得到两项核心结果：第一，提示-模型交互可完全作用于该读出指标：9个token的条件信息即可将不动点占比调整至其大部分取值区间，改变四类结构分类，还可重新排序不同模型的表现；而可带来60.5个IFEval得分提升的指令调优操作完全不会改变该结构分类。第二，我们提出的所有因子均无法解释该交互效应：前缀长度的影响不具备单调性，4种现象学因子（散文与标记语言差异、通用方向、双向性、指令抗性）均在扩大样本后失效。最接近的机制性解释——早期token的注意力沉没效应，仅能在5个模型中的2个上预测出正确的变动方向，表现等同于随机猜测；而长度-内容交叉实验显示该效应在真实文本上成立，但在探针的均匀随机输入上失效，说明我们的研究场景已经超出该理论的适用范围，而非与该理论直接矛盾。一个固定的9token前缀可驱动4个模型的不动点占比趋近于0，2个模型趋近于1；双向性效应在分布内初始样本中稳定存在。在该读出指标下，解释的基本单元是提示-模型配对。本研究过程中反复出现的认知偏差可总结为：将带有特定形态的评判标准套用到不存在可变空间的研究对象上。

title: Memory Augmentation Unlocks Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
title_zh: 记忆增强解锁高效思维链推理
authors: Simeng Zhang, Yilong Chen, Wenyuan Zhang, Zhenyu Zhang, Yao Chen, Junyuan Shang, Tingwen Liu
abstract: Large language models often rely on Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex tasks, but verbose reasoning traces introduce substantial inference overhead. CoT compression shortens generation, yet aggressive compression may disrupt logical coherence and degrade performance. We formalize this trade-off as the \textit{Context-Generation Substitution Law}, where explicit reasoning context substitutes for part of decode-time generation. Based on this principle, we propose \textit{Memory-Augmented Compression}, a training-free framework that constructs reusable reasoning memories from historical traces and retrieves them as prefill-side scaffolds. Rather than using raw demonstrations, these memories summarize reusable reasoning patterns, key constraints, and critical operations to compensate for information lost during compression. Experiments show that Memory consistently improves prompt-based Chain-of-Draft (CoD) compression across mathematical reasoning, complex reasoning, and science question answering tasks, yielding accuracy gains of 21.4, 28.0, 29.5, and 6.61 points over CoD on GSM8K, MATH, BBH, and MMLU-Sci, while achieving a 1.14--1.49$\times$ latency speedup over standard CoT. Memory is also compatible with token-level, reasoning-trace-level, and inference-state compression mechanisms. Further analyzes show that the gains come from relevant reasoning memories rather than simply increasing context length.
summary_zh: 大语言模型通常依赖思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）推理解决复杂任务，但冗长的推理轨迹会带来极高的推理开销。思维链压缩技术可缩短生成长度，但过度压缩可能破坏逻辑连贯性，造成性能下降。本文将该权衡关系形式化为上下文-生成替代定律：即显式推理上下文可替代部分解码阶段的生成内容。基于该原理，本文提出记忆增强压缩框架，这是一种无需额外训练的方法，可从历史推理轨迹中构建可复用的推理记忆，将其作为预填充侧的脚手架使用。这类记忆并非直接使用原始演示样本，而是对可复用的推理模式、关键约束和核心操作进行总结，用于补偿压缩过程中丢失的信息。实验结果表明，该记忆增强方法可在数学推理、复杂推理、科学问答等任务上持续提升基于提示的草稿链（Chain-of-Draft, CoD）压缩性能：在GSM8K、MATH、BBH、MMLU-Sci数据集上相比原生CoD分别带来21.4、28.0、29.5、6.61的准确率提升，同时相比标准思维链实现1.14~1.49倍的延迟加速。该记忆增强方案还可与token级、推理轨迹级、推理状态级的各类压缩机制兼容。进一步分析显示，性能提升来源于相关推理记忆的作用，而非单纯的上下文长度增加。

title: Benchmarking Patent Drafting from Inventor-Style Disclosures
title_zh: 面向发明人风格披露文本的专利起草基准测试
authors: Lekang Jiang, Wenjun Sun, Stephan Goetz
abstract: While recent large language models (LLMs) have achieved promising results on individual patent drafting tasks, they fundamentally fail to investigate the core challenge of real-world patent drafting: generating a complete and legally coherent patent application directly from early-stage invention materials. Prior work predominantly assumes later-stage, highly structured, or already legalistic inputs. However, real patenting workflows begin with informal, de-legalized disclosures authored by inventors. To bridge the gap, we introduce Dis2Pat, a disclosure-to-patent dataset that reflects realistic patenting workflows by requiring the generation of complete patent applications directly from inventor-style, de-legalized disclosures. Given the inherent difficulty of long-form, legally constrained patent drafting and the strong privacy requirements, we further propose a strong baseline named Patent-MAF. It is a multi-agent framework for locally deployable patent drafting. Benchmark results reveal that current LLMs exhibit limitations in patent drafting, while Patent-MAF provides a strong baseline that consistently outperforms evaluated open-source models and remains competitive with large closed-source models.
summary_zh: 尽管当前大语言模型在单项专利起草任务上已经取得了不错的效果，但始终未能解决真实世界专利起草的核心挑战：直接从早期阶段的发明材料生成完整、具备法律连贯性的专利申请文件。现有相关工作大多假设输入是后期阶段、高度结构化、已经符合法律规范的文本，但真实的专利工作流程始于发明人撰写的非正式、去法律化的披露文档。为填补这一差距，本文提出Dis2Pat数据集，这是一个从披露文本到专利的数据集，要求模型直接从发明人风格的去法律化披露文本生成完整专利申请，完全还原真实专利工作流程。考虑到长文本、法律约束下专利起草的固有难度，以及相关数据的强隐私要求，本文进一步提出名为Patent-MAF的强基线模型，这是一个支持本地部署的多智能体专利起草框架。基准测试结果显示，当前大语言模型在专利起草任务上存在明显局限性，而Patent-MAF作为强基线，性能持续优于所有参评的开源模型，且可与大型闭源模型的表现相竞争。

title: Affective Context Amplifies Sycophancy in LLM Responses
authors: Jiayi Li, Sanjana Menon, Brett Frischmann, Shomir Wilson, Sarah Rajtmajer
abstract: As conversational companions, large language models (LLMs) often have access to users' emotional states. We study how this affective context modulates LLM sycophancy in subjective, evaluative interactions, where users share actions or opinions that invite feedback. Drawing on ingratiation theory, we measure sycophancy as the divergence between a model's independent evaluation and its user-facing response, elicited by presenting the same content as either a third-party account or the user's own disclosure. Across seven LLMs and two Reddit datasets (r/AmItheAsshole and r/TrueUnpopularOpinion), we find that this divergence is systematic and strongly one-directional. User-facing responses consistently soften or withhold negative or oppositional judgments. Affective context further amplifies this divergence with negative states, particularly loneliness and distress, producing the largest effects. These findings suggest that affective context functions as a vulnerability signal that suppresses critical feedback when users may need it most, often through evasive sycophancy, in which models retreat toward non-committal responses rather than outright agreement.

title: RARE: Decoupling Representation Steering from Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
title_zh: RARE：在混合专家语言模型中解耦表示引导与专家路由
authors: Zhibo Zhang, Zhen Ouyang, Ling Shi, Kailong Wang
abstract: Representation engineering offers a lightweight means of controlling language-model behavior by modifying intermediate hidden states, but its direct application to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models introduces a structural mismatch. We first verify this failure mode through a series of empirical studies and find that preserving clean routing substantially recovers steering performance and that routing is more sensitive to semantic content than to behavioral changes under controlled content. Motivated by these findings, we introduce RARE, a router-agnostic representation engineering framework for MoE language models. RARE projects arbitrary behavioral perturbations onto the null space of the router matrix, thereby removing router-visible components, and further corrects routing drift propagated to selected downstream layers. To decide the best perturbation estimator in this framework, we evaluate five estimators on six heterogeneous open-weight MoE models across three steering scenarios: harmfulness, truthfulness, and factual editing. On harmfulness steering, RARE reaches an average attack success rate of 53.3% while retaining 67.8% MMLU accuracy, yielding a stronger aggregate effectiveness--utility trade-off than baselines. It further improves average TruthfulQA MC1 accuracy from 41.0% to 58.6% and CounterFact efficacy from 16.8% to 96.3%. These results support routing consistency as an important architectural consideration for adapting representation engineering to MoE models.
summary_zh: 表示工程是一种通过修改中间隐藏状态控制语言模型行为的轻量方法，但直接将其应用于混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）模型会出现结构不匹配问题。本文通过一系列实证研究验证了该失效模式，发现保留路由的清洁性可大幅恢复表示引导的性能，且在内容受控的条件下，路由对语义内容的敏感度远高于对行为变更的敏感度。受该发现启发，本文提出RARE框架，这是一种与路由无关的混合专家语言模型表示工程框架。RARE将任意行为扰动投影到路由矩阵的零空间中，从而移除扰动中可被路由感知的分量，还可进一步修正传播到下游选定层的路由漂移。为确定框架内最优的扰动估计器，本文在6个异构开源混合专家模型上，针对有害内容引导、真实性提升、事实编辑三类引导场景评估了5种估计器的效果。在有害内容引导任务上，RARE的平均攻击成功率可达53.3%，同时保留67.8%的MMLU准确率，相比基线实现了更优的效果-效用权衡。该方法还将TruthfulQA MC1的平均准确率从41.0%提升至58.6%，将CounterFact的编辑有效性从16.8%提升至96.3%。上述结果表明，路由一致性是将表示工程适配到混合专家模型时需要重点考虑的架构要素。

title: When the Feature Pool Goes Algorithmic: Extending Mufwene's Ecology of Language Evolution to LLM-Mediated Exposure
title_zh: 当特征池走向算法化：将Mufwene的语言进化生态学模型扩展至大语言模型介导的语言接触场景
authors: Kunmei Han
abstract: Mufwene's ecological model locates language evolution in competition among variants contributed by individual idiolects and in speakers' selection from linguistic material made available through interaction. Large language models (LLMs) complicate this architecture without requiring the locus of selection to move away from human speakers. This article argues that LLMs are best treated as distributional mediators: they aggregate language produced across human populations, transform its distribution through training and post-training, and redistribute model-specific outputs at scale. I call the resulting ecological process algorithmic reweighting of the speaker-accessible distribution: model mediation can alter the relative frequencies with which competing variants reach human selectors. Emerging evidence on model-specific linguistic profiles and lexical uptake is consistent with parts of this pathway, but does not establish inevitable convergence. Human social evaluation remains decisive: model-associated forms may diffuse and become conventionalized, become socially recognizable as 'AI-like' and subsequently avoided, or fail to diffuse in the first place. The proposal extends Mufwene's feature-pool ecology one step upstream of speaker selection and yields testable predictions about uptake, model-version effects, convergence, and social reversal.
summary_zh: Mufwene提出的语言进化生态学模型将语言进化的动因归于不同个体方言贡献的语言变体之间的竞争，以及说话人从交互过程中获取的语言材料中做出的选择。大语言模型并未将选择的核心主体从人类说话人处移走，而是让该架构变得更加复杂。本文提出，大语言模型最适合被定位为分布中介：它们聚合全人类产出的语言数据，通过训练和后训练过程改变语言分布，再大规模重新分发模型生成的特有输出。本文将由此产生的生态过程称为说话人可访问分布的算法重加权：模型介导可改变不同竞争变体触达人类选择者的相对频率。当前已有的关于模型特有语言特征、词汇采纳的初步证据与该路径的部分推论吻合，但并不意味着必然会出现语言趋同。人类的社会评价仍然是决定性因素：模型关联的语言形式可能扩散并成为通用规范，也可能被社会识别为“类AI”特征后遭到规避，甚至从一开始就完全无法扩散。本文提出的理论将Mufwene的特征池生态学框架向说话人选择的上游延伸了一步，可产出关于语言采纳、模型版本效应、趋同现象、社会反向选择的可验证预测。

title: Jokes Aside: Measuring the Semantic Distance of Double Meanings
title_zh: 玩笑之外：测量双关语义的语义距离
authors: Fabio De Ponte
abstract: Large language models have significantly enriched the toolkit for computational humor research, particularly in the automated generation of jokes and puns. A key innovation, contextual embedding vectors, offers new opportunities to revisit and refine earlier hypotheses. Notably, Petrovic and Matthews (2013) proposed a joke generation model based on the scheme "I like my X like I like my Y, Z" (e.g. "I like my ice like I like my dreams, crushed"). They suggested that joke hilarity increases with: a) frequent association of Z with X and Y, b) rarity of Z, c) ambiguity of Z, and d) meaning distance between X and Y. Building on this, Winters et al. (2019) proposed a set of metrics, based on Google Ngrams and Word2Vector. In this work, three out of their five metrics are revisited with word embeddings: obviousness, compatibility, and comparison. Another measure, symmetry, defined as closeness of Z to both X and Y, is introduced here for the first time. Two models were used to collect the embedding vectors (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small and MiniLM all-MiniLM-L6-v2) on three datasets: JokeJudger, Expunations, and rJokes. The last two datasets, Expunations, and rJokes, were expanded by adding paired sentences that captured the ambiguous expression at the core of each joke in its two different meanings. Results revealed that models trained on the proposed metrics performed poorly in predicting humor ratings: on JokeJudger, the best model achieved 57.1% accuracy, below the 61.5% baseline, while performance on Expunations and rJokes was even lower. Nevertheless, the symmetry metric seems consistently associated with higher-rated jokes, suggesting it may capture a necessary -though not sufficient- property of humor.
summary_zh: 大语言模型极大丰富了计算幽默研究的工具集，尤其在笑话和双关语的自动生成领域。上下文嵌入向量这一关键创新，为重新审视和完善早期研究假设提供了新的机会。值得注意的是，Petrovic and Matthews (2013)提出了基于“我喜欢我的X就像我喜欢我的Y一样，Z”句式的笑话生成模型（例如“我喜欢我的冰就像我喜欢我的梦一样，碎碎的”），他们提出笑话的好笑程度随以下四个因素提升：a) Z与X、Y的关联频率高，b) Z本身的稀有度高，c) Z的歧义性高，d) X与Y之间的语义距离大。在此基础上，Winters et al. (2019)基于Google Ngrams和Word2Vector提出了一组度量指标。本研究使用词嵌入重新审视了他们提出的5项指标中的3项：易懂性、兼容性和对比性，还首次提出了对称性指标，定义为Z与X、Y两者的接近程度。研究使用OpenAI text-embedding-3-small和MiniLM all-MiniLM-L6-v2两个模型在JokeJudger、Expunations、rJokes三个数据集上收集嵌入向量，其中后两个数据集Expunations和rJokes都新增了配对句子，用于捕捉每个笑话核心歧义表达的两种不同含义。结果显示，基于本文提出的指标训练的模型在幽默评分预测任务上表现不佳：在JokeJudger数据集上最优模型的准确率仅为57.1%，低于61.5%的基线水平，在Expunations和rJokes数据集上的表现甚至更差。尽管如此，对称性指标始终与更高评分的笑话显著相关，说明该指标可能捕捉到了幽默的一项必要非充分属性。

title: Evidence-Consistent Generative Detection under Scenario-Level Distribution Shift
title_zh: 场景级分布偏移下的证据一致生成式检测
authors: San Kim, JinYeong Bak
abstract: Conventional in-distribution evaluation can overestimate robustness when training and test data share recurring task-specific patterns or surface cues. This risk is especially relevant in social-engineering fraud detection, where attackers can preserve malicious intent while changing the scenario, impersonated entity, or wording. We study this problem as scenario-level out-of-distribution (SL-OOD) detection for SMS and voice phishing, where entire attack scenarios are held out from training while the label space remains fixed. This setting tests whether models can generalize to unseen attack scenarios using decision-relevant evidence rather than familiar scenario-specific cues. Using this SL-OOD evaluation, we find that high in-distribution performance does not reliably predict held-out robustness across feature-, encoder-, and decoder-based baselines. We interpret this gap as scenario memorization: reliance on recurring scenario-specific lexical or entity cues rather than decision-relevant evidence. We propose ECoG, an evidence-consistent generative framework that combines evidence-span supervision with a rationale-label consistency objective during training. On the 0.5B decoder, relative to the same backbone trained without consistency regularization, ECoG raises Macro-F1 on OOD challenging instances by 3.22 points, reduces the share of predictions whose generated rationale supports the opposite label by 4.22 points, and increases token-level overlap with reference evidence spans by 8.38 points; the reduction in prediction-rationale inconsistency is consistent across four decoder backbones. These results suggest that compact generative detectors can benefit from evidence supervision and rationale-label consistency under social-engineering shift.
summary_zh: 当训练集和测试集共享重复的任务特定模式或表面线索时，传统的分布内评估会高估模型的鲁棒性。该风险在社工欺诈检测场景中尤为突出：攻击者可以在保留恶意意图的前提下，改变攻击场景、伪装身份或措辞。本文将该问题定义为面向短信和语音钓鱼的场景级分布外（SL-OOD）检测任务：训练集中完全不包含某些完整攻击场景，标签空间保持固定。该设置可测试模型是否能基于与决策相关的证据泛化到从未见过的攻击场景，而非依赖熟悉的场景特定线索。基于该SL-OOD评估范式，我们发现，在基于特征、编码器、解码器的各类基线模型中，分布内的高表现并不能可靠预测模型在留出场景上的鲁棒性。我们将该性能差距解释为场景记忆效应：模型依赖重复出现的场景特定词汇或实体线索，而非与决策相关的证据。本文提出ECoG框架，这是一个证据一致的生成式检测框架，训练过程中结合了证据跨度监督和基本原理-标签一致性目标。在0.5B参数量的解码器模型上，与未加入一致性正则化的同骨干模型相比，ECoG将分布外困难样本的Macro-F1值提升了3.22个百分点，将生成的基本原理支持相反标签的预测占比降低了4.22个百分点，将与参考证据跨度的token级重叠度提升了8.38个百分点；预测-基本原理不一致性的降低效果在4个不同的解码器骨干上均稳定成立。上述结果表明，在社工攻击分布偏移场景下，轻量生成式检测器可从证据监督和基本原理-标签一致性约束中获益。

title: Scaling Unsupervised Word Alignment to Documents via Structural Constraints
title_zh: 通过结构约束将无监督词对齐扩展至文档级别
authors: Michelle Wastl, Jannis Vamvas, Rico Sennrich
abstract: Word alignment has traditionally been studied between sentences, but many cross-lingual tasks increasingly require correspondences across full documents. While recent multilingual embedding models can encode long inputs, we show that applying algorithms designed for sentences directly to documents leads to performance degradation. To address this, we introduce CTFAlign, a lightweight, training-free approach for document-level word alignment. CTFAlign applies a coarse-to-fine refinement strategy that restricts the alignment search space to semantically similar regions. Additionally, we introduce MDPAlign, a simpler alternative that constrains alignments by position with a main diagonal prior. Both approaches operate directly on full documents without relying on sentence segmentation or sentence alignment. We evaluate these methods across six language pairs varying in typological distance, resourcedness, and document length. Averaged over three models, CTFAlign reduces word alignment error rate from 0.412 to 0.326. These gains transfer downstream, leading to improvements in document-level translation coverage evaluation and recognition of semantic differences. We release CTFAlign as a Python package and make the code and data to reproduce our experiments publicly available.
summary_zh: 传统词对齐研究大多聚焦于句子层级，但越来越多的跨语言任务需要实现完整文档层面的词对应关系。尽管最新的多语言嵌入模型可以编码长输入，我们的研究显示，直接将为句子设计的对齐算法应用到文档上会导致性能下降。为解决该问题，本文提出CTFAlign，这是一种轻量、无需额外训练的文档级词对齐方法。CTFAlign采用由粗到细的优化策略，将对齐搜索空间限制在语义相似的区域内。此外本文还提出更简单的替代方案MDPAlign，该方法通过主对角线先验对对齐结果施加位置约束。两种方法都可直接在完整文档上运行，无需依赖句子切分或句子对齐结果。我们在6个语言对上对两类方法开展评估，覆盖不同类型距离、资源丰富度和文档长度的场景。在3个测试模型上取平均后，CTFAlign将词对齐错误率从0.412降至0.326。该性能提升可迁移到下游任务中，改善文档级翻译覆盖度评估和语义差异识别的效果。我们已将CTFAlign作为Python包开源，可公开获取复现实验所需的代码和数据。

title: ForeDreamer: A Self-Evolving Dual-Agent Memory Architecture for Future Event Prediction
title_zh: ForeDreamer：面向未来事件预测的自进化双智能体记忆架构
authors: Linhao Zhong, Zongze Du, Linyu Wu, Yu Bo, Hourong Li, Chenchen Jing, Hao Chen, Yuling Xi, Chunhua Shen
abstract: Open-web future event prediction requires agents to distill reliable signals from noisy, redundant, and incomplete evidence. Existing retrieval/memory mechanisms directly feed retrieved information to agents or rely on simple memory functions such as storing and reusing prior information for prediction, leaving them insufficient for open-web forecasting. We propose to transform raw web evidence into structured memory before prediction, enabling agents to reason over distilled, question-specific evidence rather than noisy retrieval results. This paper presents ForeDreamer, a self-evolving dual-agent framework for managing memory over open-web evidence. ForeDreamer separates factual memory, a question-specific evidence state for the current forecast, from experiential memory, persistent agent experience accumulated across forecasting episodes. It uses a main agent for search and prediction, and a memory-processing subagent to convert search results into factual memory with dedicated tools. ForeDreamer further evolves experiential memory through two tracks, improving both forecasting decisions and factual-memory construction. Experiments on Prophet Arena and FutureX demonstrate the effectiveness of ForeDreamer. Project page: https://zhongzero.github.io/ForeDreamer
summary_zh: 开放网页场景下的未来事件预测要求智能体从存在噪声、冗余且不完整的证据中提炼可靠信号。现有检索/记忆机制直接将检索得到的信息输入智能体，或仅依赖存储、复用先验信息这类简单记忆功能完成预测，难以适配开放网页预测场景。本文提出在预测前将原始网页证据转换为结构化记忆，使智能体能够基于提炼后的、适配特定问题的证据进行推理，而非直接处理带噪声的检索结果。本文提出ForeDreamer这一自进化双智能体框架，用于管理开放网页证据的记忆体系：该框架将事实记忆（面向当前预测任务的特定问题证据状态）与经验记忆（跨多个预测任务累积的智能体持久化经验）分离，由主智能体负责搜索与预测任务，由记忆处理子智能体通过专用工具将搜索结果转换为事实记忆。ForeDreamer还通过两条路径迭代进化经验记忆，同时优化预测决策与事实记忆的构建过程。在Prophet Arena和FutureX两个基准数据集上开展的实验验证了ForeDreamer的有效性。项目主页：https://zhongzero.github.io/ForeDreamer

title: Ontology-Driven Structural Regularization for Document-Level Relation Extraction
title_zh: 面向文档级关系抽取的本体驱动结构正则化方法
authors: Laura Menotti, Stefano Marchesin, Gianmaria Silvello
abstract: We introduce an ontology-driven framework to quantify and enforce structural consistency in DocRE datasets. Our analysis reveals substantial structural noise in DocRED distant and demonstrates that such inconsistencies propagate to model predictions. Enforcing structural well-formedness during training significantly reduces logical contradictions and consistently improves generalization performance. These findings establish structural consistency as a missing axis of supervision in DocRE and highlight structural regularization as an effective strategy for leveraging distant data at scale.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一个本体驱动框架，用于量化并保障文档级关系抽取（DocRE）数据集的结构一致性。分析结果显示，远程监督数据集DocRED中存在大量结构噪声，这类结构不一致问题会传导至模型预测结果中。在训练过程中强制保障结构合规性可显著减少逻辑矛盾，持续提升模型的泛化性能。上述研究结果证明，结构一致性是文档级关系抽取任务中此前缺失的监督维度，同时表明结构正则化是大规模利用远程监督数据的有效策略。

title: Tree-of-Concerns: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Debate for Unstated-Limitation Extraction in Scientific Critique
title_zh: Tree-of-Concerns（关注树）：面向科学评论中未声明局限提取的层级多智能体辩论框架
authors: Sahil Mishra, Niranjan Rajeev, Tanmoy Chakraborty
abstract: As scientific literature grows and papers increasingly under-report limitations, multi-agent LLMs offer a promising approach to systematically uncover these hidden failure modes. Here, we introduce Tree-of-Concerns, a multi-agent framework that deploys specialized skeptic personas, each operating through a category-specific analytical lens, as parallel debate trees to extract unstated limitations from scientific papers. Each persona conducts structured, evidence-grounded argumentation, while a Panel Review mechanism re-evaluates each surviving claim from all five perspectives to correct category drift and severity miscalibration. Through experiments on ToC-Bench, our benchmark of 414 research papers with 1,905 unstated limitations, sourced from reviewer-reported weaknesses and follow-up citation critiques, we demonstrate that ToC improves precision by 79% and coverage by 11% relative to strongest baselines, surfacing specific, evidence-grounded concerns that support reviewers in systematic evaluation.
summary_zh: 随着科研文献体量增长，越来越多的论文未充分报告自身研究局限，多智能体大语言模型为系统挖掘这类隐藏缺陷提供了可行方案。本文提出Tree-of-Concerns（ToC，关注树）这一多智能体框架，部署多个专业化的质疑者角色，每个角色基于特定类别的分析视角作为并行辩论树，从科研论文中提取未被声明的研究局限。每个角色开展结构化、基于证据的论证，同时设置专家组评审机制，从全部五个视角对每一条留存的主张进行重评估，修正类别偏移与严重程度校准偏差。本文构建的基准数据集ToC-Bench包含414篇科研论文、共计1905项未声明局限，数据来源于审稿人报告的研究缺陷与后续引用中的批评内容。在该数据集上的实验结果表明，相较于性能最优的基线方法，ToC的精确率提升79%，覆盖率提升11%，可输出具体的、基于证据的研究关注点，为审稿人的系统性评估提供支撑。

title: AsmEvo: Agentic Assembly-Level Optimization of AMD GPU Kernels with Functional Equivalence Verification
title_zh: AsmEvo：具备功能等价性验证的AMD GPU内核智能体级汇编优化方法
authors: Ji Liu, Puyuan Yang, Rongzhang Zheng, Fan Wang, Jinglin Wang, Muhammad A. Awad, Mortis Huang, Andy Chang, Zekai Li, Zeping Li, Zihao An, Yue Liu, Yuchen Yang, Jianghui Wang, Chushi Chen, Ziqiong Liu, Fuwei Yang, Dong Li, Wen Heng Chung, Shengcai Liu, Emad Barsoum
abstract: We conduct extensive experiments with AsmEvo on various AMD GPU kernels. On MI308X, AsmEvo improves 29 of 30 selected KernelBench kernels, reaching 1.35x geometric-mean and 3.88x maximum speedup. On MI300X production workloads, it improves all evaluated AITer binaries and vLLM/SGLang Triton assembly kernels, reaching 1.09x/1.31x and 1.18x/1.34x geometric-mean/maximum speedups, respectively, while preserving functional equivalence.
summary_zh: 本文基于多种AMD GPU内核对AsmEvo开展了大量实验：在MI308X平台上，AsmEvo对30个选定的KernelBench内核中的29个实现了性能提升，几何平均加速比达1.35倍，最大加速比达3.88倍；在MI300X生产负载场景下，AsmEvo对所有测试的AITer二进制文件、vLLM/SGLang Triton汇编内核均实现了性能提升，二者的几何平均/最大加速比分别达到1.09倍/1.31倍与1.18倍/1.34倍，且全程保持功能等价性。

title: Directional Contextual Representations for Dependency Relations: Why Cross-Direction Pairing Fails
title_zh: 面向依存关系的定向上下文表示：跨方向配对失效原因研究
authors: Sai Krishna Arthanari, JaeHyeong Chang, Chengzhe Sun, Siwei Lyu
abstract: Splitting a bidirectional LSTM's contextual representation into a forward-only $F_i$ (strictly a function of tokens $1..i$) and a backward-only $B_i$ (strictly a function of tokens $i..n$) beats either alone and beats a fused self-attention representation for dependency relation-type classification. But a specific, natural extension of this idea -- pairing a token's forward state against a \emph{candidate}'s backward state (``cross-direction'' pairing, $F_i$ vs.\ $B_j$) -- consistently \emph{underperforms} same-direction pairing, and the penalty \emph{grows}, not shrinks, with token distance, both paired-bootstrap significant. We diagnose why using a frozen-trunk methodology: architectural information leakage between directions is impossible by construction (a single-layer BiLSTM, verified by code inspection); 93\% of the same-vs-cross gap survives freezing the trunk and training only fresh heads, ruling out training-co-adaptation as the primary cause; linear regression shows partial representational redundancy between $F_i$ and $B_i$ ($R^2{=}0.324$ vs.\ $0.028$ for a shuffled control) and a linear probe shows partial anticipatory encoding of upcoming tokens in $F_i$ (36.5\% vs.\ 17.2\% majority baseline) -- real effects, but neither alone, nor combined, cleanly explains the full gap. Extended frozen-trunk diagnostics (a positional probe and a distance-decay probe) show directional information is genuinely stored but not exactly positioned, and propagates only a few tokens before decaying to baseline -- consistent with, and mechanistically underneath, the distance-growth finding.
summary_zh: 将双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）的上下文表示拆分为仅前向状态$F_i$（严格仅由第1到第i个token生成）与仅后向状态$B_i$（严格仅由第i到第n个token生成），在依存关系类型分类任务上的表现优于单独使用任意一种状态，也优于融合后的自注意力表示。但对该思路的一种自然扩展——将某个token的前向状态与候选token的后向状态配对（即“跨方向”配对，$F_i$与$B_j$配对），其性能始终低于同方向配对，且性能差距随token距离增加而扩大而非缩小，两项结论均通过配对bootstrap显著性检验。本文采用冻结主干网络的方法诊断背后原因：首先，通过代码验证的单层BiLSTM结构从设计上就不存在跨方向的架构信息泄漏；其次，将主干网络完全冻结仅训练新增输出头后，同方向配对与跨方向配对的性能差距仍有93%被保留，排除了训练过程协同适配是核心诱因的可能性；线性回归结果显示$F_i$与$B_i$之间存在部分表示冗余（$R^2=0.324$，对照打乱组的$R^2$仅为0.028），线性探针结果显示$F_i$中存在对后续token的部分预期编码（准确率36.5%，多数基线准确率为17.2%），两类效应均真实存在，但二者单独或结合都无法完整解释全部性能差距。后续扩展的冻结主干诊断实验（位置探针与距离衰减探针）表明，定向信息确实被存储但未被精确定位，且仅能传播少数几个token后就衰减至基线水平，该机制与观测到的性能差距随距离扩大的现象完全吻合，为其提供了机理解释。

title: Sparse Token Routing in Efficient Transformers
title_zh: LiLiCorr：面向推测解码的并行草稿轻量似然关联方法
authors: Sai Krishna Arthanari, JaeHyeong Chang, Chengzhe Sun, Siwei Lyu
abstract: Efficient-transformer research often motivates token pruning and adaptive computation with the claim that not all tokens require equal computational effort. We test this claim end to end using SEWN, a two-stream Transformer that routes tokens through either lightweight or full-capacity processing using a learned gate. Across our experiments, routing introduces negligible accuracy change relative to parameter-matched baselines, while the gate's token-importance signal depends critically on how it is learned. A static lexicon-seeded prior fails a counterfactual faithfulness test on BoolQ, whereas a fully contextual gate achieves highly significant separation ($p<10^{-10}$) on both evaluated tasks without changing task accuracy.
summary_zh: 推测解码通过生成后续token草稿、再由目标模型并行验证的方式加速大语言模型推理。DFlash这类扩散风格的块预测头是极具潜力的草稿生成器，可通过一次前向传播预测一整个块的后续token。但这类生成器基于单位置边缘分布训练，而非块的联合分布，因此输出的单个token均符合语法逻辑，但整体块内容不连贯。本文提出LiLiCorr，一种基于轻量似然的模型，可对草稿生成器已输出的各位置边缘分布进行关联：该方法在每个位置保留top-k个token作为候选，对所有候选进行联合处理，为每个候选生成输入向量与输出向量。当前一个候选的输出向量与后一个候选的输入向量余弦相似度较高时，即判定为相邻候选匹配。这类匹配关系可在无需生成完整联合分布的前提下捕获块的联合结构。仅需一次轻量级网络前向传播即可生成所有向量，随后可通过批矩阵操作并行计算所有配对得分，仅保留代价极低的贪心遍历作为串行步骤。本文进一步将草稿生成器与LiLiCorr联合训练，使生成器学习输出可关联为更长可接受序列的候选。相较于原生DFlash草稿生成器，LiLiCorr在所有基准测试集上将可接受序列长度提升9%~19%，其得分头带来的延迟仅占单块总延迟的2.8%。在72种测试设置中的70种下，LiLiCorr的吞吐量均高于DFlash以及另外两种同期提出的草稿阶段连贯性恢复方法：测试场景包含9个基准测试集、2种目标模型大小、贪心解码与温度为1的解码设置，以及覆盖6种并发数、2种输入长度、3种熵等级的吞吐量扫描，所有对比系统均在统一服务栈上完成同等优化。将LiLiCorr扩展到比训练输入长一个数量级的输入场景下，该性能优势仍然保留。

title: LiLiCorr: Lightweight Likelihood Correlation of Parallel Drafts for Speculative Decoding
title_zh: ARGUS：具备策略感知规划与知识锚定的心智理论引导论证生成框架
authors: Matan Rusanovsky, Yoav Miron, Roy Uziel, Omer Belhasin, Ran Zilberstein, Maor Ashkenazi, Michael Elad
abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by drafting future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. A diffusion-style block head such as DFlash is an attractive drafter, predicting an entire block of future tokens in one forward pass. However, it is trained on per-position marginals rather than the joint block distribution, so the tokens it emits are individually plausible yet jointly incoherent. We introduce LiLiCorr, a Lightweight Likelihood-based model that Correlates the per-position marginal distributions a drafter already produces. It keeps the top-k tokens at each position as candidates and processes them jointly, producing for each an in and an out vector. A pair of adjacent candidates matches when the earlier one's out vector has high cosine similarity with the later one's in vector. These matches capture the block's joint structure without ever materializing the full joint distribution. One lightweight network pass produces all the vectors, and the pairwise scores are then computed in parallel as batched matrix operations, leaving only a cheap greedy walk sequential. We further co-train the drafter with LiLiCorr, so it learns to propose candidates that correlate into longer accepted sequences. Over the vanilla DFlash drafter, LiLiCorr raises acceptance length on every benchmark by 9 to 19%, while its scoring head accounts for about 2.8% of the per-block latency. Against DFlash and two concurrent methods that also restore coherence at draft time, LiLiCorr delivers the highest throughput in 70 of 72 settings: nine benchmarks at two target sizes under greedy and temperature-one decoding, and a throughput sweep over six concurrencies, two input lengths and three entropy tiers, with all systems equally optimized on a common serving stack. Extending LiLiCorr to inputs an order of magnitude longer than it was trained on preserves that lead.
summary_zh: 生成有说服力的论证需要对受众信念、修辞策略与事实锚定进行建模。尽管相关研究已取得诸多进展，现有方法大多未考虑受众差异，也未整合策略选择环节以提升论证说服力。为解决该问题，本文提出Argus这一基于智能体的框架，将经典修辞学理论落地到说服性写作场景。该框架的核心是心智理论（ToM）推理器，可构建受众信念与价值的显式双心智模型，为下游决策提供引导。该表示层为组件感知规划器提供条件，规划器可将论证拆解为多个子主题，分配细粒度的修辞功能（理性诉求、情感诉求、品格诉求、时机诉求），并在规划阶段触发策略引导的证据检索。最后通过精炼模块迭代定位并修复多维度缺陷，且不会出现质量退化。本文基于三类不同的基准数据集，采用自动配对Elo评分与大模型评审指标对Argus进行评估，结果显示Argus在多种骨干模型下的表现均持续优于强基线方法，取得最高排名与整体最优得分。定向仿真实验进一步验证了该框架在转变受众抵触立场方面的有效性。

title: ARGUS: Theory-of-Mind Guided Argument Generation with Strategy-Aware Planning and Knowledge Grounding
authors: Zhe Hu
